name: Famocid 40mg Tablet 14'S
introduction:
Introduction About FAMOCID 40MG TABLET

Famocid 40 mg Tablet is a commonly prescribed acid-reducing medicine that contains famotidine, a histamine-2 (H2) receptor blocker. It is typically used to help manage conditions related to excess stomach acid, such as acidity, sour burps, gastric discomfort, and acid reflux. Individuals who frequently experience burning in the chest after meals or discomfort during bedtime due to acid buildup may find this medicine beneficial under medical guidance. 

This tablet works by reducing the production of acid in the stomach. Famotidine blocks the H2 receptors in the stomach lining, which are responsible for signalling acid release. Clinical studies have shown that H2 blockers like famotidine can reduce gastric acidity within 1 hour and offer sustained relief for up to 12 hours. Famocid 40 mg may be especially suitable for adults who experience recurring acid-related discomfort, those with a diagnosed acid-peptic condition, or individuals sensitive to dietary triggers such as spicy, oily, or late-night meals.

Famocid 40 mg should be used cautiously in those with kidney problems, older adults, or those taking multiple medications, due to possible drug interactions. If you experience black stools, vomiting with blood, or ongoing abdominal pain, seek immediate medical attention. Use during pregnancy or breastfeeding should be based on medical recommendation only. Commonly reported side effects include headache, constipation, diarrhoea, and dizziness. If symptoms persist or worsen, consult your healthcare provider promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How FAMOCID 40MG TABLET Works
Mechanism of Famocid 40 Tablet

Famocid 40 contains famotidine, which belongs to a group of medicines called H2-receptor antagonists. It works by blocking histamine-2 receptors in the stomach lining. This reduces the production of gastric acid and helps relieve symptoms like acidity, bloating and heartburn caused by excess acid.

How Does Famotidine Block Acid Production?

Famotidine blocks the H2 receptors on the cells of the stomach wall. These receptors normally respond to a chemical called histamine, which triggers acid production. By blocking this signal, famotidine reduces acid release, making the stomach environment less acidic and more comfortable.

name: DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR Oral Suspension 170ml
introduction:
Introduction About DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION

DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION is a combination of Aluminium hydroxide, Magnesium hydroxide, and Simethicone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antacids and Antifoaming agents. It is indicated for the relief of indigestion (dyspepsia), heartburn, and flatulence.

DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use if you have kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or might become pregnant, or are breastfeeding before using DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION.

DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children aged 2 to 18 years of age. Your child’s doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, disease condition, and body weight.

The most common side effects of taking DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION are diarrhea, stomach pain, bloating, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn, upset stomach, constipation, loss of appetite, and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Use of DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION may cause hypermagnesemia (increased levels of magnesium in blood) in small children, particularly if they have renal impairment or dehydration. Others

Are feeling very weak and have no energy (debilitated)
Have low levels of phosphate in the blood (hypophosphatemia)

Before taking DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION, tell your doctor if you:

Are on a low-phosphorus diet
Are suffering from porphyria and are undergoing hemodialysis
Have intolerance to fructose

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicines before taking DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION:

Medicines used to manage the heart diseases (such as digoxin, quinidine, metoprolol, atenolol, and propranolol)
Medicines used to manage anemia (Ex. iron salts)
Medicines used to manage stomach ulcers and acidity (H2 antagonists) such as ranitidine or cimetidine
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. chloroquine)
Medicines used to manage some bone disorders (bisphosphonates), such as alendronate
Medicines used to manage some allergic, inflammatory, or abnormal immune reactions (glucocorticoids), such as hydrocortisone
Medicines used to manage kidney disorders, such as citrates
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. ethambutol, isoniazid)
Medicines used to manage infections (Ex. Ciprofloxacin, clindamycin, ketoconazole, tetracylines, cefpodoxime and cefdinir, dolutegravir, elvitegravir, raltegravir potassium, and tenofovir alafenamide fumarate/emtricitabine/bictegravir sodium, rilpivirine)
Medicines used to manage mental illness (psychosis) (Ex. chlorpromazine)
Medicines used to manage high levels of potassium in the body (Ex. polystyrene sulfonate)
Medicines used to manage pain (Ex. diflunisal and indomethacin)
Medicines used in dental care (Ex. sodium fluorure)
Medicines used to manage an underactive thyroid gland (Ex. levothyroxine)
Medicines used to manage joint pains and abnormal chemical reactions in the body (Ex. penicillamine)
Medicines used to reduce cholesterol (Ex. rosuvastatin)
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. nilotinib, dasatinib monohydrate)
Medicines used to manage blood disorders (Ex. eltrombopag olamine)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure in the lungs (pulmonary hypertension) (Ex. riociguat)
Salicylates such as aspirin (used to manage pain and inflammation)

B. Drug-food interactions:

NA

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of DYNACID SUGAR FREE SAUNF FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

name: PANTOP DSR Capsule 15's
introduction:
Introduction About PANTOP DSR CAPSULE

Pantop DSR Capsule is a dual-action formulation combining Pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor and Domperidone, a prokinetic agent. It is helpful for individuals who experience recurring gastric discomfort, acid build-up, post-meal bloating or frequent burping. It is especially beneficial for those with a pattern of acid-related issues that worsen on an empty stomach or after heavy meals. Whether due to irregular meal timings, dietary choices or stress-induced acidity, Pantop DSR is designed to support a more comfortable and regulated digestive experience.   

Pantoprazole works by reducing the production of excess stomach acid creating a balanced gastric environment, while Domperidone enhances stomach motility, helping move food and gas more efficiently through the digestive tract. It is generally suitable for adults who face frequent episodes of bloating, discomfort after meals, or acid-related unease, especially those with sedentary lifestyles or irregular eating patterns.

For optimal effectiveness, Pantop DSR Capsule is usually taken once daily before meals, ideally in the morning. It should be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing. Adherence to the recommended timing and dosage, as directed by a healthcare provider, ensures better symptom control. It is important to maintain a gap of at least 30–60 minutes between the capsule and any calcium, iron, or magnesium supplements, as these may interfere with absorption. Avoid consuming alcohol and spicy foods while on this capsule, as these can aggravate stomach acid levels.

Caution is advised in individuals with liver, kidney, or heart conditions. It is also important to consult a doctor before use in pregnancy or while breastfeeding, as the safety of Domperidone is still under clinical evaluation in such groups. While generally well-tolerated, some users may experience dry mouth, headache, dizziness, or mild gastrointestinal disturbances such as loose stools or constipation. If any unusual or persistent symptoms occur, medical guidance should be sought promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How PANTOP DSR CAPSULE Works
How Pantop DSR Capsule Supports Gastric Acid Regulation

The formulation is designed to act at two levels:

Regulation of Excess Stomach Acid: The capsule contains a component that helps reduce the volume and acidity of stomach secretions. This contributes to a more neutral internal environment, helping relieve common discomfort associated with hyperacidity
Improved Stomach Emptying: By supporting the movement of food through the stomach and into the intestines, this capsule helps reduce the sensation of heaviness, bloating, and fullness which is the common experiences related to delayed gastric emptying

The delayed-release property ensures that the active ingredients are released only when they reach specific areas of the gastrointestinal tract, helping minimize irritation and maximize their function.

The dual-action formula works both to control excess stomach acid and to encourage smooth digestion which can help reduce regurgitation and discomfort caused by acid reflux

name: Rantac 150mg Tablet 30'S
introduction:
Introduction About RANTAC 150MG TABLET

Rantac 150mg Tablet contains Ranitidine, a compound that supports acid balance in the stomach. Commonly recommended during acidity-related discomfort like peptic/intestinal ulcers, this tablet is often used under doctor supervision as part of daily digestive health support.

RANTAC 150MG TABLET is also used to manage reflux oesophagitis and Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome (small tumour in the first part of your intestine due to excessive gastrin secretion).

Your doctor may occasionally perform tests to make sure RANTAC 150MG TABLET is working and to manage side effects. Visit your doctor routinely for a check-up.

Avoid smoking during the treatment, as it may delay healing or worsen the ulcers. Inform your doctor if you have stomach cancer, kidney, lung or immunity problems, porphyria (rare blood disorder) or diabetes.

RANTAC 150MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless your doctor finds it essential. mechanismOfAction:
How RANTAC 150MG TABLET Works

Ranitidine belongs to a group of medicines called H2-receptor antagonists (also called H2 blockers). These medicines are designed to reduce the natural production of stomach acid.

Histamine in the stomach binds to H2 receptors on specialized cells in your stomach lining.
This binding triggers acid secretion into the stomach.
Ranitidine blocks H2 receptors – preventing histamine from activating them.
As a result, less acid is produced, helping reduce stomach acidity levels.

usageDetails:
How to use RANTAC 150MG TABLET
How to Take Rantac 150mg Tablet Safely

Swallow Rantac 150mg whole with a glass of water. Avoid crushing or chewing the tablet. It may be advised to take it before meals or at bedtime, based on your doctor's instructions. Staying upright for at least 30 minutes post-dose is considered helpful for stomach comfort.

What Is the Recommended Dosage for Rantac 150?

The commonly advised adult dosage for Rantac 150mg may vary depending on your health condition and doctor’s assessment. It is typically suggested once or twice a day — either before meals or at bedtime. Always follow your healthcare provider’s instructions.

Should Rantac Be Taken With Food or On an Empty Stomach?

Rantac 150mg is generally taken 15–30 minutes before a meal, especially if meal-related symptoms are a concern. Taking it on an empty stomach may allow it to work faster, but follow your doctor’s timing guidance.

How Often Can Rantac 150 Be Taken in a Day?

Rantac 150mg may be advised once or twice daily, depending on your individual health plan. Avoid taking more than advised. Keep a minimum 8–12 hour gap between doses if advised twice daily.

When Is the Best Time to Take Rantac 150mg?

Depending on the reason it is prescribed, it may be best taken:

Before meals to support digestion-related discomfort
At bedtime to manage overnight gastric discomfort

Consult your healthcare provider for specific timing based on your symptoms and lifestyle.

Can Rantac Be Taken at Night or Before Bed?

Yes, in some cases, a bedtime dose of Rantac 150mg may be advised to support overnight comfort. This is particularly useful if night-time stomach issues are frequent. Take it with water and avoid lying down immediately after.

introduction:
Introduction About NODOSIS GST 500MG TABLET

Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet is an alkalinizing agent that helps restore the body’s acid-base balance in conditions linked with increased acidity. It contains Sodium Bicarbonate, which works by neutralizing excess acid in the blood, stomach, or urine. This makes it beneficial in situations like metabolic acidosis, heartburn, indigestion, urinary alkalinization, and certain intoxications involving acidic compounds. By helping maintain optimal pH levels, it supports normal cellular metabolism and promotes kidney function efficiency.

It is generally recommended for individuals who experience acidic imbalance, digestive discomfort, or require urinary pH adjustment as advised by their doctor. It is suitable for patients needing support in managing acid-related concerns caused by underlying metabolic or dietary conditions. The tablet should be taken after meals with a glass of water to minimize gastric irritation. The dosage and duration depend on the patient’s medical needs and physician’s advice. Avoid taking it with acidic drinks or immediately after large meals to maintain its neutralizing effect.

Before taking Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet, patients should inform their healthcare provider about any existing kidney, liver, or heart conditions, or if they are on a low-sodium diet. Overuse or prolonged intake without guidance may lead to electrolyte imbalance or increased sodium levels in the blood. It is important not to self-adjust the dose or use it for extended periods without medical supervision. Always maintain a gap of at least 2 hours between this tablet and other oral medicines to avoid potential drug interactions.

It should be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding only under medical supervision. Your doctor will weigh the benefits and potential risks before recommending its use. Most people tolerate this medicine well, but some may experience nausea, bloating, mild stomach discomfort, or increased thirst. If any unusual symptoms occur, it is advisable to seek medical advice promptly. Overall, when taken as prescribed, Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet supports healthy acid balance and contributes to better metabolic and digestive health.

mechanismOfAction:
How NODOSIS GST 500MG TABLET Works
Mechanism of Action of Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet

Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet works primarily by neutralizing excess acid in the body through its active ingredient, Sodium Bicarbonate, an alkalinizing agent. When dissolved, it releases bicarbonate ions, which combine with hydrogen ions in the body to form carbonic acid. This carbonic acid then breaks down into water and carbon dioxide, which are safely eliminated through the lungs and kidneys.

This mechanism helps restore the acid-base balance in the blood and tissues, relieving acidity-related discomfort and maintaining optimal pH levels. Additionally, the alkalinization of urine helps enhance the excretion of acidic drugs and toxins, supporting detoxification processes. Overall, Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet promotes internal balance by reducing acid overload and aiding in the smooth functioning of metabolic and renal systems.

warnings.details: Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet should be used during pregnancy only if clearly needed and under medical advice. Excessive intake may alter the acid-base balance in the body, which could affect both mother and baby. Always consult your doctor before use during pregnancy.

It is not known whether the components of Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet pass into breast milk. Since sodium bicarbonate may affect the infant’s acid-base balance, breastfeeding women should use this medicine only on a doctor’s recommendation.

Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet does not usually affect alertness or coordination. However, if you experience dizziness, headache, or unusual tiredness after taking it, avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you feel better.

Patients with kidney problems should use Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet with caution. The medicine contains sodium, which may accumulate and cause electrolyte imbalance or fluid retention in those with impaired kidney function. Dose adjustment and regular monitoring of electrolytes are advisable.

Individuals with liver impairment should take Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet only under medical supervision. The sodium content may worsen fluid retention or influence metabolic balance in severe liver conditions. Inform your doctor about any liver issues before starting the medicine.

Do not take Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet if you are allergic to sodium bicarbonate, simethicone, or any of its inactive ingredients. Seek medical attention immediately if you experience rash, itching, swelling, or difficulty breathing after taking the medicine.

While not directly affecting lung function, patients with respiratory conditions such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) or asthma should consult their doctor before use, as metabolic changes may indirectly affect breathing patterns.

People with heart conditions, including high blood pressure, heart failure, or fluid retention, should use Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet cautiously. Its sodium content can increase blood pressure and may worsen heart symptoms if taken in excess.
Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet is not recommended for use in children unless prescribed by a doctor. The dosage must be carefully calculated based on age and weight.

Elderly patients should take Nodosis GST 500mg Tablet under strict medical guidance. Due to the risk of electrolyte imbalance or fluid overload, the lowest effective dose is usually recommended with regular monitoring.

introduction:
Introduction About ESPUMISAN GOLD CAPSULE

ESPUMISAN GOLD CAPSULE contains Simethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Digestants. It is used to provide relief from bloating (gas) and other unpleasant symptoms associated with accumulation of excess gas in the stomach (such as stomach discomfort or pain, sense of fullness, pressure in the stomach etc.).

ESPUMISAN GOLD CAPSULE should be taken at least 10 minutes before meals. Before taking ESPUMISAN GOLD CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have thyroid problems, high blood calcium levels or phenylketonuria. ESPUMISAN GOLD CAPSULE is considered safe for use both in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

The most common side effect of taking ESPUMISAN GOLD CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, constipation and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

Manage bloating (gas)
Relieves stomach discomfort or pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ESPUMISAN GOLD CAPSULE Works

ESPUMISAN GOLD CAPSULE is a surfactant medicine with anti-gas properties. It works by decreasing the surface tension of gas bubbles in the gastrointestinal tract. This action helps in eliminating the accumulated gas from the gut region along with bowel movements. It also manages further accumulation of gas in the gut.

Take ESPUMISAN GOLD CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It should be taken at least 10 minutes before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About RANIDOM O SUGAR FREE ORANGE FLAVOUR SUSPENSION

RANIDOM O SUGAR FREE ORANGE FLAVOUR SUSPENSION is a combination of Magaldrate, Oxetacaine, and Simethicone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antacid, Local Anaesthetic and Anti-flatulence, respectively. It is used for the management of acidity, heartburn, gas, and stomach ulcers. The stomach is generally protected from acid by a mucous layer.

In some cases, due to excess production of acid, the mucous layer gets eroded, which leads to problems like acidity and heartburn. Bloating occurs when the abdomen is filled with air or gas. Avoid smoking and alcohol consumption while taking RANIDOM O SUGAR FREE ORANGE FLAVOUR SUSPENSION, as it leads to increased production of stomach acid, thereby increasing acidity and heartburn.

RANIDOM O SUGAR FREE ORANGE FLAVOUR SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with hepatic and renal impairments. RANIDOM O SUGAR FREE ORANGE FLAVOUR SUSPENSION is not recommended for use by pregnant or breastfeeding women. RANIDOM O SUGAR FREE ORANGE FLAVOUR SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking RANIDOM O SUGAR FREE ORANGE FLAVOUR SUSPENSION are nausea, vomiting, constipation, diarrhea, and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

How RANIDOM O SUGAR FREE ORANGE FLAVOUR SUSPENSION Works

RANIDOM O SUGAR FREE ORANGE FLAVOUR SUSPENSION is a combination of magaldrate, oxetacaine and simethicone. Magaldrate is an antacid that works by neutralizing excess stomach acid. Oxetacaine is a local anaesthetic that exerts a numbing effect, thereby providing relief from pain due to ulcers or acidic injuries in the stomach. Simethicone is an antiflatulent that works by decreasing gas bubbles' surface tension, thereby facilitating gas expulsion through flatus or belching (burping). It also manages gas accumulation and formation in the digestive tract.

Introduction About PAN D CAPSULE

PAN-D Capsule is a combination medicine used to manage acid reflux, heartburn, burping, bloating indigestion, burning sensation in throat and food pipe and other signs of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD). It can also be used to heal inflammation of stomach lining (gastritis).

It contains a combination of Pantoprazole and Domperidone, which work together to reduce acid production and improve digestion.

Pan D Capsule is used to manage digestive health i.e peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. PAN D CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with PAN D CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking PAN D CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

PAN D CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking PAN D CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

PAN-D Capsule should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Proper dosage adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients, especially when taken for a longer time. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems before taking PAN-D Capsule as a precaution.

PAN-D Capsule is not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems. Regular monitoring of liver functions is necessary in such patients.
Do not take Pan-D Capsule if you are allergic to Domperidone, Pantoprazole or to any other ingredients of this medicine.

PAN-D Capsule is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as prolongation of QT interval or congestive heart failure. Therefore, inform your doctor if you have any heart problems before taking PAN-D Capsule as a precaution.

The safety and effectiveness of PAN-D Capsule have not been established in children aged below 18 years. Your doctor will decide whether this medicine should be used in children or not based on potential benefits and risks of the therapy.

PAN D CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) especially in those having kidney and liver functions, as a prolonged therapy. Regular monitoring of liver and kidney functions are required in such patients.

More Information
Which is Better: PAN D or Omeprazole?

Both PAN D (Pantoprazole and Domperidone) and Omeprazole (a proton pump inhibitor) are used to manage gastrointestinal conditions such as acid reflux, GERD, and ulcers, but they have distinct differences and applications:

Omeprazole is typically preferred for Managing long-term acid-related disorders like GERD and peptic ulcers. Simple acid suppression without the need for motility support.

PAN D is chosen when There are accompanying symptoms of nausea, bloating, or delayed gastric emptying, Patients need additional relief from symptoms like belching or feeling of fullness due to domperidone's prokinetic properties.

Omeprazole has fewer potential drug interactions as compared to PAN D, which includes Domperidone that can affect cardiac health (risk of QT prolongation).

Eat Smaller, More Frequent Meals: Large meals can put pressure on the stomach and worsen acid reflux. Aim for 4-5 smaller meals throughout the day.
Avoid Trigger Foods: Common GERD triggers include spicy foods, citrus, tomatoes, chocolate, caffeine, and fatty foods.
Opt for Lean Proteins: Choose lean meats like chicken, turkey, and fish instead of fatty cuts of meat, which can increase stomach acid.
Incorporate Fiber-Rich Foods: Foods like whole grains, vegetables, and oats help absorb stomach acid and improve digestion.
Drink Plenty of Water: Staying hydrated helps neutralize stomach acid and aids in digestion.
Lifestyle Changes for Better Digestion:
Maintain a Healthy Weight: Excess weight can increase abdominal pressure, worsening GERD symptoms.
Avoid Lying Down After Meals: Wait at least 2-3 hours after eating before lying down to reduce the risk of acid reflux.
Elevate Your Head While Sleeping: Use extra pillows or elevate the head of your bed to prevent acid from traveling up your esophagus.
Stop Smoking: Smoking weakens the lower esophageal sphincter, increasing the likelihood of acid reflux.
Stay Active: Regular physical activity helps with digestion and overall health, but avoid vigorous exercise right after meals.

SOBISIS TABLET contains Sodium Bicarbonate and is commonly used to provide relief from acidity, heartburn, and indigestion. This medication works by neutralizing excess stomach acid, providing fast relief from symptoms.

Introduction About PAN 40 TABLET

Pan 40 Tablet contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking Pan 40 Tablet  as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking Pan 40 Tablet, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How PAN 40 TABLET Works

Pan 40 Tablet contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why Pan 40 Tablet Is Effective for Acid Control:
Pan 40 Tablet  effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take Pan 40 Tablet?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

Introduction About REBOZEN 20MG TABLET

REBOZEN 20MG TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take REBOZEN 20MG TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking REBOZEN 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take REBOZEN 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking REBOZEN 20MG TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking REBOZEN 20MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About OMEZ 20MG CAPSULE

Omez 20mg Capsule is a medication primarily used to manage acid reflux, stomach ulcers, and other gastrointestinal problems. It contains the active ingredient Omeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that reduces stomach acid production.

Omez 20mg Capsule is most effective when taken an hour before a meal, ideally in the morning. The dosage will vary based on your condition and how you respond to the medication. It is important to continue taking it as prescribed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. To enhance the management's effectiveness, consider eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated drinks (such as tea and coffee) as well as spicy or fatty foods.

Common side effect of this medication includes headache, diarrhea, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting and flatulence. These symptoms are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, it is advisable to consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of side effects. For example, using it for over a year, particularly at higher doses, may elevate the risk of bone fractures. Discuss with your doctor ways to help reduce bone loss (osteoporosis).

Before starting this medication, inform your doctor if you have a history of severe liver issues, allergic reactions to similar drugs, or bone loss (osteoporosis). Other medications may interact with this one, so make sure to tell your doctor about all the medicines you are currently taking to ensure safety. This is especially important if you are using medicines for HIV, fungal infections, tuberculosis, epilepsy (seizures), or certain blood thinners. If you are pregnant or breastfeeding, consult your doctor before taking this medication.

mechanismOfAction:
How OMEZ 20MG CAPSULE Works

Omez 20mg Capsule contains the active ingredient omeprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, helping to relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and stomach ulcers. By blocking the proton pumps in the stomach lining that produce acid, Omez helps to create a less acidic environment, allowing the esophagus and stomach lining to heal, and reducing further damage from excess stomach acid. This action also provides relief from the discomfort associated with acid-related digestive problems.

introduction:
Introduction About NEXPRO 40MG TABLET

Nexpro 40mg Tablet, containing esomeprazole, is widely chosen by individuals seeking relief from persistent acidity, heartburn, and acid reflux symptoms. It is especially useful for those experiencing discomfort due to gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcers, erosive esophagitis, or conditions involving excessive stomach acid production such as Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. By blocking the proton pumps in the stomach lining, esomeprazole effectively reduces acid secretion, promoting healing of the stomach and esophageal lining and improving overall digestive comfort. 

This tablet is ideal for adults and can also be considered for use in elderly patients, pregnant or breastfeeding women, and those with kidney or liver conditions, though it should only be used under medical supervision in these groups. Nexpro 40mg is generally taken once daily, preferably before meals, and should be swallowed whole with water—crushing or chewing the tablet is not recommended for optimal absorption. Consistency in timing and adherence to the prescribed duration are important for achieving the best results. 

Patients are advised to inform their healthcare provider about any existing allergies, liver problems, or plans for pregnancy or breastfeeding before starting Nexpro 40mg Tablet. It is important to avoid alcohol and certain foods that may worsen acidity, and to be cautious about potential interactions with other medications such as blood thinners, antifungals, and anti-HIV drugs. Prolonged use may lead to deficiencies in vitamin B12, calcium, or magnesium, and may increase the risk of bone thinning (osteoporosis). If you experience symptoms like severe stomach pain, black stools, or allergic reactions, immediate medical attention is necessary. 

During pregnancy and breastfeeding, Nexpro 40mg Tablet may be used if clearly needed and prescribed by a doctor, as current evidence suggests safety but emphasizes the importance of medical guidance. Common side effects include headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, dizziness, and flatulence. Most side effects are mild and temporary, but any persistent or severe symptoms should be reported to your healthcare provider.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEXPRO 40MG TABLET Works
How Does Nexpro 40mg Reduce Stomach Acid

Nexpro 40mg Tablet contains esomeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively lowers stomach acid production. It works by blocking the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, located in the stomach lining. This enzyme is responsible for the final step in the secretion of gastric acid. By inhibiting this pump, Nexpro 40mg significantly reduces both basal and stimulated acid secretion, providing long-lasting acid suppression and promoting the healing of acid-related conditions

Nexpro 40mg Tablet action in acid reflux

In acid reflux, stomach acid flows back into the esophagus, causing symptoms like heartburn and discomfort. Nexpro 40mg Tablet helps manage these symptoms by decreasing the amount of acid produced in the stomach. This reduction in acid not only relieves the burning sensation but also helps protect the esophageal lining from further irritation and damage. The tablet is usually taken before meals for optimal effectiveness, as recommended by healthcare professionals

Nexpro 40mg Tablet mode of action in peptic ulcer

Peptic ulcers develop when the stomach lining is damaged by excess acid. Nexpro 40mg Tablet aids in the healing process by suppressing gastric acid secretion through inhibition of the proton pump. With lower acid levels, the ulcerated tissue is given a better environment to recover, reducing pain and the risk of complications. Regular use as directed by a healthcare provider supports ulcer healing and helps prevent recurrence

Is Nexpro 40mg More Effective Than H2 Blockers for GERD?

Nexpro 40mg Tablet (esomeprazole) is generally considered more effective than H2 blockers (H2-receptor antagonists) for treating GERD. Proton pump inhibitors like Nexpro 40mg suppress stomach acid more profoundly and for a longer duration than H2 blockers. Clinical studies show that PPIs provide symptomatic relief in about 83% of GERD patients, compared to 60% with H2 blockers. Additionally, healing rates for esophagitis are significantly higher with PPIs—about 78% versus 50% with H2 blockers. This greater efficacy is because PPIs block the final step of acid production, while H2 blockers only partially reduce acid and are less effective, especially after meals. For most patients with moderate to severe GERD, Nexpro 40mg is preferred for both symptom control and healing of the esophagus.

introduction:
Introduction About ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE

ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE is a combination of Domperidone and Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used in adults to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumors in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid). ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE is effective in managing peptic ulcer caused either due to stomach infection (H. pylori infection) or due to prolong use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (such as ibuprofen, Aceclofenac etc). It can also be used to manage re-bleeding from the ulcers. GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the acid from the stomach frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE should be taken at least 30 minutes before meals. During management with ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones. ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE Works

ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE contains two medicines namely Domperidone and Esomeprazole. Domperidone works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and the brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Esomeprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).
usageDetails:
How to use ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE

Take ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE 30 minutes to 1 hour before meals or as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE unless your doctor advice you to stop.

ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having heart problems (such as prolongation of QT wave, congestive heart failure or arrhythmia). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. However, consult your doctor before taking it.
ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Have bloody stools or bleeding in the gut
Have blockage or tear in the intestines
Have severe fluid or electrolyte disturbances
Have prolactinoma (a non-cancerous tumor of pituitary gland)
Have low blood potassium or magnesium levels
Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)

Before taking ESOMEFOL DSR 30/40MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you:

Have osteoporosis
Have vitamin B12 deficiency (sore tongue, mouth ulcers, pale skin, depression)
Are going to test Chromogranin A level

introduction:
Introduction About SOBIREN 500MG TABLET

SOBIREN 500MG TABLET contains Sodium Bicarbonate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antacids. It is used in the management of metabolic acidosis. Metabolic acidosis can be defined as a condition in which body fluids and tissues produce too much acid in the body. It can also be used to manage heartburn (a burning sensation in the chest) and indigestion.

Before taking SOBIREN 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high levels of sodium in the blood, peripheral oedema (swelling of body parts due to fluid retention), or if you are following a strict diet that contains low sodium. In patients with severe liver disease, kidney disease, breathing difficulties, or heart failure, SOBIREN 500MG TABLET should be used with caution.

SOBIREN 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women unless clearly necessary. SOBIREN 500MG TABLET is not recommended to be used by children. SOBIREN 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (those over the age of 75). Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking SOBIREN 500MG TABLET are hypernatremia (a high level of sodium in the blood), alkalosis (an increased alkaline substance in the blood), cellulitis (a bacterial skin infection), etc. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

SOBIREN 500MG TABLET functions as an alkalizing agent by increasing plasma bicarbonate concentration, which raises the pH of urine and blood. As a result, it manages metabolic acidosis (increased production of acid in the body). It also works by neutralising the excessive production of stomach acid and increasing the pH value of stomach fluids. Thus, it relieves acidity symptoms.

name: Pantafol 40mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET

PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). mechanismOfAction:
How PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET Works

PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

More Information
01.What makes PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET a preferred choice over other medications?
Potent and Long-Lasting Acid Suppression: PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively blocks the final step of stomach acid production, providing stronger and longer-lasting relief from symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, and indigestion compared to H2 blockers or antacids.
Comprehensive Symptom Relief and Healing: It not only relieves discomfort from acid-related conditions but also promotes healing of stomach and duodenal ulcers, and helps manage more severe conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
Lowering with Painkiller Use: PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET is recommended for lowering stomach ulcers and acidity in patients who require long-term use of painkillers (NSAIDs), a benefit not offered by all acid-reducing medicines.
Convenient Once-Daily Dosing: Its long duration of action allows for once-daily dosing, making it easier for patients to adhere to treatment and maintain consistent acid control.
Favorable Tolerability Profile: Most side effects are mild and temporary, such as headache, nausea, or diarrhea. Serious side effects are rare when used as directed, and the risk of complications can be minimized with appropriate monitoring.
Well-Studied and Trusted: Pantoprazole, the active ingredient, is widely used and supported by extensive clinical experience, ensuring both efficacy and safety for a broad range of patients.

These advantages make PANTAFOL 40MG TABLET a reliable and effective option for both short-term relief and long-term management of acid-related disorders, often outperforming less potent or shorter-acting alternatives.

introduction:
Introduction About GASOGEST SUSPENSION

GASOGEST SUSPENSION is used to manage gastrointestinal disorders manifested with hyperacidity and increased gas production. It may be administered as monotherapy or to manage gastro-oesophagitis reflux, chronic diarrhea, and non-ulcer dyspepsia. GASOGEST SUSPENSION contains Aluminium hydroxide, Magnesium hydroxide, and oxetacaine, which belong to a group of medicines called Antacids and Local anaesthetics, respectively.

GASOGEST SUSPENSION is not recommended for patients with chronic renal failure. Patients should be advised not to take any oral medication within 1 to 2 hours of taking GASOGEST SUSPENSION, as it has potential interactions with other medicines. Patients should be informed that GASOGEST SUSPENSION held for a long time in the mouth may impair taste sensation because of its oxetacaine content.

Patients should be advised not to exceed the prescribed amounts of GASOGEST SUSPENSION, as it may cause hypersensitive reactions. The most common side effects of taking GASOGEST SUSPENSION are nausea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse while taking GASOGEST SUSPENSION.

mechanismOfAction:
How GASOGEST SUSPENSION Works

GASOGEST SUSPENSION is a combination of Aluminium hydroxide, Magnesium hydroxide, and Oxetacaine. Aluminium hydroxide acts on the hydrochloric acid in the stomach by neutralizing it, forming Aluminium chloride salt and water. Magnesium hydroxide increases peristaltic activity, causing osmotic retention of fluids, thus resulting in bowel evacuation. It also reduces stomach acid by reacting with hydrochloric acid to form magnesium chloride. Oxetacaine is a topical anaesthetic that effectively relieves pain when applied to the mouth and food pipelining. The antacids neutralize stomach acid and reduce further irritation of the food pipe. Antacid also thickens the liquid to help carry the oxetacaine and coat the food pipe.
usageDetails:
How to use GASOGEST SUSPENSION

Take GASOGEST SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Take GASOGEST SUSPENSION 1 to 2 teaspoonfuls 4 times a day, 15 minutes before each meal and at bedtime. It is preferable to take GASOGEST SUSPENSION undiluted. However, a sip of water may be taken if desired. The correct dose and duration for you will be decided by the doctor depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PANTAFOL DSR CAPSULE

PANTAFOL DSR CAPSULE is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. PANTAFOL DSR CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with PANTAFOL DSR CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking PANTAFOL DSR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

PANTAFOL DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking PANTAFOL DSR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

mechanismOfAction:
How PANTAFOL DSR CAPSULE Works

PANTAFOL DSR CAPSULE contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, PANTAFOL DSR CAPSULE it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

introduction:
Introduction About OMIFYL CAPSULE

OMIFYL CAPSULE contains Omeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called  Proton pump inhibitors. It is used in the management of gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (acid contents in the stomach flows back into the tube connecting your mouth and stomach causing heartburn, nausea, vomiting, bitter taste, discomfort in upper abdomen) in children (above 1 years of age) and adults.

It is used in adults to manage gastric (stomach), duodenal ulcer (upper part of the intestine), ulcers infected with Helicobacter pylori bacteria in addition with antibiotics (including children) and ulcers due to the use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs).

Also, it is used in adults to manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (increased acid secretion in the stomach due to growth in pancreas resulting in abdominal pain, diarrhoea, gnawing or discomfort in upper abdomen, heartburn, nausea and vomiting).

OMIFYL CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with history of allergic reactions to omeprazole or any other proton pump inhibitors (Ex. pantoprazole, lansoprazole, rabeprazole and esomeprazole).

Before taking OMIFYL CAPSULE, tell your doctor if you have any severe liver problems, weight loss, swallowing problems, stomach pain or indigestion, osteoporosis (condition in which bones become weak and brittle), vitamin B12 deficiency, schedule for specific blood test (chromogranin A).

OMIFYL CAPSULE can be used in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor. OMIFYL CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) due to increased risk of fractures.

The most common side effects of taking OMIFYL CAPSULE are headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How OMIFYL CAPSULE Works

OMIFYL CAPSULE effectively lowers the amount of acid produced in the stomach by irreversibly binding to and inhibiting the hydrogen-potassium ATPase pump that resides on the lining of the digestive tract. This kind of action helps to reduce vomiting, promote healing of damaged stomach tissue in ulcers.

Introduction About SOMPRAZ D 40MG CAPSULE

Sompraz D 40mg Capsule is a medication used to manage acid reflux, heartburn, GERD, and stomach ulcers. It contains two active ingredients such as domperidone and esomeprazole which work together to reduce acid secretion and improve digestion.

Sompraz D 40 Capsule should be taken as prescribed by your doctor, typically on an empty stomach. The dosage and duration will vary depending on your condition and how you respond to the medication. It is important to continue the management for as long as recommended by your doctor, as stopping too soon may cause your symptoms to return or worsen. Be sure to inform your doctor about any other medications you are taking, as some may interact with this medicine.

Common side effects of Sompraz D 40mg Capsule include headache, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation, flatulence (gas), skin rash or irritation, dryness in mouth. Most of these side effects are temporary and typically resolve over time. However, if you are concerned about any of them, contact your doctor immediately. This medication may also cause drowsiness and dizziness, so avoid driving or engaging in activities that require focus until you are familiar with how it affects you. It is also important to refrain from drinking alcohol while using this medication, as it can increase sleepiness. To improve results, consider lifestyle changes such as drinking cold milk and avoiding hot tea, coffee, spicy foods, or chocolate.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Additionally, let your doctor know if you have any liver conditions so that they can adjust the dosage accordingly.

mechanismOfAction:
How SOMPRAZ D 40MG CAPSULE Works

Domperidone is a dopamine antagonist that works by increasing the movement of the stomach and intestines, helping to relieve symptoms like nausea, vomiting, and bloating. Esomeprazole is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that reduces the production of stomach acid by blocking the proton pumps in the stomach lining, thus helping to treat conditions like acid reflux, GERD (gastroesophageal reflux disease), and ulcers. Together, they work synergistically to alleviate digestive discomfort, improve gastric motility, and reduce acid-related issues.

02. Is Sompraz D better than other heartburn medications like Zantac or Nexium?

When comparing Sompraz D with other heartburn medications like Zantac (ranitidine) and Nexium (Esomeprazole), there are a few factors to consider:

Mechanism of Action:
Sompraz D: Esomeprazole works by reducing stomach acid production, while Domperidone helps with gastric emptying and prevents nausea. The combination is particularly useful for people who suffer from both acid reflux and delayed gastric emptying.
Zantac (Ranitidine): Zantac is an H2 blocker that reduces acid production by blocking histamine receptors in the stomach. It works differently from PPIs like Esomeprazole and is usually less potent.
Nexium (Esomeprazole): Nexium is a PPI like Esomeprazole in Sompraz D, and it is typically used for reducing stomach acid production. It is generally more effective at suppressing acid than H2 blockers like Zantac.
Effectiveness:
Sompraz D may be more effective for people who experience both heartburn and gastrointestinal motility issues (delayed stomach emptying or nausea). The Domperidone component can be particularly beneficial in these cases.
Nexium is a stronger PPI and may provide more potent acid suppression than Zantac and is often used for conditions like GERD (gastroesophageal reflux disease).
Zantac may be effective for mild to moderate heartburn but typically doesn't suppress acid production as effectively as PPIs.
Side Effects:
Sompraz D: Esomeprazole can have side effects like headaches, diarrhea, and potential long-term risks if used for extended periods (e.g., osteoporosis, kidney issues). Domperidone may cause side effects like dry mouth, dizziness, or an increased risk of heart problems in certain people.
Zantac: While Zantac was commonly used for heartburn, recent concerns about its safety (due to potential links to cancer-causing substances) have led to its removal from the market in some regions.
Nexium: Similar to other PPIs, it may cause side effects like stomach infections, magnesium deficiency, and potential kidney problems with long-term use.
Target Use:
Sompraz D is often prescribed for people with more complex symptoms, such as those who experience both acid reflux and gastric motility issues.
Zantac is usually used for milder forms of heartburn, though it is being phased out in some places due to safety concerns.
Nexium is effective for long-term acid suppression and is used in treating conditions like GERD, ulcers, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.

Conclusion:

Sompraz D may be more suitable for individuals who need both acid suppression and help with gastric motility (like nausea or delayed stomach emptying).
Nexium is generally considered more effective for acid suppression than Zantac, making it a good choice for more severe or chronic heartburn.
Zantac, while effective for milder heartburn, has safety concerns and is no longer widely recommended.

Also, it is used in adults to manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (increased acid secretion in the stomach due to growth in pancreas resulting in abdominal pain, diarrhoea, gnawing or discomfort in upper abdomen, heartburn, nausea and vomiting).

OCID 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with history of allergic reactions to omeprazole or any other proton pump inhibitors (Ex. pantoprazole, lansoprazole, rabeprazole and esomeprazole).

Before taking OCID 20MG CAPSULE, tell your doctor if you have any severe liver problems, weight loss, swallowing problems, stomach pain or indigestion, osteoporosis (condition in which bones become weak and brittle), vitamin B12 deficiency, schedule for specific blood test (chromogranin A).

OCID 20MG CAPSULE can be used in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor. OCID 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) due to increased risk of fractures.

The most common side effects of taking OCID 20MG CAPSULE are headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About ADDPHOS GRANULES

ADDPHOS GRANULES contains Sodium acid phosphate which belongs to the group of medicines called Inorganic salts. It is used to manage hypophosphatemia (low blood phosphorous levels) and hypercalcemia (high blood calcium levels). It can also be used to manage phosphate depletion and calcium-based kidney stone.

ADDPHOS GRANULES should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function, congestive heart failure or high blood pressure. The safety of ADDPHOS GRANULES in pregnant and breastfeeding women has not been established. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ADDPHOS GRANULES should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. Inform your doctor if you experience any side effects after taking ADDPHOS GRANULES.
usesDetails:

To manage:

Hypophosphatemia
Hypercalcemia
Phosphate depletion
Calcium based kidney stone
mechanismOfAction:
How ADDPHOS GRANULES Works

ADDPHOS GRANULES work by decreasing calcium in blood in patients with hypercalcemia. It also works by binding to the calcium ions present in the gut and helps to manage kidney stones and the oral phosphate present in this medicine helps to correct hypophosphatemia (low blood phosphate levels).
usageDetails:
How to use ADDPHOS GRANULES

Take ADDPHOS GRANULES as advised by your physician. It should be taken with meals. This medicine should be emptied and dissolved in 2/3rd to 1 full glass of water. Stir briskly and swallow the contents immediately. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you based upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: PANTOSEC D SR Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE

PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

Uses Of PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Peptic ulcer

mechanismOfAction:
How PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE Works

PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, PANTOSEC D SR NEW CAPSULE it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

introduction:
Introduction About SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET

SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET contains Sodium Bicarbonate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antacids. It is used in the management of metabolic acidosis. Metabolic acidosis can be defined as a condition in which body fluids and tissues produce too much acid in the body. It can also be used to manage heartburn (a burning sensation in the chest) and indigestion.

Before taking SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high levels of sodium in the blood, peripheral oedema (swelling of body parts due to fluid retention), or if you are following a strict diet that contains low sodium. In patients with severe liver disease, kidney disease, breathing difficulties, or heart failure, SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET should be used with caution.

SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women unless clearly necessary. SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET is not recommended to be used by children. SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (those over the age of 75). Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET are hypernatremia (a high level of sodium in the blood), alkalosis (an increased alkaline substance in the blood), cellulitis (a bacterial skin infection), etc. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.
uses: Manage metabolic acidosis (increased production of acid in the body
Prevents acidity symptoms such as indigestion and heart burn
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET Works

SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET functions as an alkalizing agent by increasing plasma bicarbonate concentration, which raises the pH of urine and blood. As a result, it manages metabolic acidosis (increased production of acid in the body). It also works by neutralising the excessive production of stomach acid and increasing the pH value of stomach fluids. Thus, it relieves acidity symptoms.

Take SOBISIS EC 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET

LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET contains Levosulpiride which belongs to the group of medicines called Antipsychotic drugs. It is used in the management of depression and schizophrenia in adults.

Depression is a mood disorder characterized by persistent feeling of sadness, loss of interest, feeling guilty or worthless, attention impairment, lack of energy, suicidal thoughts and slow or abnormal physical movements.

Schizophrenia is a serious mental health disorder in which the individual interprets the reality in an abnormal way. It affects the thinking and behaviour of the person and causes symptoms such as long-lasting delusions, hallucinations, disorganized thinking, irrelevant speech, agitation, slow movements, unusual body postures and lack of interest/pleasure.

Before taking LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have epilepsy, any bleeding or any blockage or tear in the gut, mania or bipolar disorder (manic depression).

LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having cancer or tumours in the body. Do not take LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET are sleepiness, tiredness and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET

It is used in adults to manage:

Depression
Schizophrenia
mechanismOfAction:
How LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET Works

LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET is an antipsychotic medicine. It acts by increasing the levels of certain chemical messengers (such as serotonin) in the brain that can stabilize mood and mental health. As a result, it improves your mood and reduces the signs of depression. It can also control abnormal thoughts and behaviours and improves thinking abilities, behaviour and body movements.
usageDetails:
How to use LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET

Take LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking LEVIPRIDE 50MG TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About GELUSIL MPS ORIGINAL MINT FLAVOUR CHEWABLE TABLET

GELUSIL MPS Original Mint Flavour Chewable Tablet is an antacid which helps to provide relief from symptoms of hyperacidity (such as heartburn, epigastric discomfort, or their equivalents) associated with indigestion, peptic ulcer, gastritis, peptic esophagitis, and hiatus hernia. It also helps to provide relief from flatulence (gas). It contains activated dimethicone, magnesium hydroxide, dried aluminium hydroxide, magnesium aluminium silicate hydrate as active ingredients which helps to provide relief from indigestion and flatulence.

Aluminium Hydroxide reacts with hydrochloric acid (helps to digest food) in stomach which raises pH of the stomach and provides relief from hyperacidity (increased acid secretion in stomach). It also forms a protective covering in the stomach which reduces burning sensation and provides relief to it. Magnesium hydroxide also reacts with gastric hydrochloric acid which neutralizes stomach acid.

Always take GELUSIL MPS Original Mint Flavour Chewable Tablet as advised by your physician. Do not swallow the medicine. Chew One or two tablets for 30-60 min after meals or as directed by your physician. Do not exceed the recommended daily dose.

GELUSIL MPS Original Mint Flavour Chewable Tablet may cause diarrhea, dehydration, constipation, and/or musculoskeletal effects in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while taking GELUSIL MPS Original Mint Flavour Chewable Tablet.
