Introduction About RACIPER 20MG TABLET

RACIPER 20MG TABLET contains Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used for the management of Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) heartburn in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. RACIPER 20MG TABLET also helps in managing stomach ulcers or upper part of the gut (intestine) that are infected with Helicobacter pylori bacteria and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) medicines in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. It is also used to manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (too much acid produced in the stomach caused by a growth in the pancreas).

GERD is a disease where acid from the stomach escapes into the tube which connects your throat to your stomach (oesophagus) causing pain and inflammation.

RACIPER 20MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken in patients with severe kidney and liver failure. RACIPER 20MG TABLET should be taken only if considered clearly necessary by your doctor in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

RACIPER 20MG TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents aged less than 12 years. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking RACIPER 20MG TABLET are headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, constipation, flatulence, nausea and vomiting. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsens with time.

introduction:
Introduction About RANTAC DOM TABLET

RANTAC DOM TABLET is a combination of Domperidone and Ranitidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Histamine (H2) receptor blockers respectively. It is used to manage peptic ulcer (painful sores on gut linings), gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD; acid reflux), reflux esophagitis (inflammation of food pipe due to acid reflux) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

It can also be used to manage nausea and vomiting and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of the GI tract such as indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn. It can also manage acid reflux among patients undergoing anaesthesia or labour pain.

Before taking RANTAC DOM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any diabetes or any problems in your liver, kidney or heart. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage, tears or tumours in the gut as a precaution.

RANTAC DOM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with signs of GI bleeding (such as passing bloody stools). Consult your doctor before taking RANTAC DOM TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking RANTAC DOM TABLET are dry mouth, constipation, stomach pain and low sex drive. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How RANTAC DOM TABLET Works

RANTAC DOM TABLET contains two medicines namely domperidone and ranitidine. Domperidone stimulates the gut and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. These actions reduce the chances for acid reflux and manages the irritation of food pipe and other unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centres of the spinal cord and the brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting.

Ranitidine blocks the effects of certain chemicals in the gut (such as histamines) that increases stomach acid production. As a result, it heals the existing ulcers and manages them from becoming worse.
usageDetails:
How to use RANTAC DOM TABLET

Take RANTAC DOM TABLET 15-30 minutes before meals or as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking RANTAC DOM TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About INSTARAFT ORAL SUSPENSION

INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is used to manage gastrointestinal symptoms like acidity, acid reflux, heartburn and indigestion. It contains Calcium Carbonate, Sodium Alginate and Sodium Bicarbonate as active ingredients which works by forming a protective gel and foam (raft) over the walls of the stomach which acts as a barrier, preventing the stomach acid from flowing back into the esophagus, thus reducing symptoms of acid reflux.

Always take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension exactly as directed by your doctor. It can be taken after meals at bedtime. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any stomach inflammation, kidney problems, heart problems, dehydration or electrolyte imbalance. There should be a 2-hour gap between taking InstaRaft and any other medications.

INSTARAFT Oral Suspension can be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding women if advised by the physician. It can be administered to children aged 12 years or older if prescribed by the physician. Studies have shown that INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is generally safe and well-tolerated. However, consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects.

Uses Of INSTARAFT ORAL SUSPENSION
It is used to manage gastrointestinal symptoms like acidity, acid reflux, heartburn and indigestion.
mechanismOfAction:
How INSTARAFT ORAL SUSPENSION Works

INSTARAFT Oral Suspension contains three ingredients namely Sodium Alginate, Calcium Carbonate and Sodium Bicarbonate.

The sodium alginate present in the medicine forms an alginic acid gel (a gel form) with a near-neutral pH when it comes in contact with stomach acid. Sodium bicarbonate present in the medicine reacts with the gastric acid to produce carbon dioxide gas. This gas gets trapped in the alginic acid gel, turning it into a foam. This foam floats on top of the stomach contents, creating a "raft’ which acts as a barrier, preventing the stomach acid from flowing back into the esophagus, thus reducing symptoms of acid reflux.

The Calcium Carbonate present in the medicine interacts with sodium alginate and makes the foam raft stronger and more effective in maintaining its structure and position on top of the stomach contents. By doing so, INSTARAFT Oral Suspension provides a rapid and near-neutral pH environment in the stomach, leading to quick and effective relief from acidity, heartburn and indigestion.

faqs.answer: A: INSTARAFT Oral Suspension contains Calcium Carbonate, Sodium Alginate and Sodium Bicarbonate as active ingredients which works by forming a protective gel and foam (raft) over the walls of the stomach which acts as a barrier, preventing the stomach acid from flowing back into the esophagus, thus reducing symptoms of acid reflux

faqs.question: Q: What is the best time to take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: Take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension after meals at bedtime. However, your doctor is the right person to decide the correct time, dose and duration for you.

faqs.question: Q: How much to take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: Typically, INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is prescribed between 10-20ml after each meal of the day and at bedtime. It can be taken at a maximum of 4 times a day. However, this period can vary based on your age, body weight and health condition. Your doctor is the right person to decide the correct dose and duration for you.

faqs.question: Q: Who should not take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: Do not take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension without consulting your doctor if you are allergic to sodium alginate, sodium bicarbonate and calcium carbonate. Also, it is advisable to inform your doctor before taking INSTARAFT Oral Suspension if you have any stomach inflammation, kidney problems, heart problems, dehydration or electrolyte imbalance.

faqs.question: Q: What precautions must be followed while taking INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: Prior to the therapy, inform your doctor if you have any stomach inflammation, kidney problems, heart problems, dehydration or electrolyte imbalance. Inform your doctor about all the medicines that you currently take as a precaution. Do not take this medicine within 2 hours of taking other medicines as it could interfere with the action of some other medicines.

faqs.question: Q: Can INSTARAFT Oral Suspension be given to children?
faqs.answer: A: INSTARAFT Oral Suspension can be administered to children aged 12 years or older if prescribed by the physician. For children aged below 12 years, it is advisable to avoid the usage of INSTARAFT Oral Suspension, as there is no sufficient clinical trial evidence.

faqs.question: Q: Can INSTARAFT Oral Suspension be used during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: INSTARAFT Oral Suspension can be used during pregnancy if advised by the physician. It helps to get rid of acid reflux, heartburn and acidity caused during pregnancy.

faqs.question: Q: Can I take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension daily?
faqs.answer: A: Take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension exactly as prescribed by your physician. It can be taken daily for 7 days continuously. However, check with your physician, if you couldn’t notice any improvement even after using this medicine for 7 days.

faqs.question: Q: Can we use INSTARAFT Oral Suspension for a long-term?
faqs.answer: A: Take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension exactly for the specified duration mentioned by your physician. It can be taken daily for 7 days continuously. Avoid long-term usage of this medicine without doctor’s supervision, as it could disturb the electrolyte balance, increased blood sodium levels and affect the kidneys.

faqs.question: Q: How long does it take for INSTARAFT Oral Suspension to show results?
faqs.answer: A: INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is claimed to show results within 3 minutes of administration and the effects may last until 4 hours.

faqs.question: Q: When can I stop taking INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: You can stop using INSTARAFT Oral Suspension after 7 days. However, if you feel the need of using this medicine for a few days, check with your doctor.

faqs.question: Q: What are the side effects of taking INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: Studies have shown that INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is generally safe and well-tolerated. However, consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects.

introduction:
Introduction About PANTOCID DSR CAPSULE

Pantocid DSR Capsule is a medication commonly prescribed to manage gastrointestinal issues like acid reflux, heartburn, and ulcers. It contains two active ingredients: Pantoprazole and Domperidone, which work together to reduce acid secretion and improve digestion.

Pantocid DSR Capsule helps neutralize stomach acid and facilitates the smooth passage of gas, alleviating stomach discomfort. It should be taken without food, according to the dosage and duration prescribed by your doctor. The recommended dose will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medication. Continue taking Pantocid DSR Capsule for the full duration as advised by your doctor. Stopping management prematurely may cause your symptoms to return or worsen your condition. Inform your doctor about all other medications you are taking, as some may interact with or be affected by this medicine.

Common side effects of Pantocid DSR Capsule include headache, dry mouth, dizziness, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, weakness, constipation, gas, rash, vomiting and fatigue. These side effects are generally temporary and tend to go away on their own over time. However, if you are concerned about any of these effects, it is important to contact your doctor immediately. This medication can cause dizziness and drowsiness, so it is advisable to avoid activities that require full attention, such as driving, until you know how it affects you. It is also best to refrain from consuming alcohol while taking Pantocid DSR Capsule, as it may intensify drowsiness. For better results, lifestyle changes such as drinking cold milk and avoiding hot beverages like tea and coffee, as well as spicy foods and chocolate, can be helpful.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver problems or heart problems. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking Pantocid DSR.

mechanismOfAction:
How PANTOCID DSR CAPSULE Works

Pantoprazole decreases the production of gastric acid, which helps in healing acid-related damage like ulcers, and it can reduce symptoms of heartburn and acid reflux (GERD). Domperidone works by enhancing the stomach's ability to empty and reducing delayed gastric emptying. It helps with symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, and fullness after eating.

Together, Pantocid DSR relieves heartburn, reduces acid reflux, and addresses nausea and bloating caused by delayed stomach emptying. This combination is often prescribed for conditions like GERD, gastric ulcers, and dyspepsia (indigestion).

name: SODICAB 500 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About SODICAB 500 TABLET

SODICAB 500 TABLET contains Sodium Bicarbonate, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antacids. It is used in the management of metabolic acidosis. Metabolic acidosis can be defined as a condition in which body fluids and tissues produce too much acid in the body. It can also be used to manage heartburn (a burning sensation in the chest) and indigestion.

Before taking SODICAB 500 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have high levels of sodium in the blood, peripheral oedema (swelling of body parts due to fluid retention), or if you are following a strict diet that contains low sodium. In patients with severe liver disease, kidney disease, breathing difficulties, or heart failure, SODICAB 500 TABLET should be used with caution.

SODICAB 500 TABLET is not recommended for use by pregnant women unless clearly necessary. SODICAB 500 TABLET is not recommended to be used by children. SODICAB 500 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (those over the age of 75). Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking SODICAB 500 TABLET are hypernatremia (a high level of sodium in the blood), alkalosis (an increased alkaline substance in the blood), cellulitis (a bacterial skin infection), etc. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse or persist.

Prevents acidity symptoms such as indigestion and heart burn

mechanismOfAction:
How SODICAB 500 TABLET Works

SODICAB 500 TABLET functions as an alkalizing agent by increasing plasma bicarbonate concentration, which raises the pH of urine and blood. As a result, it manages metabolic acidosis (increased production of acid in the body). It also works by neutralising the excessive production of stomach acid and increasing the pH value of stomach fluids. Thus, it relieves acidity symptoms.

Take SODICAB 500 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking SODICAB 500 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Antibiotics (medicines used to manage bacterial infections) Ex. rifampicin, tetracycline
Antifungals (medicines used to manage fungal infections) Ex. ketoconazole

Overdosage:

It contains activated dimethicone, dried aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide and sorbitol as an active ingredient which works by neutralizing the excess acid in the stomach.

Activated dimethicone has antiflatulent and anti-bloating properties which eliminates the trapped gas in the stomach and intestine, thus relieves bloating. Take Gelusil MPS Original Mint Flavour Sugar Free Liquid as advised by the physician. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage. introduction:
Introduction About RANTAC MINT INFANT SYRUP

RANTAC MINT INFANT SYRUP contains Ranitidine which belongs to the group of medicines called H2 receptor antagonists. It is used in adults and children (3 to 18 years old) to heal and stop ulcers in the stomach or duodenum (part of the gut it empties into) and indigestion, dyspepsia or heartburn (problems caused by acid in the food pipe or too much acid in the stomach, causing pain or discomfort).

RANTAC MINT INFANT SYRUP is also used in adults to help clear up any stomach infection when taken with antibiotics, to stop stomach ulcers when they are a side effect of some medicines, to stop ulcers from bleeding and to stop acid reflux from the stomach while under anaesthetic during an operation.

Avoid smoking during management with RANTAC MINT INFANT SYRUP. Before taking RANTAC MINT INFANT SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have stomach cancer, liver, kidney, lung or immunity problems, acute porphyria (a rare blood disorder) or diabetes.

RANTAC MINT INFANT SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless your doctor finds it essential. For children (3 to 11 years old), your doctor will determine a proper dose depending on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

The most common side effects of taking RANTAC MINT INFANT SYRUP are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain and headache. Call your doctor if the symptoms do not improve or worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About P PPI 40 TABLET

P PPI 40 TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking P PPI 40 TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking P PPI 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How P PPI 40 TABLET Works

P PPI 40 TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why P PPI 40 TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
P PPI 40 TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take P PPI 40 TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

Potent and Long-Lasting Acid Suppression: P PPI 40 TABLET contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively blocks the final step of stomach acid production, providing stronger and longer-lasting relief from symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, and indigestion compared to H2 blockers or antacids.
Comprehensive Symptom Relief and Healing: It not only relieves discomfort from acid-related conditions but also promotes healing of stomach and duodenal ulcers, and helps manage more severe conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.

Well-Studied and Trusted: Pantoprazole, the active ingredient, is widely used and supported by extensive clinical experience, ensuring both efficacy and safety for a broad range of patients.

introduction:
Introduction About REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE

REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation designed to support stomach comfort and digestive balance. It contains Rabeprazole and Domperidone, two clinically studied components that reduce excessive stomach acid and support smoother digestion. This combination is widely recommended for individuals experiencing symptoms linked to acidity, heartburn, or discomfort after meals.

Along management with REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE , try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Some individuals may experience mild effects such as headache, dry mouth, abdominal discomfort, constipation, dizziness, or nausea. These effects are generally temporary. If they persist, contact your healthcare provider for guidance.

Store REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep out of reach of children and pets.

Used to support stomach comfort and digestive balance
mechanismOfAction:
How REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE Works

REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE works through a dual mechanism. Rabeprazole acts by reducing acid secretion at its source, ensuring a well-balanced gastric environment. Meanwhile, Domperidone restores the normal movement of the stomach and intestines, managing acid backflow and improving food passage for a more comfortable digestive experience.

Dual Mechanism Explained: Acid Control and Gut Movement

1. Acid Control through Rabeprazole:

Rabeprazole belongs to the class of proton pump modulators that reduce acid secretion at its source. Once absorbed in the intestine, it reaches the acid-producing parietal cells in the stomach lining. Here, it selectively and irreversibly binds to the H/K ATPase enzyme system, also known as the proton pump, the final step in acid secretion. By blocking the hydrogen ion exchange process, Rabeprazole manages excessive acid release into the stomach lumen, thereby increasing gastric pH. It acts faster than many other molecules in its class due to its ability to activate at higher pH levels, efficiently reducing acid production even at minimal acidity. This long-acting acid suppression helps relieve common signs of acidity and promotes a stable digestive environment.

2. Gut Movement through Domperidone:

Domperidone supports the mechanical side of digestion by enhancing gastric motility. It selectively blocks dopamine D2 receptors found in the upper gastrointestinal tract, which normally act to slow stomach contractions. By inhibiting these receptors, Domperidone increases the tone of the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), facilitates faster gastric emptying, and decreases the backward flow of food and acid into the esophagus. It also improves intestinal motion, reducing sensations of bloating, heaviness, or delayed digestion after meals, particularly useful for individuals who experience reflux linked to slow gastric transit.

3. Integrated Digestive Action:

Together, these two mechanisms form a dual-action system. Rabeprazole ensures acid stability, while Domperidone optimizes movement and clearance. This combination supports digestive comfort by minimizing acid build-up while promoting efficient passage of food through the stomach and intestines. It is particularly suited for individuals who face recurring symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, or post-meal fullness due to poor gastric motility or high acid output. This science-backed synergy makes REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE effective for holistic digestive maintenance under medical supervision.

“Quick Fact Highlights” explaining why the dual combination is clinically valued
Clinically synergistic formulation: The combination of Rabeprazole (20 mg) and Domperidone (30 mg SR) works through a dual mechanism, controlling stomach acid while improving gut motility providing faster and more comprehensive relief from acid discomfort
Science-backed acid regulation: Rabeprazole acts at the final step of acid production by blocking the H/K ATPase enzyme, also known as the proton pump. This action significantly reduces acid secretion and maintains optimal pH levels in the stomach for prolonged comfort
Enhanced digestion support: Domperidone increases the movement of the stomach and upper intestinal tract, promoting quicker stomach emptying and minimizing post-meal bloating, nausea, and reflux symptoms
Faster symptom control: Rabeprazole has one of the quickest onset times among proton pump inhibitors, beginning to act within 1 hour of ingestion, offering prompt relief in cases of severe acidity and heartburn
Persistent gastric balance: The sustained-release form of Domperidone maintains smooth motility throughout the day, managing the recurrence of reflux episodes and late-night acidity, a key benefit for individuals with night-time acid reflux or delayed digestion
Improved patient quality of life: This dual approach relieves not just acid discomfort but also digestive sluggishness, making it beneficial for individuals who experience post-meal heaviness, belching, or regurgitation along with acidity
Clinically preferred for complex acid disorders: Physicians often recommend this combination when single-drug therapy (acid suppressants alone) fails to improve acid-related conditions or reflux-associated nausea
Well-tolerated and safety-monitored: The formulation has a proven safety profile when used as prescribed, with side effects such as mild headache or dizziness typically resolving with continued use

The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption

Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision

Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. How to use REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE

Take the capsule before meals, preferably in the morning, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Swallow the capsule whole with water without crushing or chewing. Regular use under professional guidance ensures optimal results.

1. How to Take REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE Safely

Swallow the capsule whole with water without biting, breaking, or crushing it. The capsule should not be chewed as it is designed for delayed release. It is best taken on an empty stomach for optimal absorption and faster onset of effect. Avoid taking it with caffeinated or acidic drinks.

2. Dosage and Duration

The dosage and duration depend on your medical condition, age, and response to therapy. Most individuals experience benefits with once-daily use, but in some cases, the doctor may recommend twice-daily administration. Continue the capsule for the prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve early.

3. Dosage Guidelines for Adults and Elderly
For most adult users, the typical dosage is one REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption
Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision
Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. Extra caution is advised in those with osteoporosis or history of cardiac arrhythmia, as Domperidone may influence heart rhythm in predisposed individuals

More Information
Why REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE is Doctor-Recommended for “Digestive Balance.”

Digestive discomfort caused by acidity and reflux is often linked to two simultaneous problems excess acid formation and slowed stomach movement.REBOZEN DSR CAPSULE addresses both through a clinically trusted dual mechanism combining Rabeprazole and Domperidone. Doctors recommend this capsule because it supports digestive balance by managing acid levels and enhancing gastric motility, offering smoother stomach function throughout the day.

“Did You Know?” Sidebar: Use small fact highlights like: “Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to late-night meals. Following early dinner routines may reduce reflux frequency”
Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to nighttime eating habits, eating late dinners or snacks within two hours of bedtime significantly increases reflux risk. Having meals earlier in the evening can reduce acid backflow and discomfort.
Meal timing matters: Studies show that eating dinner 3–4 hours before sleep supports better digestion and reduces nighttime acid episodes. Early dining allows the stomach to empty properly before lying down.
Late-night meals affect sleep and metabolism: Research indicates that those who regularly eat after 9 p.m. experience disrupted sleep patterns, slower calorie burning, and more frequent heartburn sensations compared to early eaters.
Fast eating can upset digestive balance: People who eat quickly swallow more air, which increases pressure in the stomach and raises the chance of acid discomfort. Chewing food slowly and mindfully can reduce symptoms and aid smoother digestion.
Simple posture shifts help: Standing or staying upright after meals even for 15–20 minutes can minimize reflux frequency and relieve heaviness. Avoid lying flat immediately after eating.
Diet quality counts: Frequent consumption of spicy, oily, or fried foods can raise stomach acid levels. Choosing gentle foods like oatmeal, bananas, and green vegetables can maintain a neutral digestive pH.
Hydration supports healthy acid balance: Drinking plain water throughout the day dilutes acid concentration naturally. However, sipping slowly instead of gulping helps avoid trapped air and bloating.

introduction:
Introduction About ACILOC 300MG TABLET

ACILOC 300MG TABLET contains Ranitidine which belongs to the group of medicines called H2 receptor antagonists. It is used in the management of intestinal, benign and post-operative ulcers. Peptic or intestinal ulcers are open sores that develop on the inside lining of your stomach and the upper part of your small intestine, causing stomach pain.

ACILOC 300MG TABLET is also used to manage reflux oesophagitis (inflammation of lower food pipe due to backflow of acidic stomach contents) and Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome (small tumour in the first part of your intestine due to excessive gastrin secretion).

Your doctor may occasionally perform tests to make sure ACILOC 300MG TABLET is working and to manage side effects. Visit your doctor routinely for a check-up.

Avoid smoking during the management with ACILOC 300MG TABLET, as it may delay healing or worsen the ulcers. Before taking ACILOC 300MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach cancer, kidney, lung or immunity problems, porphyria (rare blood disorder) or diabetes.

ACILOC 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless your doctor finds it essential. For children, your doctor will determine a proper dose depending on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Contact your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About SUCRAL O SUSPENSION

SUCRAL O SUSPENSION is a combination of Oxetacaine and Sucralfate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anesthetic Antacids and Ulcer Protectives respectively. It is used to manage stomach ulcers, acidity and heartburn. It can also be used to manage inflammation of gut caused due to other reasons apart from ulcer (such as H. pylori infection).

SUCRAL O SUSPENSION should be taken at least 1 hour before meals. Along with the management, eat simple foods and avoid consumption of alcohol. Do not take other antacid medications along with SUCRAL O SUSPENSION without consulting your doctor as it may reduce the effectiveness of this medicine.

Before taking SUCRAL O SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, thyroid problems or liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or obstruction in the gut or having delayed gastric emptying due to any gut surgery.

SUCRAL O SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effect of taking SUCRAL O SUSPENSION is constipation. Consult your doctor if this symptom troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How SUCRAL O SUSPENSION Works

SUCRAL O SUSPENSION contains two medicines namely sucralfate and oxetacaine. Sucralfate is an ulcer protective agent. It forms a protective layer over the ulcer lesions, giving it a sustained protection against the penetration of stomach acid and other irritants or enzymes (such as alcohol, pepsin and bile). This lessens the chances of further tissue damage which ultimately manages the exacerbation of ulcers lesions.

Oxetacaine is a local anesthetic agent. Following oral administration, it reduces pain sensation from the inflamed gut tissues (or ulcer tissues). Collectively, this medicine reduce the unpleasant symptoms of the digestive tract such as acidity, heartburn and stomach ulcers.

introduction:
Introduction About NEXPRO RD 40MG CAPSULE

Nexpro RD 40mg Capsule is a highly effective medication used for the management of acid reflux, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and stomach ulcers. The active ingredient, Domperidone and Esomeprazole, helps to reduce stomach acid and promotes healing in the digestive system.

Nexpro RD 40 Capsule should be taken without food, following the dosage and duration prescribed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medication. It is important to continue taking the medicine for the full duration recommended by your doctor. Stopping management prematurely may cause your symptoms to return or worsen your condition. Be sure to inform your healthcare team about any other medications you are taking, as some may interact with this medication.

Common side effect of this medication includes headache, abdominal pain, and diarrhea, flatulence, dryness in the mouth. Most of these side effects are temporary and typically improve with time. However, if you are concerned about any side effects, contact your doctor immediately. This medication may also cause drowsiness and dizziness, so refrain from driving or engaging in activities that require focus until you are aware of how it affects you. It is best to avoid alcohol while taking this medicine, as it can increase drowsiness. Making lifestyle changes, such as drinking cold milk and avoiding hot tea, coffee, spicy foods, or chocolate, can help improve your results.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Additionally, let your doctor know if you have any liver conditions so they can determine the appropriate dose for you.

How NEXPRO RD 40MG CAPSULE Works

Nexpro RD 40mg capsule contains two active ingredients: Domperidone and Esomeprazole. Domperidone helps by increasing the movement of the stomach and intestines, which helps relieve symptoms like nausea and vomiting. Esomeprazole reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach, helping to treat acid reflux, heartburn, and ulcers. Together, these medicines work to improve digestion, reduce acid-related problems, and prevent discomfort in the stomach and esophagus.

Cisapride: Another prokinetic, though it's less commonly used due to potential side effects.

3. Antacids:

Ranitidine: Though now less commonly used due to safety concerns, it's an H2 blocker that reduces acid production.
Antacids like Tums, Mylanta, or Gelusil: Provide immediate relief for acid reflux but do not address long-term acid reduction.

4. Herbal Alternatives:

Ginger: Known for reducing nausea and improving digestion.
Chamomile: Can help soothe an irritated stomach.
Licorice root: Sometimes used to soothe stomach ulcers and esophageal issues.

If you are looking for a specific alternative for your condition, it would be best to consult with your doctor to choose the most appropriate medication or management, as they can vary in effectiveness and safety based on individual health conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About REBOZEN SL CAPSULE

REBOZEN SL CAPSULE is a combination of Levosulpiride and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine D2 antagonists and Proton-pump inhibitors respectively. REBOZEN SL CAPSULE is indicated for the management of Gastro-esophageal reflux disease (GERD). GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation and inflammation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

REBOZEN SL CAPSULE can also be used to manage peptic ulcer (painful sores in the gut), Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumors in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid), functional dyspepsia (recurrent signs and symptoms of indigestion without an obvious cause) and diabetic gastroparesis (delayed gastric emptying caused due to diabetes).

Take REBOZEN SL CAPSULE preferably on an empty stomach. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking REBOZEN SL CAPSULE as it could potentiate the CNS depressive side effects.

Patients receiving long-term management (>1 year) with REBOZEN SL CAPSULE should be kept on regular surveillance because it can increase the risk of bone fracture (i.e., in the hip, wrist or spine) which is more predominant in the patients having osteoporosis or taking corticosteroids.

Before taking REBOZEN SL CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any heart, kidney or liver disease as a precaution. REBOZEN SL CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

The most common side effects of taking REBOZEN SL CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea, constipation and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How REBOZEN SL CAPSULE Works

REBOZEN SL CAPSULE reduces stomach ulcers, nausea and acid reflux, where rabeprazole acts by inhibiting the secretions of stomach acid by blocking the proton pump (H+ K+ ATPase) at the secretory surface of gastric parietal cells and levosulpiride acts by blocking the dopamine D2 receptors in the CTZ (area in medulla oblongata that causes vomiting when stimulated) and in the gut, thus facilitating the movement of food from the stomach into the intestines followed by healing of ulcers or inflammatory lesions in the stomach and in the esophagus.

REBOZEN SL CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with heart disease. Consult your doctor before taking REBOZEN SL CAPSULE.

Others

REBOZEN SL CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have:

Parkinson’s disease
History of epilepsy
Neuroleptic malignant syndrome (a CNS disorder characterized by high fever, stiffness of the muscles, altered mental status (paranoid behavior) and autonomic dysfunction)
Breast cancer (with high levels of prolactin in the body)

Before taking REBOZEN SL CAPSULE, inform your physician if you: 

Have a tumor in the stomach or breast
Have bleeding or perforation of the gastrointestinal tract
Have or at risk of developing vitamin-B12 deficiency
Had developed any skin reaction following management with similar medicines that can reduce stomach acid
Are due to have a specific blood test (Chromogranin A)
Have osteoporosis
Are a smoker
Have porphyria (a rare blood disorder)
Have alcohol intoxication (drinking large amount of alcohol in short period)
Have or had phaeochromocytoma (tumors of adrenal gland) in the past
Have or had prolactinoma (a noncancerous tumor of pituitary gland) in the past
Have hypokalemia (decreased potassium levels in blood)
Have neuroendocrine tumor (tumors in neuroendocrine cells)
Have mania or other mental disorders
Have painful breasts

Use in pediatrics:

REBOZEN SL CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking REBOZEN SL CAPSULE.

Use in geriatrics:

REBOZEN SL CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking REBOZEN SL CAPSULE. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About PANTOCID 40MG TABLET

PANTOCID 40MG TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking PANTOCID 40MG TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking PANTOCID 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How PANTOCID 40MG TABLET Works

PANTOCID 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why PANTOCID 40MG TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
PANTOCID 40MG TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take PANTOCID 40MG TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

More Information
01.What makes PANTOCID 40MG TABLET a preferred choice over other medications?
Potent and Long-Lasting Acid Suppression: PANTOCID 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively blocks the final step of stomach acid production, providing stronger and longer-lasting relief from symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, and indigestion compared to H2 blockers or antacids.
Comprehensive Symptom Relief and Healing: It not only relieves discomfort from acid-related conditions but also promotes healing of stomach and duodenal ulcers, and helps manage more severe conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
Lowering with Painkiller Use: PANTOCID 40MG TABLET is recommended for lowering stomach ulcers and acidity in patients who require long-term use of painkillers (NSAIDs), a benefit not offered by all acid-reducing medicines.
Convenient Once-Daily Dosing: Its long duration of action allows for once-daily dosing, making it easier for patients to adhere to treatment and maintain consistent acid control.
Favorable Tolerability Profile: Most side effects are mild and temporary, such as headache, nausea, or diarrhea. Serious side effects are rare when used as directed, and the risk of complications can be minimized with appropriate monitoring.
Well-Studied and Trusted: Pantoprazole, the active ingredient, is widely used and supported by extensive clinical experience, ensuring both efficacy and safety for a broad range of patients.

These advantages make PANTOCID 40MG TABLET a reliable and effective option for both short-term relief and long-term management of acid-related disorders, often outperforming less potent or shorter-acting alternatives.

introduction:
Introduction About DIOVOL MINT FLAVOUR SUSPENSION

Diovol Suspension is an antacid and antiflatulent, used to relieve symptoms of hyperacidity such as heartburn and epigastric discomfort. It is also used to relieve flatulence (gas). It contains Activated dimethicone, Dried aluminium hydroxide, Magnesium hydroxide and Sorbitol as active ingredients which work by neutralizing the excess acid in the stomach.

Activated dimethicone it has anti-flatulent and anti-bloating properties which eliminate the trapped gas in the stomach and intestine, thus relieving bloating. Dried aluminium hydroxide and magnesium hydroxide both antacids work by neutralizing the stomach's acid and by managing pepsin, a proteolytic enzyme and sorbitol solution acts as a sweetening agent. Thus, it provides quick and long-lasting relief from acidity, heartburn and gas.

Always take Diovol Suspension as advised by the physician. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage.

Diovol Suspension may cause diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting and headache in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while taking it.

Introduction About DYNACID SUGAR FREE AMERICAN ICE CREAM FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION

DYNACID SUGAR FREE AMERICAN ICE CREAM FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION is a combination of Aluminium hydroxide, Magnesium hydroxide, and Simethicone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antacids and Antifoaming agents. It is indicated for the relief of indigestion (dyspepsia), heartburn, and flatulence.

DYNACID SUGAR FREE AMERICAN ICE CREAM FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use if you have kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or might become pregnant, or are breastfeeding before using DYNACID SUGAR FREE AMERICAN ICE CREAM FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION.

DYNACID SUGAR FREE AMERICAN ICE CREAM FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in children aged 2 to 18 years of age. Your child’s doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, disease condition, and body weight.

The most common side effects of taking DYNACID SUGAR FREE AMERICAN ICE CREAM FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION are diarrhea, stomach pain, bloating, vomiting, indigestion, heartburn, upset stomach, constipation, loss of appetite, and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ESOKEM 20MG TABLET

ESOKEM 20MG TABLET contains Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used for the management of Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) heartburn in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. ESOKEM 20MG TABLET also helps in managing stomach ulcers or upper part of the gut (intestine) that are infected with Helicobacter pylori bacteria and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) medicines in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. It is also used to manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (too much acid produced in the stomach caused by a growth in the pancreas).

GERD is a disease where acid from the stomach escapes into the tube which connects your throat to your stomach (oesophagus) causing pain and inflammation.

ESOKEM 20MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken in patients with severe kidney and liver failure. ESOKEM 20MG TABLET should be taken only if considered clearly necessary by your doctor in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

ESOKEM 20MG TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents aged less than 12 years. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking ESOKEM 20MG TABLET are headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, constipation, flatulence, nausea and vomiting. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsens with time.

introduction:
Introduction About ESOFINE 40MG TABLET

ESOFINE 40MG TABLET contains Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used for the management of Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) heartburn in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. ESOFINE 40MG TABLET also helps in managing stomach ulcers or upper part of the gut (intestine) that are infected with Helicobacter pylori bacteria and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) medicines in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. It is also used to manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (too much acid produced in the stomach caused by a growth in the pancreas).

GERD is a disease where acid from the stomach escapes into the tube which connects your throat to your stomach (oesophagus) causing pain and inflammation.

ESOFINE 40MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken in patients with severe kidney and liver failure. ESOFINE 40MG TABLET should be taken only if considered clearly necessary by your doctor in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

ESOFINE 40MG TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents aged less than 12 years. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking ESOFINE 40MG TABLET are headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, constipation, flatulence, nausea and vomiting. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsens with time.

How ESOFINE 40MG TABLET Works

ESOFINE 40MG TABLET is a proton pump inhibitor that suppresses gastric acid secretion by specific inhibition of enzymes in the stomach cell. It hence reduces gastric acidity by blocking the final step in acid production and helps in relief of acid related indigestion and heartburn.

Others

Have ever had a skin reaction after taking medicine to manage acidity
Are going to have a specific blood test (Chromogranin A)
Are losing a lot of weight without reason
Have problems swallowing
Have stomach pain or indigestion
Pass black stools (blood-stained faeces)
Skin rashes especially after getting exposed in sun
Have joint pains

Use in geriatrics:

ESOFINE 40MG TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients (65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking ESOFINE 40MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About RANITIN 300 TABLET

RANITIN 300 TABLET contains Ranitidine which belongs to the group of medicines called H2 receptor antagonists. It is used in the management of intestinal, benign and post-operative ulcers. Peptic or intestinal ulcers are open sores that develop on the inside lining of your stomach and the upper part of your small intestine, causing stomach pain.

RANITIN 300 TABLET is also used to manage reflux oesophagitis (inflammation of lower food pipe due to backflow of acidic stomach contents) and Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome (small tumour in the first part of your intestine due to excessive gastrin secretion).

Your doctor may occasionally perform tests to make sure RANITIN 300 TABLET is working and to manage side effects. Visit your doctor routinely for a check-up.

Avoid smoking during the management with RANITIN 300 TABLET, as it may delay healing or worsen the ulcers. Before taking RANITIN 300 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach cancer, kidney, lung or immunity problems, porphyria (rare blood disorder) or diabetes.

RANITIN 300 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless your doctor finds it essential. For children, your doctor will determine a proper dose depending on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Contact your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms worsen.

Introduction About LANZOPRAX KID 15MG TABLET

LANZOPRAX KID 15MG TABLET contains Lansoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton Pump Inhibitors. It is used in the management of intestinal and peptic (stomach) ulcers. Peptic or intestinal ulcers are open sores that form on the inside lining of your stomach and the upper part of your small intestine, causing stomach pain.

LANZOPRAX KID 15MG TABLET is also used to manage reflux oesophagitis (inflammation of lower food pipe due to backflow of acidic stomach material) and Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome (small tumour in the first part of your bowel due to excessive gastrin secretion).

Before taking LANZOPRAX KID 15MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver disease, phenylketonuria, osteoporosis or if you are about to have a specific blood test (Chromogranin A). LANZOPRAX KID 15MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. LANZOPRAX KID 15MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children.

Your doctor may perform an additional examination (endoscopy) to diagnose your condition or exclude malignant disease and regular blood tests to monitor your levels of magnesium. The most common side effects of taking LANZOPRAX KID 15MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, diarrhea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms gets worse over time.

name: Auxisoda Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AUXISODA TABLET

Auxisoda Tablet is an alkalizer used to manage indigestion, acidity, and metabolic acidosis (a condition in which the acid amount in body fluid is increased) due to severe kidney disorder, uncontrolled diabetes, severe lactic acidosis, or severe dehydration. It is also a urine alkalizing agent. It contains Sodium Bicarbonate as an active ingredient raises blood pH and decreases acidosis.

Sodium bicarbonate works by increasing plasma bicarbonate levels, which buffers excess hydrogen ion concentration and increases the pH and hence relieving symptoms of acidity and metabolic acidosis.

Always take Auxisoda Tablet as directed by your doctor. Swallow the tablet as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the tablet. Take it one to four times daily (for moderate metabolic acidosis). Do not exceed the daily recommended dosages.

Auxisoda Tablet is very less likely to cause any side effects but consult your doctor immediately in case you experience any side effects or allergic reaction after taking this medication.

introduction:
Introduction About SUCRAFIL O GEL

SUCRAFIL O GEL is a combination of Oxetacaine and Sucralfate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anesthetic Antacids and Ulcer Protectives respectively. It is used to manage stomach ulcers, acidity and heartburn. It can also be used to manage inflammation of gut caused due to other reasons apart from ulcer (such as H. pylori infection).

SUCRAFIL O GEL should be taken at least 1 hour before meals. Along with the management, eat simple foods and avoid consumption of alcohol. Do not take other antacid medications along with SUCRAFIL O GEL without consulting your doctor as it may reduce the effectiveness of this medicine.

Before taking SUCRAFIL O GEL inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, thyroid problems or liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or obstruction in the gut or having delayed gastric emptying due to any gut surgery.

SUCRAFIL O GEL is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effect of taking SUCRAFIL O GEL is constipation. Consult your doctor if this symptom troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How SUCRAFIL O GEL Works

SUCRAFIL O GEL contains two medicines namely sucralfate and oxetacaine. Sucralfate is an ulcer protective agent. It forms a protective layer over the ulcer lesions, giving it a sustained protection against the penetration of stomach acid and other irritants or enzymes (such as alcohol, pepsin and bile). This lessens the chances of further tissue damage which ultimately manages the exacerbation of ulcers lesions.

Oxetacaine is a local anesthetic agent. Following oral administration, it reduces pain sensation from the inflamed gut tissues (or ulcer tissues). Collectively, this medicine reduce the unpleasant symptoms of the digestive tract such as acidity, heartburn and stomach ulcers.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: RANITIN 150 Tablet 40's
introduction:
Introduction About RANITIN 150 TABLET

RANITIN 150 TABLET contains Ranitidine which belongs to the group of medicines called H2 receptor antagonists. It is used in the management of intestinal, benign and post-operative ulcers. Peptic or intestinal ulcers are open sores that develop on the inside lining of your stomach and the upper part of your small intestine, causing stomach pain.

RANITIN 150 TABLET is also used to manage reflux oesophagitis (inflammation of lower food pipe due to backflow of acidic stomach contents) and Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome (small tumour in the first part of your intestine due to excessive gastrin secretion).

Your doctor may occasionally perform tests to make sure RANITIN 150 TABLET is working and to manage side effects. Visit your doctor routinely for a check-up.

Avoid smoking during the management with RANITIN 150 TABLET, as it may delay healing or worsen the ulcers. Before taking RANITIN 150 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach cancer, kidney, lung or immunity problems, porphyria (rare blood disorder) or diabetes.

RANITIN 150 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women unless your doctor finds it essential. For children, your doctor will determine a proper dose depending on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Contact your doctor if you experience any side effects or if any of the symptoms worsen.

Peptic or intestinal ulcers are open sores that form on the inside lining of your stomach and the upper part of your small intestine, causing stomach pain.

LAN 30MG CAPSULE is also used to manage reflux oesophagitis (inflammation of lower food pipe due to backflow of acidic stomach material) and Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome (small tumour in the first part of your bowel due to excessive gastrin secretion).

Before taking LAN 30MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have severe liver disease, phenylketonuria, osteoporosis or if you are about to have a specific blood test (Chromogranin A). LAN 30MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. LAN 30MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children.

Your doctor may perform an additional examination (endoscopy) to diagnose your condition or exclude malignant disease and regular blood tests to monitor your levels of magnesium. The most common side effects of taking LAN 30MG CAPSULE are dizziness, nausea, headache, diarrhea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms gets worse over time.

introduction:
Introduction About RABEKIND 20MG TABLET

RABEKIND 20MG TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take RABEKIND 20MG TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking RABEKIND 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take RABEKIND 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking RABEKIND 20MG TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking RABEKIND 20MG TABLET.

Manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How RABEKIND 20MG TABLET Works

RABEKIND 20MG TABLET is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.
usageDetails:
How to use RABEKIND 20MG TABLET

Take RABEKIND 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken in the mornings or at any time of the day before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Neopride Total 40mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET

NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET is a combination of Levosulpiride and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine D2 antagonists and Proton-pump inhibitors respectively. NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET is indicated for the management of Gastro-esophageal reflux disease (GERD). GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation and inflammation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET can also be used to manage peptic ulcer (painful sores in the gut), Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumors in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid), functional dyspepsia (recurrent signs and symptoms of indigestion without an obvious cause) and diabetic gastroparesis (delayed gastric emptying caused due to diabetes).

Take NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET preferably on an empty stomach. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET as it could potentiate the CNS depressive side effects.

Patients receiving long-term management (>1 year) with NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET should be kept on regular surveillance because it can increase the risk of bone fracture (i.e., in the hip, wrist or spine) which is more predominant in the patients having osteoporosis or taking corticosteroids.

Before taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any heart, kidney or liver disease as a precaution. NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

The most common side effects of taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea, constipation and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET Works

NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET reduces stomach ulcers, nausea and acid reflux, where rabeprazole acts by inhibiting the secretions of stomach acid by blocking the proton pump (H+ K+ ATPase) at the secretory surface of gastric parietal cells and levosulpiride acts by blocking the dopamine D2 receptors in the CTZ (area in medulla oblongata that causes vomiting when stimulated) and in the gut, thus facilitating the movement of food from the stomach into the intestines followed by healing of ulcers or inflammatory lesions in the stomach and in the esophagus.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness, drowsiness or sleepiness after taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET.

NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET.
NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with a previous history of liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET.
Do not take NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to Levosulpiride, Rabeprazole or other proton-pump inhibitors (Ex. pantoprazole, omeprazole, lansoprazole).
NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with asthma or other respiratory diseases. Consult your doctor before taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET.
NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with heart disease. Consult your doctor before taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET.

Others

NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Parkinson’s disease
History of epilepsy
Neuroleptic malignant syndrome (a CNS disorder characterized by high fever, stiffness of the muscles, altered mental status (paranoid behavior) and autonomic dysfunction)
Breast cancer (with high levels of prolactin in the body)

Before taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET, inform your physician if you: 

Have a tumor in the stomach or breast
Have bleeding or perforation of the gastrointestinal tract
Have or at risk of developing vitamin-B12 deficiency
Had developed any skin reaction following management with similar medicines that can reduce stomach acid
Are due to have a specific blood test (Chromogranin A)
Have osteoporosis
Are a smoker
Have porphyria (a rare blood disorder)
Have alcohol intoxication (drinking large amount of alcohol in short period)
Have or had phaeochromocytoma (tumors of adrenal gland) in the past
Have or had prolactinoma (a noncancerous tumor of pituitary gland) in the past
Have hypokalemia (decreased potassium levels in blood)
Have neuroendocrine tumor (tumors in neuroendocrine cells)
Have mania or other mental disorders
Have painful breasts

Use in pediatrics:

NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking NEOPRIDE TOTAL 40MG TABLET. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About CYRA 20MG TABLET

CYRA 20MG TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take it preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking CYRA 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take CYRA 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking CYRA 20MG TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How CYRA 20MG TABLET Works
How Rabeprazole Blocks Proton Pumps

Rabeprazole, the active ingredient in Cyra 20mg Tablet, targets and irreversibly inhibits proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase) in stomach parietal cells, which are responsible for acid secretion.

Acid Secretion Suppression and Increased Stomach pH

By blocking the final step of acid production, Cyra 20mg reduces gastric acid release, leading to a higher stomach pH and relief from acid-related discomfort.

Conversion to Active Form in Acidic Environment

Rabeprazole is converted into an active sulfenamide intermediate in acidic conditions, which then forms covalent bonds with proton pumps to inhibit their activity.

Sustained Acid Control Through Irreversible Binding

The irreversible binding prevents acid secretion until new proton pumps are synthesized, providing prolonged acid suppression and symptom relief.
usageDetails:
How to use CYRA 20MG TABLET
How to Take Cyra 20mg Tablet

Take one tablet daily, preferably in the morning on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before eating. Swallow the tablet whole with water without chewing or crushing it.

Dosage Guidelines

Follow the dose and duration as prescribed by the healthcare provider, tailored to individual condition and response. Do not alter dose or discontinue medication without consulting your doctor.

Important Administration Tips

Maintain regular timing each day to ensure consistent effect. Avoid late-night eating, spicy or fatty foods, caffeine, and alcohol to optimize symptoms relief.

introduction:
Introduction About ACILOC 150MG TABLET

ACILOC 150MG TABLET contains Ranitidine which belongs to the group of medicines called H2 receptor antagonists. It reduces the amount of gastric acid produced in the stomach, which can be used to relieve the symptoms of acidity, heartburn, indigestion, stomach pain, etc. It also helps in the management of peptic ulcers, erosive esophagitis, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome (small tumour in the first part of your intestine due to excessive gastrin secretion).

Take Aciloc Tablet as directed by your physician. Strictly follow the dosing schedule as advised by your physician to achieve better results. Inform your doctor about all the medications that you are currently taking, to avoid any drug-drug interactions with Aciloc Tablet.

Your doctor may occasionally perform tests to make sure Aciloc Tablet is working and to manage side effects. Visit your doctor routinely for a check-up. Avoid smoking during the management with Aciloc Tablet, as it may delay healing or worsen the ulcers. Before taking ACILOC 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach cancer, kidney, lung or immunity problems, porphyria (rare blood disorder) or diabetes.

Consult your doctor before taking Aciloc Tablet if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Aciloc Tablet is suitable for use in adolescents aged 16 years or older. The most common side effects of Aciloc Tablet are constipation and nausea. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

How ACILOC 150MG TABLET Works

ACILOC 150MG TABLET is a H2 receptor antagonist. It blocks the release of certain chemicals (histamines) in the gut that is responsible for production of gastric acid. As a result, it helps in relieving acidity, indigestion, heartburn, etc, and promotes healing of stomach ulcers and inflammatory lesions of oesophagus.

Take ACILOC 150MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration of therapy for you, according to your age, body weight and disease condition.
