introduction:
Introduction About GASIDOM 10MG TABLET

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET contains Domperidone which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine antagonists. It is used in the management of nausea and vomiting associated with central or local origin, chemotherapy or radiotherapy, drugs or migraine.

Nausea and vomiting are not a disease but symptoms of different conditions such as infections, food poisoning, motion sickness, overeating, blocked intestine, migraine, indigestion and many more.

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET can also be used for relief of postprandial symptoms of fullness, nausea, epigastric bloating and belching (burping) that is occasionally accompanied by stomach discomfort and heartburn.

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart or moderate to severe liver diseases, bleeding in the stomach or intestines, blockage or tear in your intestines, and tumors in the pituitary gland (prolactinoma). GASIDOM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having kidney diseases.

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women and should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered clearly necessary by the doctor. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking it. GASIDOM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 60 years of age).

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET should not be used in children below 12 years or weighing less than 35kgs. Consult with your child’s doctor. The common side effect of taking GASIDOM 10MG TABLET includes a dry mouth. Consult with your doctor if this worsens or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How GASIDOM 10MG TABLET Works

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET is has an anti-emetic property which acts by blocking a chemical messenger in the brain called dopamine, that transfers information through nerve endings. GASIDOM 10MG TABLET functions by inhibiting the muscle contraction that occurs naturally in the digestive system and enhances the peristaltic movement in the food pipe which helps in facilitating the digestion time faster, this causes calming down effect, thereby relieving nausea or vomiting sensation.
usageDetails:

Take GASIDOM 10MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken before meals.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow GASIDOM 10MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse GASIDOM 10MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take GASIDOM 10MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

warnings.details: GASIDOM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. GASIDOM 10MG TABLET may cause unwanted side effects affecting the heart in a breastfed baby. It should only be used only if considered clearly necessary by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking GASIDOM 10MG TABLET.
GASIDOM 10MG TABLET does not affect the ability to drive or use machines. Yet do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking GASIDOM 10MG TABLET.

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney problems such as kidney impairment or kidney failure. Your doctor might consider adjusting your dose. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take GASIDOM 10MG TABLET if you are allergic to domperidone or any other ingredients present in it.

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET is not recommended in patients suffering from heart problems such as prolonged QT corrected interval (reading in eco cardiogram (ECG) machine) or heart failure (heart cannot pump blood properly). Kindly consult a doctor before taking GASIDOM 10MG TABLET.

Others

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Tumor in the pituitary gland (prolactinoma)
History of blockage or tear in the intestine
Hypokalemia (low level of potassium)
Hyperkalemia (high level of potassium in the blood)
Hypomagnesemia (low level of magnesium in the blood)
Signs and symptoms of bleeding in the stomach or intestine (black tarry bowel motions or blood in your bowel motions)

Use in pediatrics:

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age or weighing less than 35 kgs. Consult with your child’s doctor before giving GASIDOM 10MG TABLET to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET should be used with caution for use over 60 years of age, as GASIDOM 10MG TABLET be associated with an increased risk of heart rhythm disorder and cardiac arrest. Consult your doctor before taking it.

references: What is GASIDOM 10MG TABLET and why is it prescribed?

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET contains Domperidone which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine antagonists. It is used in the prevention of nausea and vomiting associated with central or local origin, chemotherapy or radiotherapy, drugs or migraine. GASIDOM 10MG TABLET can also be used in relief of postprandial symptoms of fullness, nausea, epigastric bloating and belching (burping) that is occasionally accompanied by stomach discomfort and heartburn.
How long can I take GASIDOM 10MG TABLET?

It is recommended that GASIDOM 10MG TABLET be taken for the shortest period and at the lowest dose. This is because GASIDOM 10MG TABLET can cause an irregular heartbeat when taken for a longer period or at a high dose. Ask for your doctor’s advice.
Can I take GASIDOM 10MG TABLET with antibiotics?

Use of GASIDOM 10MG TABLET with antibiotics like erythromycin, levofloxacin, and some antifungals is not recommended as this can cause interaction. Please consult your doctor for advice before using any antibiotics with GASIDOM 10MG TABLET.
Does GASIDOM 10MG TABLET increase milk secretion?

Yes, GASIDOM 10MG TABLET can increase milk secretion also known as galactorrhoea. This is an uncommon side effect of using GASIDOM 10MG TABLET. Talk to your doctor if you are experiencing this side effect while taking this medicine.
Does GASIDOM 10MG TABLET cause heart problems?

GASIDOM 10MG TABLET may be associated with an increased risk of heart problems (like an irregular heartbeat) and heart attacks. The risk also increases when GASIDOM 10MG TABLET is given together with other medicines. Inform the doctor of your medication history when taking GASIDOM 10MG TABLET.
Does GASIDOM 10MG TABLET cause dry mouth?

Yes, GASIDOM 10MG TABLET can cause dry mouth. A dry mouth can be managed by chewing sugar-free gum or sucking on sugar-free hard candies to stimulate the flow of saliva. Sip water at regular intervals of time. Do not use mouthwashes that contain alcohol because they can be drying. Consult your physician for advice.
What is the best time to take GASIDOM 10MG TABLET?

It is recommended to take GASIDOM 10MG TABLET before meals. If taken after meals, absorption of the medicine is somewhat delayed. Patients should try to take each dose of GASIDOM 10MG TABLET at a scheduled time to avoid missing a dose.

introduction:
Introduction About RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE

RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE is a combination of Domperidone and Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used in adults to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumors in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid). RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE is effective in managing peptic ulcer caused either due to stomach infection (H. pylori infection) or due to prolong use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (such as ibuprofen, Aceclofenac etc). It can also be used to manage re-bleeding from the ulcers. GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the acid from the stomach frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE should be taken at least 30 minutes before meals. During management with RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones. RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

Peptic ulcers

mechanismOfAction:
How RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE Works

RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE contains two medicines namely Domperidone and Esomeprazole. Domperidone works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and the brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Esomeprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).
usageDetails:
How to use RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE

Take RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE 30 minutes to 1 hour before meals or as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE unless your doctor advice you to stop.

warnings.details: RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE does not affect your ability in driving or handling heavy tools or machines. However, do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE, as it could aggravate your existing condition.
RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Domperidone, Esomeprazole or to any other proton pump inhibitors (such as rabeprazole, pantoprazole).

RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having heart problems (such as prolongation of QT wave, congestive heart failure or arrhythmia). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. However, consult your doctor before taking it.
RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have bloody stools or bleeding in the gut
Have blockage or tear in the intestines
Have severe fluid or electrolyte disturbances
Have prolactinoma (a non-cancerous tumor of pituitary gland)
Have low blood potassium or magnesium levels
Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)

Before taking RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you:

Have osteoporosis
Have vitamin B12 deficiency (sore tongue, mouth ulcers, pale skin, depression)
Are going to test Chromogranin A level

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage gastrointestinal problems (Ex. cisapride, dolasetron, prucalopride, diphemanil, bepridil, methadone, omeprazole, lansoprazole, rabeprazole, ranitidine, famotidine)
Medicines used to manage arrhythmia or other heart problems (Ex. digoxin, apomorphine, disopyramide, hydroquinidine, quinidine, amiodarone, dofetilide, dronedarone, ibutilide, sotalol, diltiazem, or verapamil)
Medicines used to manage HIV infection (Ex. atazanavir, nelfinavir, saquinavir)
Antipsychotics (used to manage mental illness) Ex. haloperidol, pimozide, sertindole
Antidepressants (used to manage depression) Ex. escitalopram, citalopram, imipramine, St. John’s Wort
Antibiotics (used to manage bacterial infections) Ex. moxifloxacin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, clarithromycin, telithromycin, or amoxicillin
Medicines used to manage malaria (Ex. halofantrine, lumefantrine)
Antihistamines (used to manage allergies) Ex. mizolastine, mequitazine
Medicines used to manage cancer (Ex. toremifene, vandetanib, vincamine, erlotinib, dasatinib, nilotinib)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Try to take this medicine before meals to achieve maximum efficacy.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more RANIDOM D SR 30/40MG CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Symptoms of overdosage might include sleepiness, confusion, uncontrollable body movements (including eye and tongue), twisted neck and abnormal posture.

Along with PANTOCID IT CAPSULE your doctor might want you to make some lifestyle changes such as having a balanced diet and exercising.

PANTOCID IT CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

Introduction About RABEMAC 10MG TABLET

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take RABEMAC 10MG TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking RABEMAC 10MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take RABEMAC 10MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking RABEMAC 10MG TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking RABEMAC 10MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About DOMPAN SR TABLET

DOMPAN SR TABLET is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. DOMPAN SR TABLET acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with DOMPAN SR TABLET your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking DOMPAN SR TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

DOMPAN SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking DOMPAN SR TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

Peptic ulcer

mechanismOfAction:
How DOMPAN SR TABLET Works

DOMPAN SR TABLET contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, DOMPAN SR TABLET it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

DOMPAN SR TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should be used in breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician.
DOMPAN SR TABLET does not affect your ability in driving or handling heavy tools or machines. However, do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by the medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DOMPAN SR TABLET, as it could aggravate your existing condition.
DOMPAN SR TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
DOMPAN SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems.

DOMPAN SR TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as prolongation of QT interval or congestive heart failure.
DOMPAN SR TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).
DOMPAN SR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

Others

Have bloody stools or bleeding in the gut
Have blockage or tear in the intestines
Have severe fluid or electrolyte disturbances
Have prolactinoma (a non-cancerous tumor of pituitary gland)
Have low blood potassium or magnesium levels

name: RB Pride Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RB PRIDE TABLET

RB PRIDE TABLET is a combination of Levosulpiride and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine D2 antagonists and Proton-pump inhibitors respectively. RB PRIDE TABLET is indicated for the management of Gastro-esophageal reflux disease (GERD). GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation and inflammation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

RB PRIDE TABLET can also be used to manage peptic ulcer (painful sores in the gut), Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumors in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid), functional dyspepsia (recurrent signs and symptoms of indigestion without an obvious cause) and diabetic gastroparesis (delayed gastric emptying caused due to diabetes).

Take RB PRIDE TABLET preferably on an empty stomach. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking RB PRIDE TABLET as it could potentiate the CNS depressive side effects.

Patients receiving long-term management (>1 year) with RB PRIDE TABLET should be kept on regular surveillance because it can increase the risk of bone fracture (i.e., in the hip, wrist or spine) which is more predominant in the patients having osteoporosis or taking corticosteroids.

Before taking RB PRIDE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any heart, kidney or liver disease as a precaution. RB PRIDE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

The most common side effects of taking RB PRIDE TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea, constipation and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)

mechanismOfAction:
How RB PRIDE TABLET Works

RB PRIDE TABLET reduces stomach ulcers, nausea and acid reflux, where rabeprazole acts by inhibiting the secretions of stomach acid by blocking the proton pump (H+ K+ ATPase) at the secretory surface of gastric parietal cells and levosulpiride acts by blocking the dopamine D2 receptors in the CTZ (area in medulla oblongata that causes vomiting when stimulated) and in the gut, thus facilitating the movement of food from the stomach into the intestines followed by healing of ulcers or inflammatory lesions in the stomach and in the esophagus.

Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness, drowsiness or sleepiness after taking RB PRIDE TABLET.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking RB PRIDE TABLET, as it could cause CNS depression (characterized by confusion, attention impairment and anxiety), dizziness and/or drowsiness. Consult your doctor before taking RB PRIDE TABLET.
RB PRIDE TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking RB PRIDE TABLET.

RB PRIDE TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with heart disease. Consult your doctor before taking RB PRIDE TABLET.

Others

RB PRIDE TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Parkinson’s disease
History of epilepsy
Neuroleptic malignant syndrome (a CNS disorder characterized by high fever, stiffness of the muscles, altered mental status (paranoid behavior) and autonomic dysfunction)
Breast cancer (with high levels of prolactin in the body)

Before taking RB PRIDE TABLET, inform your physician if you: 

Have a tumor in the stomach or breast
Have bleeding or perforation of the gastrointestinal tract
Have or at risk of developing vitamin-B12 deficiency
Had developed any skin reaction following management with similar medicines that can reduce stomach acid
Are due to have a specific blood test (Chromogranin A)
Have osteoporosis
Are a smoker
Have porphyria (a rare blood disorder)
Have alcohol intoxication (drinking large amount of alcohol in short period)
Have or had phaeochromocytoma (tumors of adrenal gland) in the past
Have or had prolactinoma (a noncancerous tumor of pituitary gland) in the past
Have hypokalemia (decreased potassium levels in blood)
Have neuroendocrine tumor (tumors in neuroendocrine cells)
Have mania or other mental disorders
Have painful breasts

Use in pediatrics:

RB PRIDE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking RB PRIDE TABLET.

Use in geriatrics:

RB PRIDE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking RB PRIDE TABLET. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About PEZOVER 40MG TABLET

PEZOVER 40MG TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking PEZOVER 40MG TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking PEZOVER 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How PEZOVER 40MG TABLET Works

PEZOVER 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why PEZOVER 40MG TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
PEZOVER 40MG TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take PEZOVER 40MG TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

More Information
01.What makes PEZOVER 40MG TABLET a preferred choice over other medications?
Potent and Long-Lasting Acid Suppression: PEZOVER 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively blocks the final step of stomach acid production, providing stronger and longer-lasting relief from symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, and indigestion compared to H2 blockers or antacids.
Comprehensive Symptom Relief and Healing: It not only relieves discomfort from acid-related conditions but also promotes healing of stomach and duodenal ulcers, and helps manage more severe conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
Lowering with Painkiller Use: PEZOVER 40MG TABLET is recommended for lowering stomach ulcers and acidity in patients who require long-term use of painkillers (NSAIDs), a benefit not offered by all acid-reducing medicines.
Convenient Once-Daily Dosing: Its long duration of action allows for once-daily dosing, making it easier for patients to adhere to treatment and maintain consistent acid control.
Favorable Tolerability Profile: Most side effects are mild and temporary, such as headache, nausea, or diarrhea. Serious side effects are rare when used as directed, and the risk of complications can be minimized with appropriate monitoring.
Well-Studied and Trusted: Pantoprazole, the active ingredient, is widely used and supported by extensive clinical experience, ensuring both efficacy and safety for a broad range of patients.

These advantages make PEZOVER 40MG TABLET a reliable and effective option for both short-term relief and long-term management of acid-related disorders, often outperforming less potent or shorter-acting alternatives.

introduction:
Introduction About ESOFAG L CAPSULE

ESOFAG L CAPSULE is a combination of Esomeprazole and Levosulpiride which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton-pump inhibitors and Dopamine D2 antagonists respectively. ESOFAG L CAPSULE is indicated for the management of Gastro-esophageal reflux disease (GERD) among patients who do not adequately respond to proton-pump inhibitors alone (Ex. pantoprazole, rabeprazole, esomeprazole, omeprazole).        

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.    

ESOFAG L CAPSULE can also be used to manage peptic ulcer caused by H. pylori infection or NSAID use. Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, esophagus or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.   

Along management with ESOFAG L CAPSULE eat less spicy food and drink plenty of water or fluids as advised by your physician. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate your existing disease conditions.   

Patients receiving long-term management with ESOFAG L CAPSULE should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of bone fractures (hip, wrist or spine), predominantly in patients taking corticosteroids and in patients with other recognized risk factors like osteoporosis. Before taking ESOFAG L CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any heart, kidney or liver disease as a precaution.  

ESOFAG L CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety and effectiveness.  ESOFAG L CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of taking ESOFAG L CAPSULE are headache, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About SOMPRAZ 20MG TABLET

SOMPRAZ 20MG TABLET contains Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used for the management of Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and heartburn. SOMPRAZ 20MG TABLET also helps in managing stomach ulcers or upper part of the gut (intestine) that are infected with Helicobacter pylori bacteria and Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) medicines in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. It is also used to manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (too much acid produced in the stomach caused by a growth in the pancreas).

GERD is a disease where acid from the stomach escapes into the tube which connects your throat to your stomach (esophagus) causing pain and inflammation. SOMPRAZ 20MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken in patients with severe kidney and liver failure. SOMPRAZ 20MG TABLET should be taken only if considered clearly necessary by your doctor in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

SOMPRAZ 20MG TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents aged less than 12 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking SOMPRAZ 20MG TABLET are headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, constipation, flatulence, nausea and vomiting. Contact your physician if any of the above side effects worsens or persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE

PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

mechanismOfAction:
How PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE Works

PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

moreInfo:
More Information

Disease description:

Peptic Ulcer: A peptic ulcer is a sore in the lining of the stomach or the first part of the small intestine. Symptoms include burning pain in the stomach that starts between meals or at night, nausea and vomiting, bloating or belching.

Gastrointestinal Reflux disease (GERD): Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a common condition in which the stomach contents move up into the esophagus. Reflux becomes a disease when it causes frequent or severe symptoms or injury. Reflux may damage the esophagus, pharynx or respiratory tract. The main symptom of GERD is heartburn, often described as a fiery feeling in one's chest, and regurgitating sour or bitter liquid to the throat or mouth.

Reflux esophagitis: Reflux esophagitis is an esophageal mucosal injury that occurs secondary to retrograde flux of gastric contents into the esophagus.

faqs.question: Q: What is PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE used for?
faqs.answer: A: PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE is used to manage peptic ulcers, GERD and reflux esophagitis. It can also be used to manage nausea, vomiting, bloating, burping, acidity and heartburn.

faqs.question: Q: How and when to take PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: Take PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE at least 15-30 minutes before meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.question: Q: How long should I take PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: You need to take PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.question: Q: What is the best time to take PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE must be taken before meals to avoid gastrointestinal side effects.

faqs.question: Q: What to do if I forgot to take a dose of PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: If you forgot to take a dose of PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is time for the next dose of PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE, skip the missed dose and take the next one regularly.

faqs.question: Q: What are the most common side effects of taking PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

faqs.question: Q: Will taking a higher dose of PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE be more effective?
faqs.answer: A: No, taking a higher dose of PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE will not be effective rather it can lead to toxicity. Always take the dose prescribed by your doctor. If the prescribed dose is not effective for you, consult your doctor for advice. Your doctor might increase the dose or suggest an alternative therapy.

faqs.question: Q: What precautions do I need to follow while taking PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: Make sure to take PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE 30 minutes before meals. Before taking PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

faqs.question: Q: Can I take medication for high blood pressure along with PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE?
faqs.answer: A: It is not advisable to take medicines to control blood pressure while taking PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE without consulting your doctor as they have known interactions with the medicine.

faqs.question: Q: Can PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE be used in pregnant women?
faqs.answer: A: PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician.

faqs.question: Q: Can PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE cause constipation?
faqs.answer: A: Yes. Constipation is a common side effect of using PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE. Eat plenty of fiber rich foods such as fresh fruits, vegetables, cereals as well as drink plenty of water and exercise more regularly when taking this medicine. Contact your doctor if this side effect bothers you.

faqs.question: Q: Can PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE cause dry mouth?
faqs.answer: A: Yes. Dry mouth is a common side effect of using PROTOCHEK DSR CAPSULE. Contact your doctor if this side effect bothers you.

name: DOMWAYS Strawberry Flavour Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About DOMWAYS DROPS

DOMWAYS DROPS contains Domperidone which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine antagonists. It is used to manage nausea (feeling sick) and vomiting (being sick).

Nausea and vomiting are not a disease but symptoms of different conditions such as infections, food poisoning, motion sickness, overeating, blocked intestine, migraine, indigestion and many more.

DOMWAYS DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having heart or moderate to severe liver diseases, bleeding in the stomach or intestines, blockage or tear in your intestines, and tumors in the pituitary gland (prolactinoma). DOMWAYS DROPS should be used with caution in patients having kidney diseases.

DOMWAYS DROPS should be used with caution in pregnant women and should be used in breastfeeding women only if considered clearly necessary by the doctor. Ask for your doctor’s advice before taking. DOMWAYS DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 60 years of age).

DOMWAYS DROPS should not be used in children below 12 years or weighing less than 35kgs. Consult with your child’s doctor. The common side effect of taking DOMWAYS DROPS includes dry mouth. Consult with your doctor if this worsens or doesn’t improve.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOMWAYS DROPS
Manages nausea and vomiting
mechanismOfAction:
How DOMWAYS DROPS Works

DOMWAYS DROPS has an anti-emetic property which acts by blocking a chemical messenger in the brain called dopamine, that transfers information through nerve endings. DOMWAYS DROPS functions by inhibiting the muscle contraction that occurs naturally in the digestive system and enhances the peristaltic movement in the food pipe which helps in facilitating the digestion time faster, this causes calming down effect, thereby relieving nausea or vomiting sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use DOMWAYS DROPS

Take DOMWAYS DROPS as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the appropriate dose and duration of DOMWAYS DROPS for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: DOMWAYS DROPS should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.

DOMWAYS DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk. DOMWAYS DROPS may cause unwanted side effects affecting the heart in a breastfed baby. It should only be used only if considered clearly necessary by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking DOMWAYS DROPS.
DOMWAYS DROPS does not affect the ability to drive or use machines.

DOMWAYS DROPS should be taken with caution in patients with kidney problems such as kidney impairment or kidney failure. Your doctor might consider adjusting your dose. Consult your doctor before taking it.
DOMWAYS DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having moderate to severe liver diseases such as liver function impairment or liver failure. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take DOMWAYS DROPS if you are allergic to Domperidone or any other ingredients present in it.

DOMWAYS DROPS is not recommended in patients suffering from heart problems such as prolonged QT corrected interval (reading in eco cardiogram (ECG) machine) or heart failure (heart cannot pump blood properly). Kindly consult a doctor before taking DOMWAYS DROPS.

Others

DOMWAYS DROPS is not recommended for use if you:

Tumor in the pituitary gland (prolactinoma)
History of blockage or tear in the intestine
Hypokalemia (low level of potassium)
Hyperkalemia (increased levels of potassium in the blood)
Hypomagnesemia (decreased levels of magnesium in the blood)
Signs and symptoms of bleeding in the stomach or intestine (black tarry bowel motions or blood in your bowel motions)

Use in pediatrics:

DOMWAYS DROPS is not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age or weighing less than 35 kgs. Consult with your child’s doctor before giving DOMWAYS DROPS to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

DOMWAYS DROPS should be used with caution for use over 60 years of age, as DOMWAYS DROPS be associated with an increased risk of heart rhythm disorder and cardiac arrest. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Esomac 40mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About ESOMAC 40MG TABLET

ESOMAC 40MG TABLET contains Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used for the management of Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) heartburn in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. ESOMAC 40MG TABLET also helps in managing stomach ulcers or upper part of the gut (intestine) that are infected with Helicobacter pylori bacteria and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) medicines in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. It is also used to manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (too much acid produced in the stomach caused by a growth in the pancreas).

GERD is a disease where acid from the stomach escapes into the tube which connects your throat to your stomach (oesophagus) causing pain and inflammation.

ESOMAC 40MG TABLET is not recommended to be taken in patients with severe kidney and liver failure. ESOMAC 40MG TABLET should be taken only if considered clearly necessary by your doctor in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

ESOMAC 40MG TABLET is not recommended for children and adolescents aged less than 12 years. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking ESOMAC 40MG TABLET are headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, constipation, flatulence, nausea and vomiting. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsens with time.

How ESOMAC 40MG TABLET Works

ESOMAC 40MG TABLET is a proton pump inhibitor that suppresses gastric acid secretion by specific inhibition of enzymes in the stomach cell. It hence reduces gastric acidity by blocking the final step in acid production and helps in relief of acid related indigestion and heartburn.

introduction:
Introduction About INSTARAFT SUGAR FREE MIXED BERRY FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION

INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is used to manage gastrointestinal symptoms like acidity, acid reflux, heartburn and indigestion. It contains Calcium Carbonate, Sodium Alginate and Sodium Bicarbonate as active ingredients which works by forming a protective gel and foam (raft) over the walls of the stomach which acts as a barrier, preventing the stomach acid from flowing back into the esophagus, thus reducing symptoms of acid reflux.

Always take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension exactly as directed by your doctor. It can be taken after meals at bedtime. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any stomach inflammation, kidney problems, heart problems, dehydration or electrolyte imbalance. There should be a 2-hour gap between taking InstaRaft and any other medications.

INSTARAFT Oral Suspension can be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding women if advised by the physician. It can be administered to children aged 12 years or older if prescribed by the physician. Studies have shown that INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is generally safe and well-tolerated. However, consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How INSTARAFT SUGAR FREE MIXED BERRY FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION Works

INSTARAFT Oral Suspension contains three ingredients namely Sodium Alginate, Calcium Carbonate and Sodium Bicarbonate.

The sodium alginate present in the medicine forms an alginic acid gel (a gel form) with a near-neutral pH when it comes in contact with stomach acid. Sodium bicarbonate present in the medicine reacts with the gastric acid to produce carbon dioxide gas. This gas gets trapped in the alginic acid gel, turning it into a foam. This foam floats on top of the stomach contents, creating a "raft’ which acts as a barrier, preventing the stomach acid from flowing back into the esophagus, thus reducing symptoms of acid reflux.

The Calcium Carbonate present in the medicine interacts with sodium alginate and makes the foam raft stronger and more effective in maintaining its structure and position on top of the stomach contents. By doing so, INSTARAFT Oral Suspension provides a rapid and near-neutral pH environment in the stomach, leading to quick and effective relief from acidity, heartburn and indigestion.

faqs.question: Q: What is INSTARAFT Oral Suspension used for?
faqs.answer: A: INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is used to manage gastrointestinal symptoms like acidity, acid reflux, heartburn and indigestion.

faqs.answer: A: INSTARAFT Oral Suspension contains Calcium Carbonate, Sodium Alginate and Sodium Bicarbonate as active ingredients which works by forming a protective gel and foam (raft) over the walls of the stomach which acts as a barrier, preventing the stomach acid from flowing back into the esophagus, thus reducing symptoms of acid reflux

faqs.question: Q: What is the best time to take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: Take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension after meals at bedtime. However, your doctor is the right person to decide the correct time, dose and duration for you.

faqs.question: Q: How much to take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: Typically, INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is prescribed between 10-20ml after each meal of the day and at bedtime. It can be taken at a maximum of 4 times a day. However, this period can vary based on your age, body weight and health condition. Your doctor is the right person to decide the correct dose and duration for you.

faqs.question: Q: Who should not take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: Do not take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension without consulting your doctor if you are allergic to sodium alginate, sodium bicarbonate and calcium carbonate. Also, it is advisable to inform your doctor before taking INSTARAFT Oral Suspension if you have any stomach inflammation, kidney problems, heart problems, dehydration or electrolyte imbalance.

faqs.question: Q: What precautions must be followed while taking INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: Prior to the therapy, inform your doctor if you have any stomach inflammation, kidney problems, heart problems, dehydration or electrolyte imbalance. Inform your doctor about all the medicines that you currently take as a precaution. Do not take this medicine within 2 hours of taking other medicines as it could interfere with the action of some other medicines.

faqs.question: Q: Can INSTARAFT Oral Suspension be given to children?
faqs.answer: A: INSTARAFT Oral Suspension can be administered to children aged 12 years or older if prescribed by the physician. For children aged below 12 years, it is advisable to avoid the usage of INSTARAFT Oral Suspension, as there is no sufficient clinical trial evidence.

faqs.question: Q: Can INSTARAFT Oral Suspension be used during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: INSTARAFT Oral Suspension can be used during pregnancy if advised by the physician. It helps to get rid of acid reflux, heartburn and acidity caused during pregnancy.

faqs.question: Q: Can I take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension daily?
faqs.answer: A: Take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension exactly as prescribed by your physician. It can be taken daily for 7 days continuously. However, check with your physician, if you couldn’t notice any improvement even after using this medicine for 7 days.

faqs.question: Q: Can we use INSTARAFT Oral Suspension for a long-term?
faqs.answer: A: Take INSTARAFT Oral Suspension exactly for the specified duration mentioned by your physician. It can be taken daily for 7 days continuously. Avoid long-term usage of this medicine without doctor’s supervision, as it could disturb the electrolyte balance, increased blood sodium levels and affect the kidneys.

faqs.question: Q: How long does it take for INSTARAFT Oral Suspension to show results?
faqs.answer: A: INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is claimed to show results within 3 minutes of administration and the effects may last until 4 hours.

faqs.question: Q: When can I stop taking INSTARAFT Oral Suspension?
faqs.answer: A: You can stop using INSTARAFT Oral Suspension after 7 days. However, if you feel the need of using this medicine for a few days, check with your doctor.

faqs.answer: A: Studies have shown that INSTARAFT Oral Suspension is generally safe and well-tolerated. However, consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects.

introduction:
Introduction About ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE

ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE is a combination of Domperidone and Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used in adults to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumors in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid). ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE is effective in managing peptic ulcer caused either due to stomach infection (H. pylori infection) or due to prolong use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (such as ibuprofen, Aceclofenac etc). It can also be used to manage re-bleeding from the ulcers. GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the acid from the stomach frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE should be taken at least 30 minutes before meals. During management with ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones. ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE Works

ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE contains two medicines namely Domperidone and Esomeprazole. Domperidone works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and the brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Esomeprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).
usageDetails:
How to use ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE

Take ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE 30 minutes to 1 hour before meals or as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ESOLEMBIC D CAPSULE unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)

introduction:
Introduction About RABIPLUS CAPSULE

RABIPLUS CAPSULE contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take RABIPLUS CAPSULE preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking RABIPLUS CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take RABIPLUS CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking RABIPLUS CAPSULE are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking RABIPLUS CAPSULE.

mechanismOfAction:
How RABIPLUS CAPSULE Works

RABIPLUS CAPSULE is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About P2I TABLET

P2I TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking P2I TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking P2I TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How P2I TABLET Works

P2I TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why P2I TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
P2I TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take P2I TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

introduction:
Introduction About MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE

MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation designed to support stomach comfort and digestive balance. It contains Rabeprazole and Domperidone, two clinically studied components that reduce excessive stomach acid and support smoother digestion. This combination is widely recommended for individuals experiencing symptoms linked to acidity, heartburn, or discomfort after meals.

Along management with MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE , try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Some individuals may experience mild effects such as headache, dry mouth, abdominal discomfort, constipation, dizziness, or nausea. These effects are generally temporary. If they persist, contact your healthcare provider for guidance.

Store MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep out of reach of children and pets.

mechanismOfAction:
How MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE Works

MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE works through a dual mechanism. Rabeprazole acts by reducing acid secretion at its source, ensuring a well-balanced gastric environment. Meanwhile, Domperidone restores the normal movement of the stomach and intestines, managing acid backflow and improving food passage for a more comfortable digestive experience.

Dual Mechanism Explained: Acid Control and Gut Movement

1. Acid Control through Rabeprazole:

Rabeprazole belongs to the class of proton pump modulators that reduce acid secretion at its source. Once absorbed in the intestine, it reaches the acid-producing parietal cells in the stomach lining. Here, it selectively and irreversibly binds to the H/K ATPase enzyme system, also known as the proton pump, the final step in acid secretion. By blocking the hydrogen ion exchange process, Rabeprazole manages excessive acid release into the stomach lumen, thereby increasing gastric pH. It acts faster than many other molecules in its class due to its ability to activate at higher pH levels, efficiently reducing acid production even at minimal acidity. This long-acting acid suppression helps relieve common signs of acidity and promotes a stable digestive environment.

2. Gut Movement through Domperidone:

Domperidone supports the mechanical side of digestion by enhancing gastric motility. It selectively blocks dopamine D2 receptors found in the upper gastrointestinal tract, which normally act to slow stomach contractions. By inhibiting these receptors, Domperidone increases the tone of the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), facilitates faster gastric emptying, and decreases the backward flow of food and acid into the esophagus. It also improves intestinal motion, reducing sensations of bloating, heaviness, or delayed digestion after meals, particularly useful for individuals who experience reflux linked to slow gastric transit.

3. Integrated Digestive Action:

Together, these two mechanisms form a dual-action system. Rabeprazole ensures acid stability, while Domperidone optimizes movement and clearance. This combination supports digestive comfort by minimizing acid build-up while promoting efficient passage of food through the stomach and intestines. It is particularly suited for individuals who face recurring symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, or post-meal fullness due to poor gastric motility or high acid output. This science-backed synergy makes MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE effective for holistic digestive maintenance under medical supervision.

“Quick Fact Highlights” explaining why the dual combination is clinically valued
Clinically synergistic formulation: The combination of Rabeprazole (20 mg) and Domperidone (30 mg SR) works through a dual mechanism, controlling stomach acid while improving gut motility providing faster and more comprehensive relief from acid discomfort
Science-backed acid regulation: Rabeprazole acts at the final step of acid production by blocking the H/K ATPase enzyme, also known as the proton pump. This action significantly reduces acid secretion and maintains optimal pH levels in the stomach for prolonged comfort
Enhanced digestion support: Domperidone increases the movement of the stomach and upper intestinal tract, promoting quicker stomach emptying and minimizing post-meal bloating, nausea, and reflux symptoms
Faster symptom control: Rabeprazole has one of the quickest onset times among proton pump inhibitors, beginning to act within 1 hour of ingestion, offering prompt relief in cases of severe acidity and heartburn
Persistent gastric balance: The sustained-release form of Domperidone maintains smooth motility throughout the day, managing the recurrence of reflux episodes and late-night acidity, a key benefit for individuals with night-time acid reflux or delayed digestion
Improved patient quality of life: This dual approach relieves not just acid discomfort but also digestive sluggishness, making it beneficial for individuals who experience post-meal heaviness, belching, or regurgitation along with acidity
Clinically preferred for complex acid disorders: Physicians often recommend this combination when single-drug therapy (acid suppressants alone) fails to improve acid-related conditions or reflux-associated nausea
Well-tolerated and safety-monitored: The formulation has a proven safety profile when used as prescribed, with side effects such as mild headache or dizziness typically resolving with continued use

How to use MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE

Take the capsule before meals, preferably in the morning, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Swallow the capsule whole with water without crushing or chewing. Regular use under professional guidance ensures optimal results.

1. How to Take MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE Safely

Swallow the capsule whole with water without biting, breaking, or crushing it. The capsule should not be chewed as it is designed for delayed release. It is best taken on an empty stomach for optimal absorption and faster onset of effect. Avoid taking it with caffeinated or acidic drinks.

2. Dosage and Duration

The dosage and duration depend on your medical condition, age, and response to therapy. Most individuals experience benefits with once-daily use, but in some cases, the doctor may recommend twice-daily administration. Continue the capsule for the prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve early.

3. Dosage Guidelines for Adults and Elderly
For most adult users, the typical dosage is one MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption
Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision
Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. Extra caution is advised in those with osteoporosis or history of cardiac arrhythmia, as Domperidone may influence heart rhythm in predisposed individuals

More Information
Why MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE is Doctor-Recommended for “Digestive Balance.”

Digestive discomfort caused by acidity and reflux is often linked to two simultaneous problems excess acid formation and slowed stomach movement.MAXXORAB DSR CAPSULE addresses both through a clinically trusted dual mechanism combining Rabeprazole and Domperidone. Doctors recommend this capsule because it supports digestive balance by managing acid levels and enhancing gastric motility, offering smoother stomach function throughout the day.

“Did You Know?” Sidebar: Use small fact highlights like: “Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to late-night meals. Following early dinner routines may reduce reflux frequency”
Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to nighttime eating habits, eating late dinners or snacks within two hours of bedtime significantly increases reflux risk. Having meals earlier in the evening can reduce acid backflow and discomfort.
Meal timing matters: Studies show that eating dinner 3–4 hours before sleep supports better digestion and reduces nighttime acid episodes. Early dining allows the stomach to empty properly before lying down.
Late-night meals affect sleep and metabolism: Research indicates that those who regularly eat after 9 p.m. experience disrupted sleep patterns, slower calorie burning, and more frequent heartburn sensations compared to early eaters.
Fast eating can upset digestive balance: People who eat quickly swallow more air, which increases pressure in the stomach and raises the chance of acid discomfort. Chewing food slowly and mindfully can reduce symptoms and aid smoother digestion.
Simple posture shifts help: Standing or staying upright after meals even for 15–20 minutes can minimize reflux frequency and relieve heaviness. Avoid lying flat immediately after eating.
Diet quality counts: Frequent consumption of spicy, oily, or fried foods can raise stomach acid levels. Choosing gentle foods like oatmeal, bananas, and green vegetables can maintain a neutral digestive pH.
Hydration supports healthy acid balance: Drinking plain water throughout the day dilutes acid concentration naturally. However, sipping slowly instead of gulping helps avoid trapped air and bloating.

introduction:
Introduction About PROZER 15MG CAPSULE

PROZER 15MG CAPSULE contains Lansoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton Pump Inhibitors. It is used in the management of intestinal and peptic (stomach) ulcers. Peptic or intestinal ulcers are open sores that form on the inside lining of your stomach and the upper part of your small intestine, causing stomach pain.

PROZER 15MG CAPSULE is also used to manage reflux oesophagitis (inflammation of lower food pipe due to backflow of acidic stomach material) and Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome (small tumour in the first part of your bowel due to excessive gastrin secretion).

Before taking PROZER 15MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have severe liver disease, phenylketonuria, osteoporosis or if you are about to have a specific blood test (Chromogranin A). PROZER 15MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. PROZER 15MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children.

Your doctor may perform an additional examination (endoscopy) to diagnose your condition or exclude malignant disease and regular blood tests to monitor your levels of magnesium. The most common side effects of taking PROZER 15MG CAPSULE are dizziness, nausea, headache, diarrhea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms gets worse over time.

introduction:
Introduction About RABEKIND PLUS TABLET

RABEKIND PLUS TABLET is a combination of Levosulpiride and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine D2 antagonists and Proton-pump inhibitors respectively. RABEKIND PLUS TABLET is indicated for the management of Gastro-esophageal reflux disease (GERD). GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation and inflammation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

RABEKIND PLUS TABLET can also be used to manage peptic ulcer (painful sores in the gut), Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumors in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid), functional dyspepsia (recurrent signs and symptoms of indigestion without an obvious cause) and diabetic gastroparesis (delayed gastric emptying caused due to diabetes).

Take RABEKIND PLUS TABLET preferably on an empty stomach. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking RABEKIND PLUS TABLET as it could potentiate the CNS depressive side effects.

Patients receiving long-term management (>1 year) with RABEKIND PLUS TABLET should be kept on regular surveillance because it can increase the risk of bone fracture (i.e., in the hip, wrist or spine) which is more predominant in the patients having osteoporosis or taking corticosteroids.

Before taking RABEKIND PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any heart, kidney or liver disease as a precaution. RABEKIND PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).

The most common side effects of taking RABEKIND PLUS TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea, constipation and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How RABEKIND PLUS TABLET Works

RABEKIND PLUS TABLET reduces stomach ulcers, nausea and acid reflux, where rabeprazole acts by inhibiting the secretions of stomach acid by blocking the proton pump (H+ K+ ATPase) at the secretory surface of gastric parietal cells and levosulpiride acts by blocking the dopamine D2 receptors in the CTZ (area in medulla oblongata that causes vomiting when stimulated) and in the gut, thus facilitating the movement of food from the stomach into the intestines followed by healing of ulcers or inflammatory lesions in the stomach and in the esophagus.
