name: Razo D Capsule 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About RAZO D CAPSULE

RAZO D CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation designed to support stomach comfort and digestive balance. It contains Rabeprazole and Domperidone, two clinically studied components that reduce excessive stomach acid and support smoother digestion. This combination is widely recommended for individuals experiencing symptoms linked to acidity, heartburn, or discomfort after meals.

Along management with RAZO D CAPSULE , try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Some individuals may experience mild effects such as headache, dry mouth, abdominal discomfort, constipation, dizziness, or nausea. These effects are generally temporary. If they persist, contact your healthcare provider for guidance.

Store RAZO D CAPSULE in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
uses: Used to support stomach comfort and digestive balance
usesDetails:
Uses Of RAZO D CAPSULE
Used to support stomach comfort and digestive balance
mechanismOfAction:
How RAZO D CAPSULE Works

RAZO D CAPSULE works through a dual mechanism. Rabeprazole acts by reducing acid secretion at its source, ensuring a well-balanced gastric environment. Meanwhile, Domperidone restores the normal movement of the stomach and intestines, managing acid backflow and improving food passage for a more comfortable digestive experience.

Dual Mechanism Explained: Acid Control and Gut Movement

1. Acid Control through Rabeprazole:

Rabeprazole belongs to the class of proton pump modulators that reduce acid secretion at its source. Once absorbed in the intestine, it reaches the acid-producing parietal cells in the stomach lining. Here, it selectively and irreversibly binds to the H/K ATPase enzyme system, also known as the proton pump, the final step in acid secretion. By blocking the hydrogen ion exchange process, Rabeprazole manages excessive acid release into the stomach lumen, thereby increasing gastric pH. It acts faster than many other molecules in its class due to its ability to activate at higher pH levels, efficiently reducing acid production even at minimal acidity. This long-acting acid suppression helps relieve common signs of acidity and promotes a stable digestive environment.

2. Gut Movement through Domperidone:

Domperidone supports the mechanical side of digestion by enhancing gastric motility. It selectively blocks dopamine D2 receptors found in the upper gastrointestinal tract, which normally act to slow stomach contractions. By inhibiting these receptors, Domperidone increases the tone of the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), facilitates faster gastric emptying, and decreases the backward flow of food and acid into the esophagus. It also improves intestinal motion, reducing sensations of bloating, heaviness, or delayed digestion after meals, particularly useful for individuals who experience reflux linked to slow gastric transit.

3. Integrated Digestive Action:

Together, these two mechanisms form a dual-action system. Rabeprazole ensures acid stability, while Domperidone optimizes movement and clearance. This combination supports digestive comfort by minimizing acid build-up while promoting efficient passage of food through the stomach and intestines. It is particularly suited for individuals who face recurring symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, or post-meal fullness due to poor gastric motility or high acid output. This science-backed synergy makes RAZO D CAPSULE effective for holistic digestive maintenance under medical supervision.

“Quick Fact Highlights” explaining why the dual combination is clinically valued
Clinically synergistic formulation: The combination of Rabeprazole (20 mg) and Domperidone (30 mg SR) works through a dual mechanism, controlling stomach acid while improving gut motility providing faster and more comprehensive relief from acid discomfort
Science-backed acid regulation: Rabeprazole acts at the final step of acid production by blocking the H/K ATPase enzyme, also known as the proton pump. This action significantly reduces acid secretion and maintains optimal pH levels in the stomach for prolonged comfort
Enhanced digestion support: Domperidone increases the movement of the stomach and upper intestinal tract, promoting quicker stomach emptying and minimizing post-meal bloating, nausea, and reflux symptoms
Faster symptom control: Rabeprazole has one of the quickest onset times among proton pump inhibitors, beginning to act within 1 hour of ingestion, offering prompt relief in cases of severe acidity and heartburn
Persistent gastric balance: The sustained-release form of Domperidone maintains smooth motility throughout the day, managing the recurrence of reflux episodes and late-night acidity, a key benefit for individuals with night-time acid reflux or delayed digestion
Improved patient quality of life: This dual approach relieves not just acid discomfort but also digestive sluggishness, making it beneficial for individuals who experience post-meal heaviness, belching, or regurgitation along with acidity
Clinically preferred for complex acid disorders: Physicians often recommend this combination when single-drug therapy (acid suppressants alone) fails to improve acid-related conditions or reflux-associated nausea
Well-tolerated and safety-monitored: The formulation has a proven safety profile when used as prescribed, with side effects such as mild headache or dizziness typically resolving with continued use
usageInstructions: For most adult users, the typical dosage is one RAZO D CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption

Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision

Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. Extra caution is advised in those with osteoporosis or history of cardiac arrhythmia, as Domperidone may influence heart rhythm in predisposed individuals
usageDetails:
How to use RAZO D CAPSULE

Take the capsule before meals, preferably in the morning, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Swallow the capsule whole with water without crushing or chewing. Regular use under professional guidance ensures optimal results.

1. How to Take RAZO D CAPSULE Safely

Swallow the capsule whole with water without biting, breaking, or crushing it. The capsule should not be chewed as it is designed for delayed release. It is best taken on an empty stomach for optimal absorption and faster onset of effect. Avoid taking it with caffeinated or acidic drinks.

2. Dosage and Duration

The dosage and duration depend on your medical condition, age, and response to therapy. Most individuals experience benefits with once-daily use, but in some cases, the doctor may recommend twice-daily administration. Continue the capsule for the prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve early.

3. Dosage Guidelines for Adults and Elderly
For most adult users, the typical dosage is one RAZO D CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption
Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision
Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. Extra caution is advised in those with osteoporosis or history of cardiac arrhythmia, as Domperidone may influence heart rhythm in predisposed individuals

More Information
Why RAZO D CAPSULE is Doctor-Recommended for “Digestive Balance.”

Digestive discomfort caused by acidity and reflux is often linked to two simultaneous problems excess acid formation and slowed stomach movement.RAZO D CAPSULE addresses both through a clinically trusted dual mechanism combining Rabeprazole and Domperidone. Doctors recommend this capsule because it supports digestive balance by managing acid levels and enhancing gastric motility, offering smoother stomach function throughout the day.

“Did You Know?” Sidebar: Use small fact highlights like: “Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to late-night meals. Following early dinner routines may reduce reflux frequency”
Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to nighttime eating habits, eating late dinners or snacks within two hours of bedtime significantly increases reflux risk. Having meals earlier in the evening can reduce acid backflow and discomfort.
Meal timing matters: Studies show that eating dinner 3–4 hours before sleep supports better digestion and reduces nighttime acid episodes. Early dining allows the stomach to empty properly before lying down.
Late-night meals affect sleep and metabolism: Research indicates that those who regularly eat after 9 p.m. experience disrupted sleep patterns, slower calorie burning, and more frequent heartburn sensations compared to early eaters.
Fast eating can upset digestive balance: People who eat quickly swallow more air, which increases pressure in the stomach and raises the chance of acid discomfort. Chewing food slowly and mindfully can reduce symptoms and aid smoother digestion.
Simple posture shifts help: Standing or staying upright after meals even for 15–20 minutes can minimize reflux frequency and relieve heaviness. Avoid lying flat immediately after eating.
Diet quality counts: Frequent consumption of spicy, oily, or fried foods can raise stomach acid levels. Choosing gentle foods like oatmeal, bananas, and green vegetables can maintain a neutral digestive pH.
Hydration supports healthy acid balance: Drinking plain water throughout the day dilutes acid concentration naturally. However, sipping slowly instead of gulping helps avoid trapped air and bloating.

introduction:
Introduction About COCID D CAPSULE

COCID D CAPSULE is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. COCID D CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with COCID D CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking COCID D CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

COCID D CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking COCID D CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

mechanismOfAction:
How COCID D CAPSULE Works

COCID D CAPSULE contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, COCID D CAPSULE it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

It can also be used to manage re-bleeding from the ulcers. GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the acid from the stomach frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

The most common side effects of taking NEKSIUM D 40 CAPSULE are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About RAFRON 20MG TABLET

RAFRON 20MG TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take RAFRON 20MG TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking RAFRON 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take RAFRON 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking RAFRON 20MG TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking RAFRON 20MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RAFRON 20MG TABLET
Manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease
Manage and Manages Peptic ulcers
Manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How RAFRON 20MG TABLET Works

RAFRON 20MG TABLET is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.
usageDetails:
How to use RAFRON 20MG TABLET

Take RAFRON 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken in the mornings or at any time of the day before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RABLET D 40MG CAPSULE

RABLET D 40MG CAPSULE is used to manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) among patients who have not responded adequately to rabeprazole alone. It is a combination of Domperidone and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine Antagonists and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It can also be used to manage peptic ulcers caused by H. pylori infection or NSAIDs use.

Along management with RABLET D 40MG CAPSULE, try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Before taking RABLET D 40MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Your doctor may reduce the dose or suggest an alternative therapy. It is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged less than 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects worsen.

RABLET D 40MG CAPSULE reduces stomach ulcers and acid reflux, where Rabeprazole acts by inhibiting the secretions of stomach acid and Domperidone acts by increasing bowel movements and facilitating gastric emptying, thus leading to rapid symptom relief and healing of stomach ulcers and esophageal lesions.

name: Rapid 20mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RAPID 20MG TABLET

RAPID 20MG TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take RAPID 20MG TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking RAPID 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take RAPID 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking RAPID 20MG TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking RAPID 20MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RAPID 20MG TABLET
Manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease
Manage and Manages Peptic ulcers
Manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How RAPID 20MG TABLET Works

RAPID 20MG TABLET is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.
usageDetails:
How to use RAPID 20MG TABLET

Take RAPID 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken in the mornings or at any time of the day before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About PANSEC DSR CAPSULE

PANSEC DSR CAPSULE is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, esophagus or intestines. It causes severe stomach pain with sensation of flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the acid from the stomach frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Reflux esophagitis can be defined as the inflammation of the food pipe accompanied with acid reflex.

PANSEC DSR CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with PANSEC DSR CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking PANSEC DSR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

PANSEC DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking PANSEC DSR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking PANSEC DSR CAPSULE are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

Uses Of PANSEC DSR CAPSULE

It is used in adults to manage:

Peptic ulcer
Gastrointestinal Reflux disease (GERD)

mechanismOfAction:
How PANSEC DSR CAPSULE Works

PANSEC DSR CAPSULE contains two medicines namely domperidone and pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties. It works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord.

This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting.

Pantoprazole is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach.

By reducing stomach acid production, PANSEC DSR CAPSULE it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).
usageDetails:
How to use PANSEC DSR CAPSULE

Take PANSEC DSR CAPSULE 15-30 minutes before meals or as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking PANSEC DSR CAPSULE unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Have bloody stools or bleeding in the gut
Have blockage or tear in the intestines
Have severe fluid or electrolyte disturbances
Have prolactinoma (a non-cancerous tumor of pituitary gland)
Have low blood potassium or magnesium levels

Have osteoporosis
Have vitamin B12 deficiency (sore tongue, mouth ulcers, pale skin, depression)
Are going to test Chromogranin A level

PANSEC DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). However, consult your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

PANSEC DSR CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Rabezol DSR Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE

RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation designed to support stomach comfort and digestive balance. It contains Rabeprazole and Domperidone, two clinically studied components that reduce excessive stomach acid and support smoother digestion. This combination is widely recommended for individuals experiencing symptoms linked to acidity, heartburn, or discomfort after meals.

Along management with RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE , try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Some individuals may experience mild effects such as headache, dry mouth, abdominal discomfort, constipation, dizziness, or nausea. These effects are generally temporary. If they persist, contact your healthcare provider for guidance.

Store RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
uses: Used to support stomach comfort and digestive balance
usesDetails:
Uses Of RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE
Used to support stomach comfort and digestive balance
mechanismOfAction:
How RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE Works

RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE works through a dual mechanism. Rabeprazole acts by reducing acid secretion at its source, ensuring a well-balanced gastric environment. Meanwhile, Domperidone restores the normal movement of the stomach and intestines, managing acid backflow and improving food passage for a more comfortable digestive experience.

Dual Mechanism Explained: Acid Control and Gut Movement

1. Acid Control through Rabeprazole:

Rabeprazole belongs to the class of proton pump modulators that reduce acid secretion at its source. Once absorbed in the intestine, it reaches the acid-producing parietal cells in the stomach lining. Here, it selectively and irreversibly binds to the H/K ATPase enzyme system, also known as the proton pump, the final step in acid secretion. By blocking the hydrogen ion exchange process, Rabeprazole manages excessive acid release into the stomach lumen, thereby increasing gastric pH. It acts faster than many other molecules in its class due to its ability to activate at higher pH levels, efficiently reducing acid production even at minimal acidity. This long-acting acid suppression helps relieve common signs of acidity and promotes a stable digestive environment.

2. Gut Movement through Domperidone:

Domperidone supports the mechanical side of digestion by enhancing gastric motility. It selectively blocks dopamine D2 receptors found in the upper gastrointestinal tract, which normally act to slow stomach contractions. By inhibiting these receptors, Domperidone increases the tone of the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), facilitates faster gastric emptying, and decreases the backward flow of food and acid into the esophagus. It also improves intestinal motion, reducing sensations of bloating, heaviness, or delayed digestion after meals, particularly useful for individuals who experience reflux linked to slow gastric transit.

3. Integrated Digestive Action:

Together, these two mechanisms form a dual-action system. Rabeprazole ensures acid stability, while Domperidone optimizes movement and clearance. This combination supports digestive comfort by minimizing acid build-up while promoting efficient passage of food through the stomach and intestines. It is particularly suited for individuals who face recurring symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, or post-meal fullness due to poor gastric motility or high acid output. This science-backed synergy makes RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE effective for holistic digestive maintenance under medical supervision.

“Quick Fact Highlights” explaining why the dual combination is clinically valued
Clinically synergistic formulation: The combination of Rabeprazole (20 mg) and Domperidone (30 mg SR) works through a dual mechanism, controlling stomach acid while improving gut motility providing faster and more comprehensive relief from acid discomfort
Science-backed acid regulation: Rabeprazole acts at the final step of acid production by blocking the H/K ATPase enzyme, also known as the proton pump. This action significantly reduces acid secretion and maintains optimal pH levels in the stomach for prolonged comfort
Enhanced digestion support: Domperidone increases the movement of the stomach and upper intestinal tract, promoting quicker stomach emptying and minimizing post-meal bloating, nausea, and reflux symptoms
Faster symptom control: Rabeprazole has one of the quickest onset times among proton pump inhibitors, beginning to act within 1 hour of ingestion, offering prompt relief in cases of severe acidity and heartburn
Persistent gastric balance: The sustained-release form of Domperidone maintains smooth motility throughout the day, managing the recurrence of reflux episodes and late-night acidity, a key benefit for individuals with night-time acid reflux or delayed digestion
Improved patient quality of life: This dual approach relieves not just acid discomfort but also digestive sluggishness, making it beneficial for individuals who experience post-meal heaviness, belching, or regurgitation along with acidity
Clinically preferred for complex acid disorders: Physicians often recommend this combination when single-drug therapy (acid suppressants alone) fails to improve acid-related conditions or reflux-associated nausea
Well-tolerated and safety-monitored: The formulation has a proven safety profile when used as prescribed, with side effects such as mild headache or dizziness typically resolving with continued use

How to use RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE

Take the capsule before meals, preferably in the morning, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Swallow the capsule whole with water without crushing or chewing. Regular use under professional guidance ensures optimal results.

1. How to Take RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE Safely

Swallow the capsule whole with water without biting, breaking, or crushing it. The capsule should not be chewed as it is designed for delayed release. It is best taken on an empty stomach for optimal absorption and faster onset of effect. Avoid taking it with caffeinated or acidic drinks.

2. Dosage and Duration

The dosage and duration depend on your medical condition, age, and response to therapy. Most individuals experience benefits with once-daily use, but in some cases, the doctor may recommend twice-daily administration. Continue the capsule for the prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve early.

3. Dosage Guidelines for Adults and Elderly
For most adult users, the typical dosage is one RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption
Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision
Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. Extra caution is advised in those with osteoporosis or history of cardiac arrhythmia, as Domperidone may influence heart rhythm in predisposed individuals

More Information
Why RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE is Doctor-Recommended for “Digestive Balance.”

Digestive discomfort caused by acidity and reflux is often linked to two simultaneous problems excess acid formation and slowed stomach movement.RABEZOL DSR CAPSULE addresses both through a clinically trusted dual mechanism combining Rabeprazole and Domperidone. Doctors recommend this capsule because it supports digestive balance by managing acid levels and enhancing gastric motility, offering smoother stomach function throughout the day.

“Did You Know?” Sidebar: Use small fact highlights like: “Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to late-night meals. Following early dinner routines may reduce reflux frequency”
Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to nighttime eating habits, eating late dinners or snacks within two hours of bedtime significantly increases reflux risk. Having meals earlier in the evening can reduce acid backflow and discomfort.
Meal timing matters: Studies show that eating dinner 3–4 hours before sleep supports better digestion and reduces nighttime acid episodes. Early dining allows the stomach to empty properly before lying down.
Late-night meals affect sleep and metabolism: Research indicates that those who regularly eat after 9 p.m. experience disrupted sleep patterns, slower calorie burning, and more frequent heartburn sensations compared to early eaters.
Fast eating can upset digestive balance: People who eat quickly swallow more air, which increases pressure in the stomach and raises the chance of acid discomfort. Chewing food slowly and mindfully can reduce symptoms and aid smoother digestion.
Simple posture shifts help: Standing or staying upright after meals even for 15–20 minutes can minimize reflux frequency and relieve heaviness. Avoid lying flat immediately after eating.
Diet quality counts: Frequent consumption of spicy, oily, or fried foods can raise stomach acid levels. Choosing gentle foods like oatmeal, bananas, and green vegetables can maintain a neutral digestive pH.
Hydration supports healthy acid balance: Drinking plain water throughout the day dilutes acid concentration naturally. However, sipping slowly instead of gulping helps avoid trapped air and bloating.

introduction:
Introduction About ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE

ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE is a combination of Domperidone and Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used in adults to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumors in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid). ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE is effective in managing peptic ulcer caused either due to stomach infection (H. pylori infection) or due to prolong use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (such as ibuprofen, Aceclofenac etc). It can also be used to manage re-bleeding from the ulcers. GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the acid from the stomach frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE should be taken at least 30 minutes before meals. During management with ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones. ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE Works

ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE contains two medicines namely Domperidone and Esomeprazole. Domperidone works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and the brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Esomeprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).
usageDetails:
How to use ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE

Take ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE 30 minutes to 1 hour before meals or as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ESOMIFYL DSR CAPSULE unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)

It can also be used to manage re-bleeding from the ulcers. GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the acid from the stomach frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

ESYS D CAPSULE should be taken at least 30 minutes before meals. During management with ESYS D CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking ESYS D CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones. ESYS D CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking ESYS D CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ESYS D CAPSULE are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESYS D CAPSULE Works

ESYS D CAPSULE contains two medicines namely Domperidone and Esomeprazole. Domperidone works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and the brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Esomeprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, ESYS D CAPSULE manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

Introduction About RAFRON DSR CAPSULE

RAFRON DSR CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation designed to support stomach comfort and digestive balance. It contains Rabeprazole and Domperidone, two clinically studied components that reduce excessive stomach acid and support smoother digestion. This combination is widely recommended for individuals experiencing symptoms linked to acidity, heartburn, or discomfort after meals.

Along management with RAFRON DSR CAPSULE , try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Some individuals may experience mild effects such as headache, dry mouth, abdominal discomfort, constipation, dizziness, or nausea. These effects are generally temporary. If they persist, contact your healthcare provider for guidance.

Store RAFRON DSR CAPSULE in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep out of reach of children and pets.

mechanismOfAction:
How RAFRON DSR CAPSULE Works

RAFRON DSR CAPSULE works through a dual mechanism. Rabeprazole acts by reducing acid secretion at its source, ensuring a well-balanced gastric environment. Meanwhile, Domperidone restores the normal movement of the stomach and intestines, managing acid backflow and improving food passage for a more comfortable digestive experience.

Dual Mechanism Explained: Acid Control and Gut Movement

1. Acid Control through Rabeprazole:

Rabeprazole belongs to the class of proton pump modulators that reduce acid secretion at its source. Once absorbed in the intestine, it reaches the acid-producing parietal cells in the stomach lining. Here, it selectively and irreversibly binds to the H/K ATPase enzyme system, also known as the proton pump, the final step in acid secretion. By blocking the hydrogen ion exchange process, Rabeprazole manages excessive acid release into the stomach lumen, thereby increasing gastric pH. It acts faster than many other molecules in its class due to its ability to activate at higher pH levels, efficiently reducing acid production even at minimal acidity. This long-acting acid suppression helps relieve common signs of acidity and promotes a stable digestive environment.

2. Gut Movement through Domperidone:

Domperidone supports the mechanical side of digestion by enhancing gastric motility. It selectively blocks dopamine D2 receptors found in the upper gastrointestinal tract, which normally act to slow stomach contractions. By inhibiting these receptors, Domperidone increases the tone of the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), facilitates faster gastric emptying, and decreases the backward flow of food and acid into the esophagus. It also improves intestinal motion, reducing sensations of bloating, heaviness, or delayed digestion after meals, particularly useful for individuals who experience reflux linked to slow gastric transit.

3. Integrated Digestive Action:

Together, these two mechanisms form a dual-action system. Rabeprazole ensures acid stability, while Domperidone optimizes movement and clearance. This combination supports digestive comfort by minimizing acid build-up while promoting efficient passage of food through the stomach and intestines. It is particularly suited for individuals who face recurring symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, or post-meal fullness due to poor gastric motility or high acid output. This science-backed synergy makes RAFRON DSR CAPSULE effective for holistic digestive maintenance under medical supervision.

“Quick Fact Highlights” explaining why the dual combination is clinically valued
Clinically synergistic formulation: The combination of Rabeprazole (20 mg) and Domperidone (30 mg SR) works through a dual mechanism, controlling stomach acid while improving gut motility providing faster and more comprehensive relief from acid discomfort
Science-backed acid regulation: Rabeprazole acts at the final step of acid production by blocking the H/K ATPase enzyme, also known as the proton pump. This action significantly reduces acid secretion and maintains optimal pH levels in the stomach for prolonged comfort
Enhanced digestion support: Domperidone increases the movement of the stomach and upper intestinal tract, promoting quicker stomach emptying and minimizing post-meal bloating, nausea, and reflux symptoms
Faster symptom control: Rabeprazole has one of the quickest onset times among proton pump inhibitors, beginning to act within 1 hour of ingestion, offering prompt relief in cases of severe acidity and heartburn
Persistent gastric balance: The sustained-release form of Domperidone maintains smooth motility throughout the day, managing the recurrence of reflux episodes and late-night acidity, a key benefit for individuals with night-time acid reflux or delayed digestion
Improved patient quality of life: This dual approach relieves not just acid discomfort but also digestive sluggishness, making it beneficial for individuals who experience post-meal heaviness, belching, or regurgitation along with acidity
Clinically preferred for complex acid disorders: Physicians often recommend this combination when single-drug therapy (acid suppressants alone) fails to improve acid-related conditions or reflux-associated nausea
Well-tolerated and safety-monitored: The formulation has a proven safety profile when used as prescribed, with side effects such as mild headache or dizziness typically resolving with continued use

How to use RAFRON DSR CAPSULE

Take the capsule before meals, preferably in the morning, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Swallow the capsule whole with water without crushing or chewing. Regular use under professional guidance ensures optimal results.

1. How to Take RAFRON DSR CAPSULE Safely

Swallow the capsule whole with water without biting, breaking, or crushing it. The capsule should not be chewed as it is designed for delayed release. It is best taken on an empty stomach for optimal absorption and faster onset of effect. Avoid taking it with caffeinated or acidic drinks.

2. Dosage and Duration

The dosage and duration depend on your medical condition, age, and response to therapy. Most individuals experience benefits with once-daily use, but in some cases, the doctor may recommend twice-daily administration. Continue the capsule for the prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve early.

3. Dosage Guidelines for Adults and Elderly
For most adult users, the typical dosage is one RAFRON DSR CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption
Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision
Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. Extra caution is advised in those with osteoporosis or history of cardiac arrhythmia, as Domperidone may influence heart rhythm in predisposed individuals

More Information
Why RAFRON DSR CAPSULE is Doctor-Recommended for “Digestive Balance.”

Digestive discomfort caused by acidity and reflux is often linked to two simultaneous problems excess acid formation and slowed stomach movement.RAFRON DSR CAPSULE addresses both through a clinically trusted dual mechanism combining Rabeprazole and Domperidone. Doctors recommend this capsule because it supports digestive balance by managing acid levels and enhancing gastric motility, offering smoother stomach function throughout the day.

“Did You Know?” Sidebar: Use small fact highlights like: “Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to late-night meals. Following early dinner routines may reduce reflux frequency”
Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to nighttime eating habits, eating late dinners or snacks within two hours of bedtime significantly increases reflux risk. Having meals earlier in the evening can reduce acid backflow and discomfort.
Meal timing matters: Studies show that eating dinner 3–4 hours before sleep supports better digestion and reduces nighttime acid episodes. Early dining allows the stomach to empty properly before lying down.
Late-night meals affect sleep and metabolism: Research indicates that those who regularly eat after 9 p.m. experience disrupted sleep patterns, slower calorie burning, and more frequent heartburn sensations compared to early eaters.
Fast eating can upset digestive balance: People who eat quickly swallow more air, which increases pressure in the stomach and raises the chance of acid discomfort. Chewing food slowly and mindfully can reduce symptoms and aid smoother digestion.
Simple posture shifts help: Standing or staying upright after meals even for 15–20 minutes can minimize reflux frequency and relieve heaviness. Avoid lying flat immediately after eating.
Diet quality counts: Frequent consumption of spicy, oily, or fried foods can raise stomach acid levels. Choosing gentle foods like oatmeal, bananas, and green vegetables can maintain a neutral digestive pH.
Hydration supports healthy acid balance: Drinking plain water throughout the day dilutes acid concentration naturally. However, sipping slowly instead of gulping helps avoid trapped air and bloating.

introduction:
Introduction About ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE

ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE is a combination of Domperidone and Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used in adults to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumors in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid). ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE is effective in managing peptic ulcer caused either due to stomach infection (H. pylori infection) or due to prolong use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (such as ibuprofen, Aceclofenac etc). It can also be used to manage re-bleeding from the ulcers. GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the acid from the stomach frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE should be taken at least 30 minutes before meals. During management with ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones. ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

usesDetails:

Peptic ulcers

mechanismOfAction:
How ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE Works

ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE contains two medicines namely Domperidone and Esomeprazole. Domperidone works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and the brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Esomeprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).
usageDetails:
How to use ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE

Take ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE 30 minutes to 1 hour before meals or as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE unless your doctor advice you to stop.

warnings.details: ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.

ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE does not affect your ability in driving or handling heavy tools or machines. However, do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE, as it could aggravate your existing condition.
ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE if you are allergic to Domperidone, Esomeprazole or to any other proton pump inhibitors (such as rabeprazole, pantoprazole).

ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having heart problems (such as prolongation of QT wave, congestive heart failure or arrhythmia). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. However, consult your doctor before taking it.
ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have bloody stools or bleeding in the gut
Have blockage or tear in the intestines
Have severe fluid or electrolyte disturbances
Have prolactinoma (a non-cancerous tumor of pituitary gland)
Have low blood potassium or magnesium levels
Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)

Before taking ESOBIZ DSR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you:

Have osteoporosis
Have vitamin B12 deficiency (sore tongue, mouth ulcers, pale skin, depression)
Are going to test Chromogranin A level

introduction:
Introduction About ULGEL ELAICHI FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION

ULGEL ELAICHI FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION is a combination of Magaldrate and Simethicone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antacids and Anti-flatulent agents, respectively. It is used for the management of heartburn (burning sensation in the chest due to stomach acid travelling up towards the throat), hyperacidity (excess acidity in the stomach), indigestion, flatulence (expulsion of gas out of the body's intestines via the anus), bloating (buildup of gas in the stomach and intestines), and sour stomach.

It is also used to manage esophagitis (inflammation of the lining of the esophagus) or gastritis (inflammation of the lining of the stomach), stomach or stress ulcers (open sores that develop on the lining of the stomach, which may also occur due to stress), and gastroesophageal reflux (a condition in which the stomach contents move up into the esophagus (food pipe).

Avoid alcohol and carbonated drinks and reduce intake of citrus fruit juices and caffeine to reduce acidity and gas problems. Also try to maintain a healthy diet plan with adequate sleep to get better results.

ULGEL ELAICHI FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with high magnesium levels in blood, low phosphate levels in the blood, diarrhea, and severe liver or kidney impairment.

Before taking ULGEL ELAICHI FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems, appendicitis, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, bowel blockage, rectal bleeding of unknown cause, a magnesium-restricted diet, and if you have a surgical history of bowel surgery.

ULGEL ELAICHI FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION should be used in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor. Consult your child’s doctor for advice before giving ULGEL ELAICHI FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION to your child.

The most common side effects of taking ULGEL ELAICHI FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION are diarrhea, constipation, and chalky taste. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen or bother you.

ULGEL ELAICHI FLAVOUR ORAL SUSPENSION contains magaldrate and simethicone, where magaldrate works by neutralizing the pH of gastric acid in the stomach and suppressing the symptoms of acid-reflux-related issues. Simethicone is an anti-flatulent agent that works by breaking up gas bubbles, and it helps the gas to be eliminated easier.

introduction:
Introduction About REKOOL 20MG TABLET

REKOOL 20MG TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take REKOOL 20MG TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking REKOOL 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take REKOOL 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking REKOOL 20MG TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking REKOOL 20MG TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of REKOOL 20MG TABLET
Manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease
Manage and Manages Peptic ulcers
Manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How REKOOL 20MG TABLET Works

REKOOL 20MG TABLET is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.
usageDetails:
How to use REKOOL 20MG TABLET

Take REKOOL 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken in the mornings or at any time of the day before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Auxisoda DS Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AUXISODA DS TABLET

Auxisoda DS Tablet is an alkalizer used to manage indigestion, acidity, and metabolic acidosis (a condition in which the acid amount in body fluid is increased) due to severe kidney disorder, uncontrolled diabetes, severe lactic acidosis, or severe dehydration. It is also a urine alkalizing agent. It contains Sodium Bicarbonate as an active ingredient that raises blood pH and decreases acidosis.

Sodium bicarbonate works by increasing plasma bicarbonate levels, which buffers excess hydrogen ion concentration and increases the pH and hence relieving symptoms of acidity and metabolic acidosis.

Always take Auxisoda DS Tablet as directed by your doctor. Swallow the tablet as a whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the tablet. Take it one to four times daily (for moderate metabolic acidosis). Do not exceed the daily recommended dosages.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of AUXISODA DS TABLET

Auxisoda DS tablet is very less likely to cause any side effects but consult your doctor immediately in case you experience any side effects or allergic reaction after taking this medication.

name: Rabitec DSR 20/30mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RABITEC DSR 20/30MG CAPSULE

RABITEC DSR 20/30MG CAPSULE is used to manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) among patients who have not responded adequately to rabeprazole alone. It is a combination of Domperidone and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine Antagonists and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It can also be used to manage peptic ulcers caused by H. pylori infection or NSAIDs use.

Along management with RABITEC DSR 20/30MG CAPSULE, try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Before taking RABITEC DSR 20/30MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Your doctor may reduce the dose or suggest an alternative therapy. It is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged less than 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RABITEC DSR 20/30MG CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Peptic ulcer
Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD)
mechanismOfAction:
How RABITEC DSR 20/30MG CAPSULE Works

RABITEC DSR 20/30MG CAPSULE reduces stomach ulcers and acid reflux, where Rabeprazole acts by inhibiting the secretions of stomach acid and Domperidone acts by increasing bowel movements and facilitating gastric emptying, thus leading to rapid symptom relief and healing of stomach ulcers and esophageal lesions.

introduction:
Introduction About RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE

RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation designed to support stomach comfort and digestive balance. It contains Rabeprazole and Domperidone, two clinically studied components that reduce excessive stomach acid and support smoother digestion. This combination is widely recommended for individuals experiencing symptoms linked to acidity, heartburn, or discomfort after meals.

Along management with RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE , try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Some individuals may experience mild effects such as headache, dry mouth, abdominal discomfort, constipation, dizziness, or nausea. These effects are generally temporary. If they persist, contact your healthcare provider for guidance.

Store RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep out of reach of children and pets.

Uses Of RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE
Used to support stomach comfort and digestive balance
mechanismOfAction:
How RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE Works

RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE works through a dual mechanism. Rabeprazole acts by reducing acid secretion at its source, ensuring a well-balanced gastric environment. Meanwhile, Domperidone restores the normal movement of the stomach and intestines, managing acid backflow and improving food passage for a more comfortable digestive experience.

Dual Mechanism Explained: Acid Control and Gut Movement

1. Acid Control through Rabeprazole:

Rabeprazole belongs to the class of proton pump modulators that reduce acid secretion at its source. Once absorbed in the intestine, it reaches the acid-producing parietal cells in the stomach lining. Here, it selectively and irreversibly binds to the H/K ATPase enzyme system, also known as the proton pump, the final step in acid secretion. By blocking the hydrogen ion exchange process, Rabeprazole manages excessive acid release into the stomach lumen, thereby increasing gastric pH. It acts faster than many other molecules in its class due to its ability to activate at higher pH levels, efficiently reducing acid production even at minimal acidity. This long-acting acid suppression helps relieve common signs of acidity and promotes a stable digestive environment.

2. Gut Movement through Domperidone:

Domperidone supports the mechanical side of digestion by enhancing gastric motility. It selectively blocks dopamine D2 receptors found in the upper gastrointestinal tract, which normally act to slow stomach contractions. By inhibiting these receptors, Domperidone increases the tone of the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), facilitates faster gastric emptying, and decreases the backward flow of food and acid into the esophagus. It also improves intestinal motion, reducing sensations of bloating, heaviness, or delayed digestion after meals, particularly useful for individuals who experience reflux linked to slow gastric transit.

3. Integrated Digestive Action:

Together, these two mechanisms form a dual-action system. Rabeprazole ensures acid stability, while Domperidone optimizes movement and clearance. This combination supports digestive comfort by minimizing acid build-up while promoting efficient passage of food through the stomach and intestines. It is particularly suited for individuals who face recurring symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, or post-meal fullness due to poor gastric motility or high acid output. This science-backed synergy makes RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE effective for holistic digestive maintenance under medical supervision.

“Quick Fact Highlights” explaining why the dual combination is clinically valued
Clinically synergistic formulation: The combination of Rabeprazole (20 mg) and Domperidone (30 mg SR) works through a dual mechanism, controlling stomach acid while improving gut motility providing faster and more comprehensive relief from acid discomfort
Science-backed acid regulation: Rabeprazole acts at the final step of acid production by blocking the H/K ATPase enzyme, also known as the proton pump. This action significantly reduces acid secretion and maintains optimal pH levels in the stomach for prolonged comfort
Enhanced digestion support: Domperidone increases the movement of the stomach and upper intestinal tract, promoting quicker stomach emptying and minimizing post-meal bloating, nausea, and reflux symptoms
Faster symptom control: Rabeprazole has one of the quickest onset times among proton pump inhibitors, beginning to act within 1 hour of ingestion, offering prompt relief in cases of severe acidity and heartburn
Persistent gastric balance: The sustained-release form of Domperidone maintains smooth motility throughout the day, managing the recurrence of reflux episodes and late-night acidity, a key benefit for individuals with night-time acid reflux or delayed digestion
Improved patient quality of life: This dual approach relieves not just acid discomfort but also digestive sluggishness, making it beneficial for individuals who experience post-meal heaviness, belching, or regurgitation along with acidity
Clinically preferred for complex acid disorders: Physicians often recommend this combination when single-drug therapy (acid suppressants alone) fails to improve acid-related conditions or reflux-associated nausea
Well-tolerated and safety-monitored: The formulation has a proven safety profile when used as prescribed, with side effects such as mild headache or dizziness typically resolving with continued use
usageInstructions: For most adult users, the typical dosage is one RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption

Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision

Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. Extra caution is advised in those with osteoporosis or history of cardiac arrhythmia, as Domperidone may influence heart rhythm in predisposed individuals

How to use RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE

Take the capsule before meals, preferably in the morning, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Swallow the capsule whole with water without crushing or chewing. Regular use under professional guidance ensures optimal results.

1. How to Take RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE Safely

Swallow the capsule whole with water without biting, breaking, or crushing it. The capsule should not be chewed as it is designed for delayed release. It is best taken on an empty stomach for optimal absorption and faster onset of effect. Avoid taking it with caffeinated or acidic drinks.

2. Dosage and Duration

The dosage and duration depend on your medical condition, age, and response to therapy. Most individuals experience benefits with once-daily use, but in some cases, the doctor may recommend twice-daily administration. Continue the capsule for the prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve early.

3. Dosage Guidelines for Adults and Elderly
For most adult users, the typical dosage is one RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption
Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision

Extra caution is advised in those with osteoporosis or history of cardiac arrhythmia, as Domperidone may influence heart rhythm in predisposed individuals

More Information
Why RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE is Doctor-Recommended for “Digestive Balance.”

Digestive discomfort caused by acidity and reflux is often linked to two simultaneous problems excess acid formation and slowed stomach movement.RABEPRIDE D CAPSULE addresses both through a clinically trusted dual mechanism combining Rabeprazole and Domperidone. Doctors recommend this capsule because it supports digestive balance by managing acid levels and enhancing gastric motility, offering smoother stomach function throughout the day.

“Did You Know?” Sidebar: Use small fact highlights like: “Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to late-night meals. Following early dinner routines may reduce reflux frequency”
Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to nighttime eating habits, eating late dinners or snacks within two hours of bedtime significantly increases reflux risk. Having meals earlier in the evening can reduce acid backflow and discomfort.
Meal timing matters: Studies show that eating dinner 3–4 hours before sleep supports better digestion and reduces nighttime acid episodes. Early dining allows the stomach to empty properly before lying down.
Late-night meals affect sleep and metabolism: Research indicates that those who regularly eat after 9 p.m. experience disrupted sleep patterns, slower calorie burning, and more frequent heartburn sensations compared to early eaters.
Fast eating can upset digestive balance: People who eat quickly swallow more air, which increases pressure in the stomach and raises the chance of acid discomfort. Chewing food slowly and mindfully can reduce symptoms and aid smoother digestion.
Simple posture shifts help: Standing or staying upright after meals even for 15–20 minutes can minimize reflux frequency and relieve heaviness. Avoid lying flat immediately after eating.
Diet quality counts: Frequent consumption of spicy, oily, or fried foods can raise stomach acid levels. Choosing gentle foods like oatmeal, bananas, and green vegetables can maintain a neutral digestive pH.
Hydration supports healthy acid balance: Drinking plain water throughout the day dilutes acid concentration naturally. However, sipping slowly instead of gulping helps avoid trapped air and bloating.

introduction:
Introduction About ACIZO 500MG TABLET

ACIZO 500mg Tablet is an alkalinizing agent used to correct metabolic acidosis (increased acidity of blood and urine). It can also be used as a replacement therapy for patients suffering from severe diarrhea and can manage injection site irritation in patients receiving IV fluids or injections.

It contains sodium bicarbonate as the active ingredient which is a base (alkaline) compound. Following consumption, sodium bicarbonate restores the pH of blood and urine to the normal levels and reverses the clinical manifestations of metabolic acidosis.

Use ACIZO 500mg Tablet only as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage.

Before taking ACIZO 500mg Tablet, inform your doctor if you have breathing problems, heart problems, kidney problems, liver problems, high blood pressure, high blood sodium levels or swollen foot or ankles. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

Do not take ACIZO 500mg Tablet if you have metabolic alkalosis (increased pH of blood and urine), excessive vomiting or hypocalcemia (low blood calcium levels) or if you are undergoing continuous gastrointestinal suction.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are nausea, vomiting, headache, muscle pain, constipation, dry mouth, increased thirst, skin ulcerations, tiredness and edema. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

introduction:
Introduction About ESOMEZA DSR CAPSULE

ESOMEZA DSR CAPSULE is a combination of Domperidone and Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used in adults to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumors in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid). ESOMEZA DSR CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

ESOMEZA DSR CAPSULE is effective in managing peptic ulcer caused either due to stomach infection (H. pylori infection) or due to prolong use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (such as ibuprofen, Aceclofenac etc). It can also be used to manage re-bleeding from the ulcers. GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the acid from the stomach frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

ESOMEZA DSR CAPSULE should be taken at least 30 minutes before meals. During management with ESOMEZA DSR CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESOMEZA DSR CAPSULE Works

ESOMEZA DSR CAPSULE contains two medicines namely Domperidone and Esomeprazole. Domperidone works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and the brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Esomeprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, ESOMEZA DSR CAPSULE manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

Introduction About PANTAKIND DSR CAPSULE

Pantakind DSR Capsule combines Pantoprazole and Domperidone. It is often advised to support digestive comfort in individuals experiencing symptoms such as acidity, gas, or a heavy stomach (peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis). It works by reducing stomach acid and helping with gut motility.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. Your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking PANTAKIND DSR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems, blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

PANTAKIND DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking PANTAKIND DSR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence.

Inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).
