introduction:
Introduction About FASTPAN D

FASTPAN D is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. FASTPAN D acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with FASTPAN D your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking FASTPAN D inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

FASTPAN D is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking FASTPAN D if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

usesDetails:
Uses Of FASTPAN D

It is used to manage:

Peptic ulcer
Gastrointestinal Reflux disease (GERD)
Reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the esophagus)
Nausea and Vomiting
Acidity, Heartburn
Signs of indigestion (such as burping, bloating)
mechanismOfAction:
How FASTPAN D Works

FASTPAN D contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, FASTPAN D it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

introduction:
Introduction About REBEZ D TABLET

REBEZ D TABLET is used to manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) among patients who have not responded adequately to rabeprazole alone. It is a combination of Domperidone and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine Antagonists and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It can also be used to manage peptic ulcers caused by H. pylori infection or NSAIDs use.

Along management with REBEZ D TABLET, try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Before taking REBEZ D TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Your doctor may reduce the dose or suggest an alternative therapy. It is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged less than 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects worsen.

Introduction About RABEZOL IT CAPSULE

RABEZOL IT CAPSULE is a combination of Itopride and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Gastroprokinetic agent and Proton-pump inhibitors respectively. It is used to manage Gastroesophageal reflux disease (acid reflux) and Peptic ulcer disease.

Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a digestive disorder that occurs when acidic stomach juices or food and fluids back up from the stomach into the oesophagus.

Peptic ulcers are open sores that develop on the inside lining of stomach and the upper portion of small intestine. Rarely, peptic ulcer may develop just above your stomach in your oesophagus. The most common symptom of a peptic ulcer is stomach pain.

Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you have heart disease, liver disease or kidney disease. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before taking this medicine.

There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children and adultescents. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

RABEZOL IT CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects are stomach pain, headache, constipation, diarrhoea, dizziness, and rash. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.

Gastroesophageal reflux disease (acid reflux)

mechanismOfAction:
How RABEZOL IT CAPSULE Works

RABEZOL IT CAPSULE is a combination of Itopride and Rabeprazole. Itopride works by on the region in the brain that controls vomiting and also acts on the upper digestive tract and helps food move more easily through the stomach. Rabeprazole works by reducing the amount of acid in the stomach which helps to relieve acid-related indigestion and heartburn.

Take RABEZOL IT CAPSULE as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine as a whole and do not crush or chew the medicine. Take it preferably 30 minutes before food. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About VISCO TABLET

VISCO TABLET is a combination of Alginic acid, Aluminium hydroxide, Magnesium and Simethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antacids, Gastrointestinal agents and Saline laxatives respectively. It is used for the management of acidity, indigestion, heart burn, excess gas and stomach ulcer. Stomach ulcer is a condition in which painful area develops in the inner lining of stomach, small intestine, and oesophagus.

VISCO TABLET is not recommended for use in children and in patients suffering from kidney diseases, heart disease such as slower heart rate (bradycardia), low levels of phosphate in blood. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

Before taking VISCO TABLET inform your doctor if you are pregnant, breast feeding, having diabetes, blood disorder (porphyria) and fructose intolerance. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine. The most common side effects of taking VISCO TABLET includes nausea, vomiting, constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How VISCO TABLET Works

VISCO TABLET is a combination of Alginic acid, Aluminium hydroxide, Magnesium and Simethicone. Aluminium hydroxide and Magnesium lowers the amount of acid present in stomach by neutralizing excess stomach acid produced due to indigestion. Alginic acid relieves heartburn by decreasing the chances of backward flow of liquid from stomach into oesophagus after eating (postprandial upright gastroesophageal reflex) in upright position. Simethicone relieves bloating and stomach pain due to excess gas by blocking foam, breaks out gas bubbles in gut and removing gas from stomach. Antacids has viscoelastic features like gastric mucin and may afford mucosal protection by its ability to maintain or mimic the barrier properties of gastric mucus, thus it helps in management of peptic ulcer.

Take VISCO TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GERDONIL 40 TABLET

GERDONIL 40 TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking GERDONIL 40 TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking GERDONIL 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How GERDONIL 40 TABLET Works

GERDONIL 40 TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why GERDONIL 40 TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
GERDONIL 40 TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take GERDONIL 40 TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

01.What makes GERDONIL 40 TABLET a preferred choice over other medications?
Potent and Long-Lasting Acid Suppression: GERDONIL 40 TABLET contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively blocks the final step of stomach acid production, providing stronger and longer-lasting relief from symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, and indigestion compared to H2 blockers or antacids.

Well-Studied and Trusted: Pantoprazole, the active ingredient, is widely used and supported by extensive clinical experience, ensuring both efficacy and safety for a broad range of patients.

These advantages make GERDONIL 40 TABLET a reliable and effective option for both short-term relief and long-term management of acid-related disorders, often outperforming less potent or shorter-acting alternatives.

introduction:
Introduction About RABIBIT DM TABLET

RABIBIT DM TABLET is used to manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) among patients who have not responded adequately to rabeprazole alone. It is a combination of Domperidone and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine Antagonists and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It can also be used to manage peptic ulcers caused by H. pylori infection or NSAIDs use.

Along management with RABIBIT DM TABLET, try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Before taking RABIBIT DM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Your doctor may reduce the dose or suggest an alternative therapy. It is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged less than 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About O MACC DM CAPSULE

O MACC DM CAPSULE is a combination of Domperidone and Omeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

O MACC DM CAPSULE is effective in managing peptic ulcer caused either due to stomach infection (H. pylori infection) or due to prolong use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (such as ibuprofen, aceclofenac). O MACC DM CAPSULEacts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn. O MACC DM CAPSULEis suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 12 years or above weighing 35 kg or more). It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with O MACC DM CAPSULEyour doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking O MACC DM CAPSULEinform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones. O MACC DM CAPSULEis not recommended for use in patients having bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking O MACC DM CAPSULEif you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking O MACC DM CAPSULEare dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any abnormal signs such as unusual tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat, fragile bones, bloody stools or vomits or sudden weight loss.

mechanismOfAction:
How O MACC DM CAPSULE Works

O MACC DM CAPSULE contains two medicines namely domperidone and omeprazole. Domperidone works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centres and the brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Omeprazole is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, O MACC DM CAPSULEmanages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

Do not stop taking O MACC DM CAPSULEunless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE

ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE is a medication used to manage acid reflux, heartburn, GERD, and stomach ulcers. It contains two active ingredients such as domperidone and esomeprazole which work together to reduce acid secretion and improve digestion.

ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE should be taken as prescribed by your doctor, typically on an empty stomach. The dosage and duration will vary depending on your condition and how you respond to the medication. It is important to continue the management for as long as recommended by your doctor, as stopping too soon may cause your symptoms to return or worsen. Be sure to inform your doctor about any other medications you are taking, as some may interact with this medicine.

Common side effects of ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE include headache, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation, flatulence (gas), skin rash or irritation, dryness in mouth. Most of these side effects are temporary and typically resolve over time. However, if you are concerned about any of them, contact your doctor immediately. This medication may also cause drowsiness and dizziness, so avoid driving or engaging in activities that require focus until you are familiar with how it affects you. It is also important to refrain from drinking alcohol while using this medication, as it can increase sleepiness. To improve results, consider lifestyle changes such as drinking cold milk and avoiding hot tea, coffee, spicy foods, or chocolate.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Additionally, let your doctor know if you have any liver conditions so that they can adjust the dosage accordingly.

How ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE Works

Domperidone is a dopamine antagonist that works by increasing the movement of the stomach and intestines, helping to relieve symptoms like nausea, vomiting, and bloating. Esomeprazole is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that reduces the production of stomach acid by blocking the proton pumps in the stomach lining, thus helping to treat conditions like acid reflux, GERD (gastroesophageal reflux disease), and ulcers. Together, they work synergistically to alleviate digestive discomfort, improve gastric motility, and reduce acid-related issues.

02. Is ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE better than other heartburn medications like Zantac or Nexium?

When comparing ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE with other heartburn medications like Zantac (ranitidine) and Nexium (Esomeprazole), there are a few factors to consider:

Mechanism of Action:
ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE: Esomeprazole works by reducing stomach acid production, while Domperidone helps with gastric emptying and prevents nausea. The combination is particularly useful for people who suffer from both acid reflux and delayed gastric emptying.
Zantac (Ranitidine): Zantac is an H2 blocker that reduces acid production by blocking histamine receptors in the stomach. It works differently from PPIs like Esomeprazole and is usually less potent.
Nexium (Esomeprazole): Nexium is a PPI like Esomeprazole in ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE, and it is typically used for reducing stomach acid production. It is generally more effective at suppressing acid than H2 blockers like Zantac.
Effectiveness:
ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE may be more effective for people who experience both heartburn and gastrointestinal motility issues (delayed stomach emptying or nausea). The Domperidone component can be particularly beneficial in these cases.
Nexium is a stronger PPI and may provide more potent acid suppression than Zantac and is often used for conditions like GERD (gastroesophageal reflux disease).
Zantac may be effective for mild to moderate heartburn but typically doesn't suppress acid production as effectively as PPIs.
Side Effects:
ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE: Esomeprazole can have side effects like headaches, diarrhea, and potential long-term risks if used for extended periods (e.g., osteoporosis, kidney issues). Domperidone may cause side effects like dry mouth, dizziness, or an increased risk of heart problems in certain people.
Zantac: While Zantac was commonly used for heartburn, recent concerns about its safety (due to potential links to cancer-causing substances) have led to its removal from the market in some regions.
Nexium: Similar to other PPIs, it may cause side effects like stomach infections, magnesium deficiency, and potential kidney problems with long-term use.
Target Use:
ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE is often prescribed for people with more complex symptoms, such as those who experience both acid reflux and gastric motility issues.
Zantac is usually used for milder forms of heartburn, though it is being phased out in some places due to safety concerns.
Nexium is effective for long-term acid suppression and is used in treating conditions like GERD, ulcers, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.

Conclusion:

ZOMSET D 40 CAPSULE may be more suitable for individuals who need both acid suppression and help with gastric motility (like nausea or delayed stomach emptying).
Nexium is generally considered more effective for acid suppression than Zantac, making it a good choice for more severe or chronic heartburn.
Zantac, while effective for milder heartburn, has safety concerns and is no longer widely recommended.

name: MAC 20mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MAC 20MG TABLET

MAC 20MG TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take MAC 20MG TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking MAC 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take MAC 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking MAC 20MG TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking MAC 20MG TABLET.
usesDetails:

Manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease

Manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How MAC 20MG TABLET Works

MAC 20MG TABLET is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.
usageDetails:
How to use MAC 20MG TABLET

Take MAC 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken in the mornings or at any time of the day before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SPSON 40MG CAPSULE

SPSON 40MG CAPSULE contains Esomeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used for the management of Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) heartburn in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. SPSON 40MG CAPSULE also helps in managing stomach ulcers or upper part of the gut (intestine) that are infected with Helicobacter pylori bacteria and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) medicines in adults and in adolescents above 12 years of age. It is also used to manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (too much acid produced in the stomach caused by a growth in the pancreas).

GERD is a disease where acid from the stomach escapes into the tube which connects your throat to your stomach (oesophagus) causing pain and inflammation.

SPSON 40MG CAPSULE is not recommended to be taken in patients with severe kidney and liver failure. SPSON 40MG CAPSULE should be taken only if considered clearly necessary by your doctor in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

SPSON 40MG CAPSULE is not recommended for children and adolescents aged less than 12 years. Consult your doctor for advice before taking the medicine.

The most common side effects of taking SPSON 40MG CAPSULE are headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, constipation, flatulence, nausea and vomiting. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsens with time.

Introduction About PANLORD 40MG TABLET

PANLORD 40MG TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking PANLORD 40MG TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking PANLORD 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How PANLORD 40MG TABLET Works

PANLORD 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why PANLORD 40MG TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
PANLORD 40MG TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take PANLORD 40MG TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

01.What makes PANLORD 40MG TABLET a preferred choice over other medications?
Potent and Long-Lasting Acid Suppression: PANLORD 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively blocks the final step of stomach acid production, providing stronger and longer-lasting relief from symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, and indigestion compared to H2 blockers or antacids.
Comprehensive Symptom Relief and Healing: It not only relieves discomfort from acid-related conditions but also promotes healing of stomach and duodenal ulcers, and helps manage more severe conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
Lowering with Painkiller Use: PANLORD 40MG TABLET is recommended for lowering stomach ulcers and acidity in patients who require long-term use of painkillers (NSAIDs), a benefit not offered by all acid-reducing medicines.
Convenient Once-Daily Dosing: Its long duration of action allows for once-daily dosing, making it easier for patients to adhere to treatment and maintain consistent acid control.
Favorable Tolerability Profile: Most side effects are mild and temporary, such as headache, nausea, or diarrhea. Serious side effects are rare when used as directed, and the risk of complications can be minimized with appropriate monitoring.
Well-Studied and Trusted: Pantoprazole, the active ingredient, is widely used and supported by extensive clinical experience, ensuring both efficacy and safety for a broad range of patients.

These advantages make PANLORD 40MG TABLET a reliable and effective option for both short-term relief and long-term management of acid-related disorders, often outperforming less potent or shorter-acting alternatives.

introduction:
Introduction About MIOKOOL 40 TABLET

MIOKOOL 40 TABLET, containing esomeprazole, is widely chosen by individuals seeking relief from persistent acidity, heartburn, and acid reflux symptoms. It is especially useful for those experiencing discomfort due to gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcers, erosive esophagitis, or conditions involving excessive stomach acid production such as Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. By blocking the proton pumps in the stomach lining, esomeprazole effectively reduces acid secretion, promoting healing of the stomach and esophageal lining and improving overall digestive comfort. 

This tablet is ideal for adults and can also be considered for use in elderly patients, pregnant or breastfeeding women, and those with kidney or liver conditions, though it should only be used under medical supervision in these groups. MIOKOOL 40 TABLET is generally taken once daily, preferably before meals, and should be swallowed whole with water—crushing or chewing the tablet is not recommended for optimal absorption. Consistency in timing and adherence to the prescribed duration are important for achieving the best results. 

Patients are advised to inform their healthcare provider about any existing allergies, liver problems, or plans for pregnancy or breastfeeding before starting MIOKOOL 40 TABLET. It is important to avoid alcohol and certain foods that may worsen acidity, and to be cautious about potential interactions with other medications such as blood thinners, antifungals, and anti-HIV drugs. Prolonged use may lead to deficiencies in vitamin B12, calcium, or magnesium, and may increase the risk of bone thinning (osteoporosis). If you experience symptoms like severe stomach pain, black stools, or allergic reactions, immediate medical attention is necessary. 

During pregnancy and breastfeeding, MIOKOOL 40 TABLET may be used if clearly needed and prescribed by a doctor, as current evidence suggests safety but emphasizes the importance of medical guidance. Common side effects include headache, nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, dizziness, and flatulence. Most side effects are mild and temporary, but any persistent or severe symptoms should be reported to your healthcare provider.

How MIOKOOL 40 TABLET Works
How Does MIOKOOL 40 TABLET Reduce Stomach Acid

MIOKOOL 40 TABLET contains esomeprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively lowers stomach acid production. It works by blocking the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, located in the stomach lining. This enzyme is responsible for the final step in the secretion of gastric acid. By inhibiting this pump, MIOKOOL 40 TABLET significantly reduces both basal and stimulated acid secretion, providing long-lasting acid suppression and promoting the healing of acid-related conditions

MIOKOOL 40 TABLET action in acid reflux

In acid reflux, stomach acid flows back into the esophagus, causing symptoms like heartburn and discomfort. MIOKOOL 40 TABLET helps manage these symptoms by decreasing the amount of acid produced in the stomach. This reduction in acid not only relieves the burning sensation but also helps protect the esophageal lining from further irritation and damage. The tablet is usually taken before meals for optimal effectiveness, as recommended by healthcare professionals

MIOKOOL 40 TABLET mode of action in peptic ulcer

Peptic ulcers develop when the stomach lining is damaged by excess acid. MIOKOOL 40 TABLET aids in the healing process by suppressing gastric acid secretion through inhibition of the proton pump. With lower acid levels, the ulcerated tissue is given a better environment to recover, reducing pain and the risk of complications. Regular use as directed by a healthcare provider supports ulcer healing and helps prevent recurrence

Is MIOKOOL 40 TABLET More Effective Than H2 Blockers for GERD?

MIOKOOL 40 TABLET (esomeprazole) is generally considered more effective than H2 blockers (H2-receptor antagonists) for treating GERD. Proton pump inhibitors like MIOKOOL 40 TABLET suppress stomach acid more profoundly and for a longer duration than H2 blockers. Clinical studies show that PPIs provide symptomatic relief in about 83% of GERD patients, compared to 60% with H2 blockers. Additionally, healing rates for esophagitis are significantly higher with PPIs—about 78% versus 50% with H2 blockers. This greater efficacy is because PPIs block the final step of acid production, while H2 blockers only partially reduce acid and are less effective, especially after meals. For most patients with moderate to severe GERD, MIOKOOL 40 TABLET is preferred for both symptom control and healing of the esophagus.

introduction:
Introduction About DEXOL D CAPSULE

DEXOL D CAPSULE is a combination of Domperidone and Dexrabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used to manage stomach ulcers (gastric or peptic ulcers) and gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD; acid reflux causing irritation of food pipe).

It can also be used to reduce the signs of acidity, heartburn, indigestion, burping or bloating. It is typically used among patients who are not responding adequately to therapy with dexrabeprazole alone.

DEXOL D CAPSULE should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with DEXOL D CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking DEXOL D CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

DEXOL D CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having bleeding from the gut. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking DEXOL D CAPSULE are dry mouth, cough, sore throat, runny nose, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, flatulence and increased signs of infections. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DEXOL D CAPSULE Works

DEXOL D CAPSULE contains two medicines namely domperidone and Dexrabeprazole. Domperidone stimulates the gut and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. This action reduces chances for acid reflux and manages the irritation of food pipe. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting.

Dexrabeprazole is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces gastric acid secretion which promotes the healing of ulcers and esophageal lesions. It also provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of the GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

introduction:
Introduction About GELUSIL MPS XTRA COOL SUSPENSION

Gelusil MPS Xtra Cool Suspension is an Antacid and Antigas liquid used to relieve symptoms of hyperacidity such as heart burn, epigastric discomfort, that are usually associated with indigestion, peptic ulcer, gastritis (inflammation of the stomach), peptic esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophagus) and hiatus hernia (part of the stomach moves up into the chest). Gelusil MPS Xtra Cool Suspension is also used to relieve flatulence (gas). It contains activated dimethicone, dried aluminium hydroxide and magnesium hydroxide as an active ingredients.

Aluminium hydroxide and magnesium hydroxide both are antacids work by neutralizing the stomach's acid and provides relief from hyperacidity. Activated dimethicone is an antifoaming agent that decreases acid reflux and acts as an antiflatulent which eliminates the trapped gas in the stomach and intestine, thus relieves bloating.

Always take Gelusil MPS Xtra Cool Suspension as advised by the physician. Shake well before use. Take 1-2 teaspoonfuls (approximately 5-10 ml) 30-60 minutes after meals or whenever symptoms appear. Do not take more than 10 teaspoonfuls (50ml) of Gelusil MPS Xtra Cool Suspension in a 24-hour period or do not use for more than 2 weeks, except under the advice of your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About POLE 40MG TABLET

POLE 40MG TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking POLE 40MG TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking POLE 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How POLE 40MG TABLET Works

POLE 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why POLE 40MG TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
POLE 40MG TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take POLE 40MG TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

More Information
01.What makes POLE 40MG TABLET a preferred choice over other medications?
Potent and Long-Lasting Acid Suppression: POLE 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively blocks the final step of stomach acid production, providing stronger and longer-lasting relief from symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, and indigestion compared to H2 blockers or antacids.
Comprehensive Symptom Relief and Healing: It not only relieves discomfort from acid-related conditions but also promotes healing of stomach and duodenal ulcers, and helps manage more severe conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
Lowering with Painkiller Use: POLE 40MG TABLET is recommended for lowering stomach ulcers and acidity in patients who require long-term use of painkillers (NSAIDs), a benefit not offered by all acid-reducing medicines.
Convenient Once-Daily Dosing: Its long duration of action allows for once-daily dosing, making it easier for patients to adhere to treatment and maintain consistent acid control.
Favorable Tolerability Profile: Most side effects are mild and temporary, such as headache, nausea, or diarrhea. Serious side effects are rare when used as directed, and the risk of complications can be minimized with appropriate monitoring.
Well-Studied and Trusted: Pantoprazole, the active ingredient, is widely used and supported by extensive clinical experience, ensuring both efficacy and safety for a broad range of patients.

Before taking PANPRAZ D CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

PANPRAZ D CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking PANPRAZ D CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

mechanismOfAction:
How PANPRAZ D CAPSULE Works

PANPRAZ D CAPSULE contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, PANPRAZ D CAPSULE it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

warnings.details: PANPRAZ D CAPSULE should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician.
PANPRAZ D CAPSULE may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it should be used in breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician.
PANPRAZ D CAPSULE does not affect your ability in driving or handling heavy tools or machines. However, do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by the medicine.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking PANPRAZ D CAPSULE, as it could aggravate your existing condition.
PANPRAZ D CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems.
PANPRAZ D CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with moderate or severe liver impairment. It should be used with caution in patients with other mild liver problems.
Do not take PANPRAZ D CAPSULE if you are allergic to Domperidone, Pantoprazole or to any other ingredients of this medicine.
PANPRAZ D CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems such as prolongation of QT interval or congestive heart failure.
PANPRAZ D CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).
PANPRAZ D CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

Others

PANPRAZ D CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have bloody stools or bleeding in the gut
Have blockage or tear in the intestines
Have severe fluid or electrolyte disturbances
Have prolactinoma (a non-cancerous tumor of pituitary gland)
Have low blood potassium or magnesium levels

Before taking PANPRAZ D CAPSULE inform your doctor if you:

Have osteoporosis
Have vitamin B12 deficiency (sore tongue, mouth ulcers, pale skin, depression)
Are going to test Chromogranin A level

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking PANPRAZ D CAPSULE inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Aminobenzamides (Ex. cisapride, dolasetron, prucalopride, diphemanil)
Cardiac glycosides (Ex. digoxin, apomorphine, disopyramide, hydroquinidine, quinidine, amiodarone, dofetilide, dronedarone, ibutilide, sotalol, diltiazem or verapamil)
Anti-viral agents (Ex. atazanavir, nelfinavir, saquinavir, telaprevir)
Antifungal (Ex. ketoconazole, itraconazole, posaconazole)
Anti-coagulants (Ex. warfarin, phenprocoumon)
Antipsychotics (Ex. haloperidol, pimozide, sertindole)
Antidepressants (Ex. escitalopram or citalopram, fluvoxamine, St John’s wort)
Antibiotics (Ex. moxifloxacin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, clarithromycin, telithromycin or amoxicillin)
Phenanthrene class (Ex. halofantrine, lumefantrine)
Antihistamines (Ex. mizolastine, mequitazine)
Anti-cancer agents (Ex. toremifene, vandetanib, vincamine, erlotinib, dasatinib, nilotinib)
Antimetabolites (Ex. methotrexate)
Anti-arrhythmic  (Ex. bepridil)
Opiate (narcotic) analgesics (Ex. methadone)
Iron salts
Immunosupressants (Ex. tacrolimus or mycophenolate mofetil)
Anti-infective (Ex. pentamidine)
Anti-TB agents (Ex. rifampicin)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more PANPRAZ D CAPSULE, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away. Symptoms of overdosage might include sleepiness, confusion, uncontrollable body movements (including eye and tongue), twisted neck and abnormal body posture.

introduction:
Introduction About RABINON 20MG INJECTION

RABINON 20MG INJECTION is used to manage acidity, heartburn, peptic ulcers, acid reflux, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It contains a medicine called Rabeprazole which is a Proton pump inhibitor that works by reducing gastric acid secretions.

Take RABINON 20MG INJECTION 15-30 minutes before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take RABINON 20MG INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking RABINON 20MG INJECTION are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RABINON 20MG INJECTION

RABINON 20MG INJECTION is used to provide relief from following gastric conditions:

Acidity, Heartburn, Acid reflux
Peptic ulcers
Inflammation of oesophagus
Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How RABINON 20MG INJECTION Works

RABINON 20MG INJECTION is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.
usageInstructions: Take RABINON 20MG INJECTION as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
It is preferably taken in the mornings or at any time of the day before meals, preferably 15-30 minutes prior to meals
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.question: Q: What are the uses of RABINON 20MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: RABINON 20MG INJECTION is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

faqs.question: Q: How RABINON 20MG INJECTION works?
faqs.answer: A: RABINON 20MG INJECTION is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.

faqs.question: Q: How long will it take for RABINON 20MG INJECTION to manage my disease?
faqs.answer: A: The time taken for healing depends on the severity of the disease. You may notice improvement in your condition within 1-2 days of therapy with RABINON 20MG INJECTION. However, it may take several weeks for RABINON 20MG INJECTION to completely heal the ulcers.

faqs.question: Q: When should I take RABINON 20MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: RABINON 20MG INJECTION should be taken on an empty stomach at mornings. It can also be taken before a meal.

faqs.question: Q: What are the long-term side effects of RABINON 20MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: Taking RABINON 20MG INJECTION especially over the time of a year can slightly increase the risk of hip, wrist, or spine fracture. Inform your doctor if you suffer from osteoporosis or if you are taking corticosteroids which can increase the risk of osteoporosis. It may also cause vitamin B12 deficiency and low magnesium levels in the blood.

faqs.question: Q: Can I stop taking RABINON 20MG INJECTION once my symptoms subside?
faqs.answer: A: Do not stop taking RABINON 20MG INJECTION without consulting your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Make sure to take RABINON 20MG INJECTION for the stipulated duration recommended by your doctor to achieve complete healing of ulcers.

faqs.question: Q: What is the best time to take RABINON 20MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: RABINON 20MG INJECTION should be taken while you are on empty stomach in the morning. It can also be taken before a meal.

faqs.question: Q: What to do if I forgot to take a dose of RABINON 20MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: If you have missed a dose of RABINON 20MG INJECTION, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is time for the next dose of RABINON 20MG INJECTION, skip the missed dose and take the next one regularly. Do not take a double dose of RABINON 20MG INJECTION to compensate the missed ones.

faqs.question: Q: What precautions should be followed while taking RABINON 20MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: Before taking RABINON 20MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach. Do not take RABINON 20MG INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. Regularly visit your doctor and take all the necessary blood test recommended by your doctor without fail. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking RABINON 20MG INJECTION.

faqs.question: Q: Can I consume alcohol while taking RABINON 20MG INJECTION?
faqs.answer: A: Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking RABINON 20MG INJECTION as it could aggravate your ulcers and delays the healing process.

faqs.question: Q: Can I take RABINON 20MG INJECTION daily?
faqs.answer: A: Take RABINON 20MG INJECTION as advised by your physician. Your doctor will evaluate your health condition and suggest whether can you take RABINON 20MG INJECTION every day or not.

faqs.question: Q: Can the use of RABINON 20MG INJECTION affect the liver?
faqs.answer: A: Yes. RABINON 20MG INJECTION may affect the way your liver work. Therefore, it should be used with caution in patients with liver problems.

faqs.question: Q: Can RABINON 20MG INJECTION be taken during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: RABINON 20MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women.

introduction:
Introduction About UBERCID DSR CAPSULE

UBERCID DSR CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation combining Pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor and Domperidone, a prokinetic agent. It is helpful for individuals who experience recurring gastric discomfort, acid build-up, post-meal bloating or frequent burping. It is especially beneficial for those with a pattern of acid-related issues that worsen on an empty stomach or after heavy meals. Whether due to irregular meal timings, dietary choices or stress-induced acidity, UBERCID DSR CAPSULE is designed to support a more comfortable and regulated digestive experience.   

Pantoprazole works by reducing the production of excess stomach acid creating a balanced gastric environment, while Domperidone enhances stomach motility, helping move food and gas more efficiently through the digestive tract. It is generally suitable for adults who face frequent episodes of bloating, discomfort after meals, or acid-related unease, especially those with sedentary lifestyles or irregular eating patterns.

For optimal effectiveness, UBERCID DSR CAPSULE is usually taken once daily before meals, ideally in the morning. It should be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing. Adherence to the recommended timing and dosage, as directed by a healthcare provider, ensures better symptom control. It is important to maintain a gap of at least 30–60 minutes between the capsule and any calcium, iron, or magnesium supplements, as these may interfere with absorption. Avoid consuming alcohol and spicy foods while on this capsule, as these can aggravate stomach acid levels.

Caution is advised in individuals with liver, kidney, or heart conditions. It is also important to consult a doctor before use in pregnancy or while breastfeeding, as the safety of Domperidone is still under clinical evaluation in such groups. While generally well-tolerated, some users may experience dry mouth, headache, dizziness, or mild gastrointestinal disturbances such as loose stools or constipation. If any unusual or persistent symptoms occur, medical guidance should be sought promptly.

Introduction About BELLO 20 TABLET

BELLO 20 TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take BELLO 20 TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking BELLO 20 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take BELLO 20 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking BELLO 20 TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking BELLO 20 TABLET.

Introduction About SUCRAFIN O SUSPENSION

SUCRAFIN O SUSPENSION is a combination of Oxetacaine and Sucralfate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anesthetic Antacids and Ulcer Protectives respectively. It is used to manage stomach ulcers, acidity and heartburn. It can also be used to manage inflammation of gut caused due to other reasons apart from ulcer (such as H. pylori infection).

SUCRAFIN O SUSPENSION should be taken at least 1 hour before meals. Along with the management, eat simple foods and avoid consumption of alcohol. Do not take other antacid medications along with SUCRAFIN O SUSPENSION without consulting your doctor as it may reduce the effectiveness of this medicine.

Before taking SUCRAFIN O SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, thyroid problems or liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or obstruction in the gut or having delayed gastric emptying due to any gut surgery.

SUCRAFIN O SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effect of taking SUCRAFIN O SUSPENSION is constipation. Consult your doctor if this symptom troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How SUCRAFIN O SUSPENSION Works

SUCRAFIN O SUSPENSION contains two medicines namely sucralfate and oxetacaine. Sucralfate is an ulcer protective agent. It forms a protective layer over the ulcer lesions, giving it a sustained protection against the penetration of stomach acid and other irritants or enzymes (such as alcohol, pepsin and bile). This lessens the chances of further tissue damage which ultimately manages the exacerbation of ulcers lesions.

Oxetacaine is a local anesthetic agent. Following oral administration, it reduces pain sensation from the inflamed gut tissues (or ulcer tissues). Collectively, this medicine reduce the unpleasant symptoms of the digestive tract such as acidity, heartburn and stomach ulcers.

introduction:
Introduction About JOSPAN D CAPSULE

JOSPAN D CAPSULE is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. JOSPAN D CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with JOSPAN D CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking JOSPAN D CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

JOSPAN D CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking JOSPAN D CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

mechanismOfAction:
How JOSPAN D CAPSULE Works

JOSPAN D CAPSULE contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, JOSPAN D CAPSULE it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

introduction:
Introduction About PEZOVER DSR CAPSULE

PEZOVER DSR CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation combining Pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor and Domperidone, a prokinetic agent. It is helpful for individuals who experience recurring gastric discomfort, acid build-up, post-meal bloating or frequent burping. It is especially beneficial for those with a pattern of acid-related issues that worsen on an empty stomach or after heavy meals. Whether due to irregular meal timings, dietary choices or stress-induced acidity, PEZOVER DSR CAPSULE is designed to support a more comfortable and regulated digestive experience.   

Pantoprazole works by reducing the production of excess stomach acid creating a balanced gastric environment, while Domperidone enhances stomach motility, helping move food and gas more efficiently through the digestive tract. It is generally suitable for adults who face frequent episodes of bloating, discomfort after meals, or acid-related unease, especially those with sedentary lifestyles or irregular eating patterns.

For optimal effectiveness, PEZOVER DSR CAPSULE is usually taken once daily before meals, ideally in the morning. It should be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing. Adherence to the recommended timing and dosage, as directed by a healthcare provider, ensures better symptom control. It is important to maintain a gap of at least 30–60 minutes between the capsule and any calcium, iron, or magnesium supplements, as these may interfere with absorption. Avoid consuming alcohol and spicy foods while on this capsule, as these can aggravate stomach acid levels.

Caution is advised in individuals with liver, kidney, or heart conditions. It is also important to consult a doctor before use in pregnancy or while breastfeeding, as the safety of Domperidone is still under clinical evaluation in such groups. While generally well-tolerated, some users may experience dry mouth, headache, dizziness, or mild gastrointestinal disturbances such as loose stools or constipation. If any unusual or persistent symptoms occur, medical guidance should be sought promptly.

How PEZOVER DSR CAPSULE Supports Gastric Acid Regulation

The formulation is designed to act at two levels:

Regulation of Excess Stomach Acid: The capsule contains a component that helps reduce the volume and acidity of stomach secretions. This contributes to a more neutral internal environment, helping relieve common discomfort associated with hyperacidity
Improved Stomach Emptying: By supporting the movement of food through the stomach and into the intestines, this capsule helps reduce the sensation of heaviness, bloating, and fullness which is the common experiences related to delayed gastric emptying

The delayed-release property ensures that the active ingredients are released only when they reach specific areas of the gastrointestinal tract, helping minimize irritation and maximize their function.

For most individuals, One capsule of PEZOVER DSR CAPSULE is sufficient to support digestive health and regulate gastric acid levels
Duration of use should also be determined by your doctor, based on your individual needs and response to the medication
2. How and when to take PEZOVER DSR CAPSULE
PEZOVER DSR CAPSULE is best taken once daily, ideally 30–60 minutes before a meal, for optimal effectiveness
Take it on an empty stomach: The capsule works most effectively when the stomach is empty, as it supports gastric acid regulation and digestive function
Swallow the capsule whole: Do not chew, crush, or break the capsule. This ensures that the active ingredients are released in the right area of your digestive system
Drink a full glass of water: This helps in swallowing the capsule and aids in the absorption of the active ingredients
Consistency is key: Take your capsule at the same time each day to maintain a consistent level of the medication in your system
Avoid taking it with high-fat meals or other substances that might alter its absorption rate

name: RABEPILL Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RABEPILL TABLET

RABEPILL TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take RABEPILL TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking RABEPILL TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take RABEPILL TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking RABEPILL TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking RABEPILL TABLET.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RABEPILL TABLET
Manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease
Manage and Manages Peptic ulcers
Manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How RABEPILL TABLET Works

RABEPILL TABLET is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.
usageDetails:
How to use RABEPILL TABLET

Take RABEPILL TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken in the mornings or at any time of the day before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ACVOM CAPSULE

ACVOM CAPSULE is a combination of Domperidone and Omeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

ACVOM CAPSULE is effective in managing peptic ulcer caused either due to stomach infection (H. pylori infection) or due to prolong use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (such as ibuprofen, aceclofenac). ACVOM CAPSULEacts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn. ACVOM CAPSULEis suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 12 years or above weighing 35 kg or more). It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with ACVOM CAPSULEyour doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking ACVOM CAPSULEinform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones. ACVOM CAPSULEis not recommended for use in patients having bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking ACVOM CAPSULEif you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ACVOM CAPSULEare dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any abnormal signs such as unusual tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat, fragile bones, bloody stools or vomits or sudden weight loss.

It is used in adults and in children (aged 12 years or older weighing 35 kg or more) to manage:

mechanismOfAction:
How ACVOM CAPSULE Works

ACVOM CAPSULE contains two medicines namely domperidone and omeprazole. Domperidone works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centres and the brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Omeprazole is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, ACVOM CAPSULEmanages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

Do not stop taking ACVOM CAPSULEunless your doctor advice you to stop.
