name: OMIMAXX Capsule 20's
introduction:
Introduction About OMIMAXX CAPSULE

OMIMAXX CAPSULE contains Omeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called  Proton pump inhibitors. It is used in the management of gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (acid contents in the stomach flows back into the tube connecting your mouth and stomach causing heartburn, nausea, vomiting, bitter taste, discomfort in upper abdomen) in children (above 1 years of age) and adults.

It is used in adults to manage gastric (stomach), duodenal ulcer (upper part of the intestine), ulcers infected with Helicobacter pylori bacteria in addition with antibiotics (including children) and ulcers due to the use of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs).

Also, it is used in adults to manage Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (increased acid secretion in the stomach due to growth in pancreas resulting in abdominal pain, diarrhoea, gnawing or discomfort in upper abdomen, heartburn, nausea and vomiting).

OMIMAXX CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with history of allergic reactions to omeprazole or any other proton pump inhibitors (Ex. pantoprazole, lansoprazole, rabeprazole and esomeprazole).

Before taking OMIMAXX CAPSULE, tell your doctor if you have any severe liver problems, weight loss, swallowing problems, stomach pain or indigestion, osteoporosis (condition in which bones become weak and brittle), vitamin B12 deficiency, schedule for specific blood test (chromogranin A).

OMIMAXX CAPSULE can be used in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if advised by the doctor. OMIMAXX CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) due to increased risk of fractures.

The most common side effects of taking OMIMAXX CAPSULE are headache, diarrhoea, stomach pain, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How OMIMAXX CAPSULE Works

OMIMAXX CAPSULE effectively lowers the amount of acid produced in the stomach by irreversibly binding to and inhibiting the hydrogen-potassium ATPase pump that resides on the lining of the digestive tract. This kind of action helps to reduce vomiting, promote healing of damaged stomach tissue in ulcers.

Take OMIMAXX CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow OMIMAXX CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of OMIMAXX CAPSULE for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RABISAFE 20 TABLET

RABISAFE 20 TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take RABISAFE 20 TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking RABISAFE 20 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take RABISAFE 20 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking RABISAFE 20 TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking RABISAFE 20 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How RABISAFE 20 TABLET Works

RABISAFE 20 TABLET is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.

Take RABISAFE 20 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken in the mornings or at any time of the day before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE

CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

usesDetails:
Uses Of CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE

It is used to manage:

Peptic ulcer
Gastrointestinal Reflux disease (GERD)

Nausea and Vomiting

mechanismOfAction:
How CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE Works

CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, CUPENTA DSR CAPSULE it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

introduction:
Introduction About PENTASTAR DSR CAPSULE

PENTASTAR DSR CAPSULE is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. PENTASTAR DSR CAPSULE acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with PENTASTAR DSR CAPSULE your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking PENTASTAR DSR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

PENTASTAR DSR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking PENTASTAR DSR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

Peptic ulcer

mechanismOfAction:
How PENTASTAR DSR CAPSULE Works

PENTASTAR DSR CAPSULE contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, PENTASTAR DSR CAPSULE it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

name: BELLO D Capsule 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BELLO D CAPSULE

BELLO D CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation designed to support stomach comfort and digestive balance. It contains Rabeprazole and Domperidone, two clinically studied components that reduce excessive stomach acid and support smoother digestion. This combination is widely recommended for individuals experiencing symptoms linked to acidity, heartburn, or discomfort after meals.

Along management with BELLO D CAPSULE , try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Some individuals may experience mild effects such as headache, dry mouth, abdominal discomfort, constipation, dizziness, or nausea. These effects are generally temporary. If they persist, contact your healthcare provider for guidance.

Store BELLO D CAPSULE in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
uses: Used to support stomach comfort and digestive balance
usesDetails:
Uses Of BELLO D CAPSULE
Used to support stomach comfort and digestive balance
mechanismOfAction:
How BELLO D CAPSULE Works

BELLO D CAPSULE works through a dual mechanism. Rabeprazole acts by reducing acid secretion at its source, ensuring a well-balanced gastric environment. Meanwhile, Domperidone restores the normal movement of the stomach and intestines, managing acid backflow and improving food passage for a more comfortable digestive experience.

Dual Mechanism Explained: Acid Control and Gut Movement

1. Acid Control through Rabeprazole:

Rabeprazole belongs to the class of proton pump modulators that reduce acid secretion at its source. Once absorbed in the intestine, it reaches the acid-producing parietal cells in the stomach lining. Here, it selectively and irreversibly binds to the H/K ATPase enzyme system, also known as the proton pump, the final step in acid secretion. By blocking the hydrogen ion exchange process, Rabeprazole manages excessive acid release into the stomach lumen, thereby increasing gastric pH. It acts faster than many other molecules in its class due to its ability to activate at higher pH levels, efficiently reducing acid production even at minimal acidity. This long-acting acid suppression helps relieve common signs of acidity and promotes a stable digestive environment.

2. Gut Movement through Domperidone:

Domperidone supports the mechanical side of digestion by enhancing gastric motility. It selectively blocks dopamine D2 receptors found in the upper gastrointestinal tract, which normally act to slow stomach contractions. By inhibiting these receptors, Domperidone increases the tone of the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), facilitates faster gastric emptying, and decreases the backward flow of food and acid into the esophagus. It also improves intestinal motion, reducing sensations of bloating, heaviness, or delayed digestion after meals, particularly useful for individuals who experience reflux linked to slow gastric transit.

3. Integrated Digestive Action:

Together, these two mechanisms form a dual-action system. Rabeprazole ensures acid stability, while Domperidone optimizes movement and clearance. This combination supports digestive comfort by minimizing acid build-up while promoting efficient passage of food through the stomach and intestines. It is particularly suited for individuals who face recurring symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, or post-meal fullness due to poor gastric motility or high acid output. This science-backed synergy makes BELLO D CAPSULE effective for holistic digestive maintenance under medical supervision.

“Quick Fact Highlights” explaining why the dual combination is clinically valued
Clinically synergistic formulation: The combination of Rabeprazole (20 mg) and Domperidone (30 mg SR) works through a dual mechanism, controlling stomach acid while improving gut motility providing faster and more comprehensive relief from acid discomfort
Science-backed acid regulation: Rabeprazole acts at the final step of acid production by blocking the H/K ATPase enzyme, also known as the proton pump. This action significantly reduces acid secretion and maintains optimal pH levels in the stomach for prolonged comfort
Enhanced digestion support: Domperidone increases the movement of the stomach and upper intestinal tract, promoting quicker stomach emptying and minimizing post-meal bloating, nausea, and reflux symptoms
Faster symptom control: Rabeprazole has one of the quickest onset times among proton pump inhibitors, beginning to act within 1 hour of ingestion, offering prompt relief in cases of severe acidity and heartburn
Persistent gastric balance: The sustained-release form of Domperidone maintains smooth motility throughout the day, managing the recurrence of reflux episodes and late-night acidity, a key benefit for individuals with night-time acid reflux or delayed digestion
Improved patient quality of life: This dual approach relieves not just acid discomfort but also digestive sluggishness, making it beneficial for individuals who experience post-meal heaviness, belching, or regurgitation along with acidity
Clinically preferred for complex acid disorders: Physicians often recommend this combination when single-drug therapy (acid suppressants alone) fails to improve acid-related conditions or reflux-associated nausea
Well-tolerated and safety-monitored: The formulation has a proven safety profile when used as prescribed, with side effects such as mild headache or dizziness typically resolving with continued use
usageInstructions: For most adult users, the typical dosage is one BELLO D CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption

Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision

Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. Extra caution is advised in those with osteoporosis or history of cardiac arrhythmia, as Domperidone may influence heart rhythm in predisposed individuals
usageDetails:
How to use BELLO D CAPSULE

Take the capsule before meals, preferably in the morning, or as directed by your healthcare provider. Swallow the capsule whole with water without crushing or chewing. Regular use under professional guidance ensures optimal results.

1. How to Take BELLO D CAPSULE Safely

Swallow the capsule whole with water without biting, breaking, or crushing it. The capsule should not be chewed as it is designed for delayed release. It is best taken on an empty stomach for optimal absorption and faster onset of effect. Avoid taking it with caffeinated or acidic drinks.

2. Dosage and Duration

The dosage and duration depend on your medical condition, age, and response to therapy. Most individuals experience benefits with once-daily use, but in some cases, the doctor may recommend twice-daily administration. Continue the capsule for the prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve early.

3. Dosage Guidelines for Adults and Elderly
For most adult users, the typical dosage is one BELLO D CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption
Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision
Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. Extra caution is advised in those with osteoporosis or history of cardiac arrhythmia, as Domperidone may influence heart rhythm in predisposed individuals

When to Seek Medical Attention

Stop using BELLO D CAPSULE and seek medical attention immediately if you experience symptoms such as allergic rash, facial swelling, difficulty breathing, severe diarrhea, or persistent fatigue. Seek urgent attention for unusual muscle stiffness, tremors, or irregular heartbeat.

Drink plenty of water to avoid dehydration and practice balanced eating habits. If you experience mild stomach discomfort, avoid spicy or acidic food. For dry mouth, staying hydrated or chewing sugar-free gum can help. If symptoms persist or worsen, consult your healthcare provider for guidance.

More Information
Why BELLO D CAPSULE is Doctor-Recommended for “Digestive Balance.”

Digestive discomfort caused by acidity and reflux is often linked to two simultaneous problems excess acid formation and slowed stomach movement.BELLO D CAPSULE addresses both through a clinically trusted dual mechanism combining Rabeprazole and Domperidone. Doctors recommend this capsule because it supports digestive balance by managing acid levels and enhancing gastric motility, offering smoother stomach function throughout the day.

“Did You Know?” Sidebar: Use small fact highlights like: “Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to late-night meals. Following early dinner routines may reduce reflux frequency”
Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to nighttime eating habits, eating late dinners or snacks within two hours of bedtime significantly increases reflux risk. Having meals earlier in the evening can reduce acid backflow and discomfort.
Meal timing matters: Studies show that eating dinner 3–4 hours before sleep supports better digestion and reduces nighttime acid episodes. Early dining allows the stomach to empty properly before lying down.
Late-night meals affect sleep and metabolism: Research indicates that those who regularly eat after 9 p.m. experience disrupted sleep patterns, slower calorie burning, and more frequent heartburn sensations compared to early eaters.
Fast eating can upset digestive balance: People who eat quickly swallow more air, which increases pressure in the stomach and raises the chance of acid discomfort. Chewing food slowly and mindfully can reduce symptoms and aid smoother digestion.
Simple posture shifts help: Standing or staying upright after meals even for 15–20 minutes can minimize reflux frequency and relieve heaviness. Avoid lying flat immediately after eating.
Diet quality counts: Frequent consumption of spicy, oily, or fried foods can raise stomach acid levels. Choosing gentle foods like oatmeal, bananas, and green vegetables can maintain a neutral digestive pH.
Hydration supports healthy acid balance: Drinking plain water throughout the day dilutes acid concentration naturally. However, sipping slowly instead of gulping helps avoid trapped air and bloating.

introduction:
Introduction About PANVERGE 40MG TABLET

PANVERGE 40MG TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking PANVERGE 40MG TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking PANVERGE 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How PANVERGE 40MG TABLET Works

PANVERGE 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why PANVERGE 40MG TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
PANVERGE 40MG TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take PANVERGE 40MG TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

Potent and Long-Lasting Acid Suppression: PANVERGE 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively blocks the final step of stomach acid production, providing stronger and longer-lasting relief from symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, and indigestion compared to H2 blockers or antacids.
Comprehensive Symptom Relief and Healing: It not only relieves discomfort from acid-related conditions but also promotes healing of stomach and duodenal ulcers, and helps manage more severe conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
Lowering with Painkiller Use: PANVERGE 40MG TABLET is recommended for lowering stomach ulcers and acidity in patients who require long-term use of painkillers (NSAIDs), a benefit not offered by all acid-reducing medicines.
Convenient Once-Daily Dosing: Its long duration of action allows for once-daily dosing, making it easier for patients to adhere to treatment and maintain consistent acid control.

Well-Studied and Trusted: Pantoprazole, the active ingredient, is widely used and supported by extensive clinical experience, ensuring both efficacy and safety for a broad range of patients.

These advantages make PANVERGE 40MG TABLET a reliable and effective option for both short-term relief and long-term management of acid-related disorders, often outperforming less potent or shorter-acting alternatives.

Introduction About ACINIL O SUSPENSION

ACINIL O SUSPENSION is a combination of Aluminium hydroxide, Magnesium hydroxide, Oxetacaine, and Simethicone, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antacids, Saline laxatives, Anesthetic antacids, and Gastrointestinal agents, respectively. It is used for symptomatic relief of gastric hyperacidity associated with gastritis, peptic ulcer, and esophageal reflux with heartburn.

ACINIL O SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients having renal failure, partial intestinal obstruction, gastric outlet obstruction, constipation, or hypophosphatemia (low level of phosphate). Consult your doctor for advice. Before taking ACINIL O SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have porphyria, are undergoing hemodialysis, and are on a low-phosphorous diet.

There are limited studies on the use of ACINIL O SUSPENSION during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Your doctor will prescribe the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight, and disease condition. Consult your doctor before taking ACINIL O SUSPENSION.

The most common side effects of taking ACINIL O SUSPENSION are diarrhea, stomach pain, bloating, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, and indigestion. Consult your doctor’s advice if any of these worsen or persist for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About P OD TABLET

P OD TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking P OD TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking P OD TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How P OD TABLET Works

P OD TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why P OD TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
P OD TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take P OD TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

More Information
01.What makes P OD TABLET a preferred choice over other medications?
Potent and Long-Lasting Acid Suppression: P OD TABLET contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively blocks the final step of stomach acid production, providing stronger and longer-lasting relief from symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, and indigestion compared to H2 blockers or antacids.
Comprehensive Symptom Relief and Healing: It not only relieves discomfort from acid-related conditions but also promotes healing of stomach and duodenal ulcers, and helps manage more severe conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
Lowering with Painkiller Use: P OD TABLET is recommended for lowering stomach ulcers and acidity in patients who require long-term use of painkillers (NSAIDs), a benefit not offered by all acid-reducing medicines.
Convenient Once-Daily Dosing: Its long duration of action allows for once-daily dosing, making it easier for patients to adhere to treatment and maintain consistent acid control.
Favorable Tolerability Profile: Most side effects are mild and temporary, such as headache, nausea, or diarrhea. Serious side effects are rare when used as directed, and the risk of complications can be minimized with appropriate monitoring.
Well-Studied and Trusted: Pantoprazole, the active ingredient, is widely used and supported by extensive clinical experience, ensuring both efficacy and safety for a broad range of patients.

These advantages make P OD TABLET a reliable and effective option for both short-term relief and long-term management of acid-related disorders, often outperforming less potent or shorter-acting alternatives.

name: DIOVOL COOL BLUE CHEWABLE Tablet 20's
introduction:
Introduction About DIOVOL COOL BLUE CHEWABLE TABLET

Diovol Cool Blue Chewable Tablet is an antacid and antigas medicine, used to relieve symptoms of hyperacidity that are usually associated with indigestion, peptic ulcer, gastritis (inflammation of the stomach), peptic esophagitis (inflammation and swelling of the oesophagus), and hiatus hernia (part of the stomach moves up into the chest).

Diovol Cool Blue Chewable Tablet is also used to relieve flatulence (gas). It contains dried aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide, magnesium aluminium silicate hydrate, and activated dimethicone as active ingredients that work by neutralizing the excess acid in the stomach.

Activated dimethicone, aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide and magnesium aluminium silicate are antacids that act by neutralizing the acid in the stomach and by inhibiting pepsin (an enzyme that helps break down protein in the digestive tract). By this mechanism, they raise the pH of the stomach contents and provide relief from hyperacidity.

Always take Diovol Cool Blue Chewable Tablet as advised by the physician. Inform your doctor if you have kidney impairment, high magnesium levels in the blood, or if you are aged over 50 years and experiencing heartburn for the first time. Diovol Cool Blue Chewable Tablet should not be given to children younger than 12 years of age.

introduction:
Introduction About GASTORAB D TABLET

GASTORAB D TABLET is used to manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) among patients who have not responded adequately to rabeprazole alone. It is a combination of Domperidone and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine Antagonists and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It can also be used to manage peptic ulcers caused by H. pylori infection or NSAIDs use.

Along management with GASTORAB D TABLET, try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Before taking GASTORAB D TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Your doctor may reduce the dose or suggest an alternative therapy. It is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged less than 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LANZIP 30 CAPSULE

LANZIP 30 CAPSULE contains Lansoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton Pump Inhibitors. It is used in the management of intestinal and peptic (stomach) ulcers. Peptic or intestinal ulcers are open sores that form on the inside lining of your stomach and the upper part of your small intestine, causing stomach pain.

LANZIP 30 CAPSULE is also used to manage reflux oesophagitis (inflammation of lower food pipe due to backflow of acidic stomach material) and Zollinger-Ellison Syndrome (small tumour in the first part of your bowel due to excessive gastrin secretion).

Before taking LANZIP 30 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have severe liver disease, phenylketonuria, osteoporosis or if you are about to have a specific blood test (Chromogranin A). LANZIP 30 CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. LANZIP 30 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children.

Your doctor may perform an additional examination (endoscopy) to diagnose your condition or exclude malignant disease and regular blood tests to monitor your levels of magnesium. The most common side effects of taking LANZIP 30 CAPSULE are dizziness, nausea, headache, diarrhea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms gets worse over time.

Introduction About ESODRIVE D CAPSULE

ESODRIVE D CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation designed to support stomach comfort and digestive balance. It contains Rabeprazole and Domperidone, two clinically studied components that reduce excessive stomach acid and support smoother digestion. This combination is widely recommended for individuals experiencing symptoms linked to acidity, heartburn, or discomfort after meals.

Along management with ESODRIVE D CAPSULE , try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Some individuals may experience mild effects such as headache, dry mouth, abdominal discomfort, constipation, dizziness, or nausea. These effects are generally temporary. If they persist, contact your healthcare provider for guidance.

Store ESODRIVE D CAPSULE in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture. Keep out of reach of children and pets.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESODRIVE D CAPSULE Works

ESODRIVE D CAPSULE works through a dual mechanism. Rabeprazole acts by reducing acid secretion at its source, ensuring a well-balanced gastric environment. Meanwhile, Domperidone restores the normal movement of the stomach and intestines, managing acid backflow and improving food passage for a more comfortable digestive experience.

Dual Mechanism Explained: Acid Control and Gut Movement

1. Acid Control through Rabeprazole:

Rabeprazole belongs to the class of proton pump modulators that reduce acid secretion at its source. Once absorbed in the intestine, it reaches the acid-producing parietal cells in the stomach lining. Here, it selectively and irreversibly binds to the H/K ATPase enzyme system, also known as the proton pump, the final step in acid secretion. By blocking the hydrogen ion exchange process, Rabeprazole manages excessive acid release into the stomach lumen, thereby increasing gastric pH. It acts faster than many other molecules in its class due to its ability to activate at higher pH levels, efficiently reducing acid production even at minimal acidity. This long-acting acid suppression helps relieve common signs of acidity and promotes a stable digestive environment.

2. Gut Movement through Domperidone:

Domperidone supports the mechanical side of digestion by enhancing gastric motility. It selectively blocks dopamine D2 receptors found in the upper gastrointestinal tract, which normally act to slow stomach contractions. By inhibiting these receptors, Domperidone increases the tone of the lower esophageal sphincter (LES), facilitates faster gastric emptying, and decreases the backward flow of food and acid into the esophagus. It also improves intestinal motion, reducing sensations of bloating, heaviness, or delayed digestion after meals, particularly useful for individuals who experience reflux linked to slow gastric transit.

3. Integrated Digestive Action:

Together, these two mechanisms form a dual-action system. Rabeprazole ensures acid stability, while Domperidone optimizes movement and clearance. This combination supports digestive comfort by minimizing acid build-up while promoting efficient passage of food through the stomach and intestines. It is particularly suited for individuals who face recurring symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, or post-meal fullness due to poor gastric motility or high acid output. This science-backed synergy makes ESODRIVE D CAPSULE effective for holistic digestive maintenance under medical supervision.

“Quick Fact Highlights” explaining why the dual combination is clinically valued
Clinically synergistic formulation: The combination of Rabeprazole (20 mg) and Domperidone (30 mg SR) works through a dual mechanism, controlling stomach acid while improving gut motility providing faster and more comprehensive relief from acid discomfort
Science-backed acid regulation: Rabeprazole acts at the final step of acid production by blocking the H/K ATPase enzyme, also known as the proton pump. This action significantly reduces acid secretion and maintains optimal pH levels in the stomach for prolonged comfort
Enhanced digestion support: Domperidone increases the movement of the stomach and upper intestinal tract, promoting quicker stomach emptying and minimizing post-meal bloating, nausea, and reflux symptoms
Faster symptom control: Rabeprazole has one of the quickest onset times among proton pump inhibitors, beginning to act within 1 hour of ingestion, offering prompt relief in cases of severe acidity and heartburn
Persistent gastric balance: The sustained-release form of Domperidone maintains smooth motility throughout the day, managing the recurrence of reflux episodes and late-night acidity, a key benefit for individuals with night-time acid reflux or delayed digestion
Improved patient quality of life: This dual approach relieves not just acid discomfort but also digestive sluggishness, making it beneficial for individuals who experience post-meal heaviness, belching, or regurgitation along with acidity
Clinically preferred for complex acid disorders: Physicians often recommend this combination when single-drug therapy (acid suppressants alone) fails to improve acid-related conditions or reflux-associated nausea
Well-tolerated and safety-monitored: The formulation has a proven safety profile when used as prescribed, with side effects such as mild headache or dizziness typically resolving with continued use
usageInstructions: For most adult users, the typical dosage is one ESODRIVE D CAPSULE (Rabeprazole 20 mg + Domperidone 30 mg) taken once daily, ideally 30 minutes before a meal, preferably in the morning. The capsule must be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing, to ensure proper drug release and absorption

Elderly individuals often metabolize medicines more slowly and may have pre-existing heart, kidney, or liver impairments. Therefore, they should only take the prescribed dose once daily, under close medical supervision

Long-term users may require periodic assessment of magnesium, calcium, and vitamin B12 levels, as prolonged use can mildly affect nutrient absorption. Digestive discomfort caused by acidity and reflux is often linked to two simultaneous problems excess acid formation and slowed stomach movement.ESODRIVE D CAPSULE addresses both through a clinically trusted dual mechanism combining Rabeprazole and Domperidone. Doctors recommend this capsule because it supports digestive balance by managing acid levels and enhancing gastric motility, offering smoother stomach function throughout the day.

“Did You Know?” Sidebar: Use small fact highlights like: “Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to late-night meals. Following early dinner routines may reduce reflux frequency”
Over 70% of acidity cases are linked to nighttime eating habits, eating late dinners or snacks within two hours of bedtime significantly increases reflux risk. Having meals earlier in the evening can reduce acid backflow and discomfort.
Meal timing matters: Studies show that eating dinner 3–4 hours before sleep supports better digestion and reduces nighttime acid episodes. Early dining allows the stomach to empty properly before lying down.
Late-night meals affect sleep and metabolism: Research indicates that those who regularly eat after 9 p.m. experience disrupted sleep patterns, slower calorie burning, and more frequent heartburn sensations compared to early eaters.
Fast eating can upset digestive balance: People who eat quickly swallow more air, which increases pressure in the stomach and raises the chance of acid discomfort. Chewing food slowly and mindfully can reduce symptoms and aid smoother digestion.
Simple posture shifts help: Standing or staying upright after meals even for 15–20 minutes can minimize reflux frequency and relieve heaviness. Avoid lying flat immediately after eating.
Diet quality counts: Frequent consumption of spicy, oily, or fried foods can raise stomach acid levels. Choosing gentle foods like oatmeal, bananas, and green vegetables can maintain a neutral digestive pH.
Hydration supports healthy acid balance: Drinking plain water throughout the day dilutes acid concentration naturally. However, sipping slowly instead of gulping helps avoid trapped air and bloating.

Introduction About POTA DSR CAPSULE

POTA DSR CAPSULE is a dual-action formulation combining Pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor and Domperidone, a prokinetic agent. It is helpful for individuals who experience recurring gastric discomfort, acid build-up, post-meal bloating or frequent burping. It is especially beneficial for those with a pattern of acid-related issues that worsen on an empty stomach or after heavy meals. Whether due to irregular meal timings, dietary choices or stress-induced acidity, POTA DSR CAPSULE is designed to support a more comfortable and regulated digestive experience.   

Pantoprazole works by reducing the production of excess stomach acid creating a balanced gastric environment, while Domperidone enhances stomach motility, helping move food and gas more efficiently through the digestive tract. It is generally suitable for adults who face frequent episodes of bloating, discomfort after meals, or acid-related unease, especially those with sedentary lifestyles or irregular eating patterns.

For optimal effectiveness, POTA DSR CAPSULE is usually taken once daily before meals, ideally in the morning. It should be swallowed whole with water, without crushing or chewing. It is important to maintain a gap of at least 30–60 minutes between the capsule and any calcium, iron, or magnesium supplements, as these may interfere with absorption. Avoid consuming alcohol and spicy foods while on this capsule, as these can aggravate stomach acid levels.

Caution is advised in individuals with liver, kidney, or heart conditions. It is also important to consult a doctor before use in pregnancy or while breastfeeding, as the safety of Domperidone is still under clinical evaluation in such groups. introduction:
Introduction About PATROVA 40MG TABLET

PATROVA 40MG TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is commonly prescribed to manage conditions caused by excess stomach acid such as acidity, heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), peptic ulcer disease and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking PATROVA 40MG TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking PATROVA 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it.

mechanismOfAction:
How PATROVA 40MG TABLET Works

PATROVA 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why PATROVA 40MG TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
PATROVA 40MG TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take PATROVA 40MG TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

More Information
01.What makes PATROVA 40MG TABLET a preferred choice over other medications?
Potent and Long-Lasting Acid Suppression: PATROVA 40MG TABLET contains pantoprazole, a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that effectively blocks the final step of stomach acid production, providing stronger and longer-lasting relief from symptoms like heartburn, acid reflux, and indigestion compared to H2 blockers or antacids.
Comprehensive Symptom Relief and Healing: It not only relieves discomfort from acid-related conditions but also promotes healing of stomach and duodenal ulcers, and helps manage more severe conditions such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
Lowering with Painkiller Use: PATROVA 40MG TABLET is recommended for lowering stomach ulcers and acidity in patients who require long-term use of painkillers (NSAIDs), a benefit not offered by all acid-reducing medicines.
Convenient Once-Daily Dosing: Its long duration of action allows for once-daily dosing, making it easier for patients to adhere to treatment and maintain consistent acid control.
Favorable Tolerability Profile: Most side effects are mild and temporary, such as headache, nausea, or diarrhea. Serious side effects are rare when used as directed, and the risk of complications can be minimized with appropriate monitoring.
Well-Studied and Trusted: Pantoprazole, the active ingredient, is widely used and supported by extensive clinical experience, ensuring both efficacy and safety for a broad range of patients.

These advantages make PATROVA 40MG TABLET a reliable and effective option for both short-term relief and long-term management of acid-related disorders, often outperforming less potent or shorter-acting alternatives.

introduction:
Introduction About ASIDITA 10/20 TABLET

ASIDITA 10/20 TABLET is used to manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) among patients who have not responded adequately to rabeprazole alone. It is a combination of Domperidone and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine Antagonists and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It can also be used to manage peptic ulcers caused by H. pylori infection or NSAIDs use.

Along management with ASIDITA 10/20 TABLET, try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Before taking ASIDITA 10/20 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Your doctor may reduce the dose or suggest an alternative therapy. It is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged less than 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects worsen.

How ASIDITA 10/20 TABLET Works

ASIDITA 10/20 TABLET reduces stomach ulcers and acid reflux, where Rabeprazole acts by inhibiting the secretions of stomach acid and Domperidone acts by increasing bowel movements and facilitating gastric emptying, thus leading to rapid symptom relief and healing of stomach ulcers and esophageal lesions.

Introduction About JUFATE O SUSPENSION

JUFATE O SUSPENSION is a combination of Oxetacaine and Sucralfate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anesthetic Antacids and Ulcer Protectives respectively. It is used to manage stomach ulcers, acidity and heartburn. It can also be used to manage inflammation of gut caused due to other reasons apart from ulcer (such as H. pylori infection).

JUFATE O SUSPENSION should be taken at least 1 hour before meals. Along with the management, eat simple foods and avoid consumption of alcohol. Do not take other antacid medications along with JUFATE O SUSPENSION without consulting your doctor as it may reduce the effectiveness of this medicine.

Before taking JUFATE O SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood pressure, thyroid problems or liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or obstruction in the gut or having delayed gastric emptying due to any gut surgery.

JUFATE O SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effect of taking JUFATE O SUSPENSION is constipation. Consult your doctor if this symptom troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How JUFATE O SUSPENSION Works

JUFATE O SUSPENSION contains two medicines namely sucralfate and oxetacaine. Sucralfate is an ulcer protective agent. It forms a protective layer over the ulcer lesions, giving it a sustained protection against the penetration of stomach acid and other irritants or enzymes (such as alcohol, pepsin and bile). This lessens the chances of further tissue damage which ultimately manages the exacerbation of ulcers lesions.

Oxetacaine is a local anesthetic agent. Following oral administration, it reduces pain sensation from the inflamed gut tissues (or ulcer tissues). Collectively, this medicine reduce the unpleasant symptoms of the digestive tract such as acidity, heartburn and stomach ulcers.

introduction:
Introduction About TAMEGUT D CAPSULE

TAMEGUT D CAPSULE is a medication used to manage acid reflux, heartburn, GERD, and stomach ulcers. It contains two active ingredients such as domperidone and esomeprazole which work together to reduce acid secretion and improve digestion.

TAMEGUT D CAPSULE should be taken as prescribed by your doctor, typically on an empty stomach. The dosage and duration will vary depending on your condition and how you respond to the medication. It is important to continue the management for as long as recommended by your doctor, as stopping too soon may cause your symptoms to return or worsen. Be sure to inform your doctor about any other medications you are taking, as some may interact with this medicine.

Common side effects of TAMEGUT D CAPSULE include headache, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation, flatulence (gas), skin rash or irritation, dryness in mouth. Most of these side effects are temporary and typically resolve over time. However, if you are concerned about any of them, contact your doctor immediately. This medication may also cause drowsiness and dizziness, so avoid driving or engaging in activities that require focus until you are familiar with how it affects you. It is also important to refrain from drinking alcohol while using this medication, as it can increase sleepiness. To improve results, consider lifestyle changes such as drinking cold milk and avoiding hot tea, coffee, spicy foods, or chocolate.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Additionally, let your doctor know if you have any liver conditions so that they can adjust the dosage accordingly.

mechanismOfAction:
How TAMEGUT D CAPSULE Works

Domperidone is a dopamine antagonist that works by increasing the movement of the stomach and intestines, helping to relieve symptoms like nausea, vomiting, and bloating. Esomeprazole is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that reduces the production of stomach acid by blocking the proton pumps in the stomach lining, thus helping to treat conditions like acid reflux, GERD (gastroesophageal reflux disease), and ulcers. Together, they work synergistically to alleviate digestive discomfort, improve gastric motility, and reduce acid-related issues.

02. Is TAMEGUT D CAPSULE better than other heartburn medications like Zantac or Nexium?

When comparing TAMEGUT D CAPSULE with other heartburn medications like Zantac (ranitidine) and Nexium (Esomeprazole), there are a few factors to consider:

Mechanism of Action:
TAMEGUT D CAPSULE: Esomeprazole works by reducing stomach acid production, while Domperidone helps with gastric emptying and prevents nausea. The combination is particularly useful for people who suffer from both acid reflux and delayed gastric emptying.
Zantac (Ranitidine): Zantac is an H2 blocker that reduces acid production by blocking histamine receptors in the stomach. It works differently from PPIs like Esomeprazole and is usually less potent.
Nexium (Esomeprazole): Nexium is a PPI like Esomeprazole in TAMEGUT D CAPSULE, and it is typically used for reducing stomach acid production. It is generally more effective at suppressing acid than H2 blockers like Zantac.
Effectiveness:
TAMEGUT D CAPSULE may be more effective for people who experience both heartburn and gastrointestinal motility issues (delayed stomach emptying or nausea). The Domperidone component can be particularly beneficial in these cases.
Nexium is a stronger PPI and may provide more potent acid suppression than Zantac and is often used for conditions like GERD (gastroesophageal reflux disease).
Zantac may be effective for mild to moderate heartburn but typically doesn't suppress acid production as effectively as PPIs.
Side Effects:
TAMEGUT D CAPSULE: Esomeprazole can have side effects like headaches, diarrhea, and potential long-term risks if used for extended periods (e.g., osteoporosis, kidney issues). Domperidone may cause side effects like dry mouth, dizziness, or an increased risk of heart problems in certain people.
Zantac: While Zantac was commonly used for heartburn, recent concerns about its safety (due to potential links to cancer-causing substances) have led to its removal from the market in some regions.
Nexium: Similar to other PPIs, it may cause side effects like stomach infections, magnesium deficiency, and potential kidney problems with long-term use.
Target Use:
TAMEGUT D CAPSULE is often prescribed for people with more complex symptoms, such as those who experience both acid reflux and gastric motility issues.
Zantac is usually used for milder forms of heartburn, though it is being phased out in some places due to safety concerns.
Nexium is effective for long-term acid suppression and is used in treating conditions like GERD, ulcers, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.

Conclusion:

TAMEGUT D CAPSULE may be more suitable for individuals who need both acid suppression and help with gastric motility (like nausea or delayed stomach emptying).
Nexium is generally considered more effective for acid suppression than Zantac, making it a good choice for more severe or chronic heartburn.
Zantac, while effective for milder heartburn, has safety concerns and is no longer widely recommended.

introduction:
Introduction About PANTOBERT D TABLET

PANTOBERT D TABLET is used to manage peptic ulcers, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and reflux esophagitis. It is a combination of Domperidone and Pantoprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Prokinetic Drugs and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. PANTOBERT D TABLET acts by reducing the production of gastric acid. It also speeds up the movement of food from the stomach to the intestines, thereby reducing the signs of nausea, vomiting and acid reflux. Due to these actions, it can also reduce the unpleasant signs of GI tract such as nausea, vomiting, indigestion, burping, bloating, acidity or heartburn.

It should be taken at least 15-30 minutes before meals. During management with PANTOBERT D TABLET your doctor will closely monitor your kidney functions, liver functions and blood magnesium levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking PANTOBERT D TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any blockage or tears in the gut or have weak bones.

PANTOBERT D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients bleeding from the gut. Consult your doctor before taking PANTOBERT D TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects are dryness of mouth, constipation and flatulence. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you. You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience any signs of low magnesium levels in blood (such as tiredness, abnormal muscle movements, dizziness, confusion, disorientation, irregular heartbeat).

mechanismOfAction:
How PANTOBERT D TABLET Works

PANTOBERT D TABLET contains Domperidone and Pantoprazole. Domperidone is a prokinetic medicine with anti-emetic properties which works by blocking the actions of a chemical messenger called dopamine in the gut and across the brain and spinal cord. This action stimulates the gut, reduces acid reflux and speeds up the movements of food from the stomach into the intestines. It also blocks the transmission of nerve signals between the vomiting centers and brain which reduces the onset of nausea and vomiting. Pantoprazole reduces gastric acid secretion by the blocking the actions of a protein membrane called H+K+Atpase (proton pump) present in the lining of the stomach. By reducing stomach acid production, PANTOBERT D TABLET it manages the worsening of ulcers, heals the existing ulcers and esophageal lesions and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms of GI tract (such as acidity, bloating, burping and indigestion).

Are going to test Chromogranin A level

Antidepressants (Ex. escitalopram or citalopram, fluvoxamine, St John’s wort)
Antibiotics (Ex. moxifloxacin, erythromycin, levofloxacin, clarithromycin, telithromycin or amoxicillin)

name: RENVORAB 40 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RENVORAB 40 TABLET

RENVORAB 40 TABLET is used to manage Gastro-Esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) among patients who have not responded adequately to rabeprazole alone. It is a combination of Domperidone and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Dopamine Antagonists and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It can also be used to manage peptic ulcers caused by H. pylori infection or NSAIDs use.

Along management with RENVORAB 40 TABLET, try to eat less spicy foods and drink plenty of water. Avoid smoking or alcohol consumption as it may aggravate your existing condition. Patients receiving long-term management with the medicine should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of hypomagnesaemia (decreased magnesium levels in blood) and bone fracture, predominantly in the elderly patients and in patients with other recognized risk factors.

Before taking RENVORAB 40 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. Your doctor may reduce the dose or suggest an alternative therapy. It is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women and in children (aged less than 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). The most common side effects are nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these above side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About DURAZOL LS CAPSULE

DURAZOL LS CAPSULE is a combination of Esomeprazole and Levosulpiride which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton-pump inhibitors and Dopamine D2 antagonists respectively. DURAZOL LS CAPSULE is indicated for the management of Gastro-esophageal reflux disease (GERD) among patients who do not adequately respond to proton-pump inhibitors alone (Ex. pantoprazole, rabeprazole, esomeprazole, omeprazole).        

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the esophagus leading to irritation of lining of food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.    

DURAZOL LS CAPSULE can also be used to manage peptic ulcer caused by H. pylori infection or NSAID use. Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, esophagus or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.   

Along management with DURAZOL LS CAPSULE eat less spicy food and drink plenty of water or fluids as advised by your physician. Avoid consumption of alcohol as it could aggravate your existing disease conditions.   

Patients receiving long-term management with DURAZOL LS CAPSULE should be kept on regular surveillance to rule out the risk of bone fractures (hip, wrist or spine), predominantly in patients taking corticosteroids and in patients with other recognized risk factors like osteoporosis. Before taking DURAZOL LS CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any heart, kidney or liver disease as a precaution.  

DURAZOL LS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women, including children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety and effectiveness.  DURAZOL LS CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of taking DURAZOL LS CAPSULE are headache, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea or constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DURAZOL LS CAPSULE Works

DURAZOL LS CAPSULE reduces peptic ulcers and acid reflux, where rabeprazole acts by inhibiting the secretions of stomach acid by blocking the proton pump (H+ K+ ATPase) at the secretory surface of gastric parietal cells and levosulpiride acts by blocking the dopamine D2 receptors in the gut which promotes the secretions of acetylcholine, thus facilitating gastric emptying and healing of ulcers and/or esophageal lesions.

Take DURAZOL LS CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow DURAZOL LS CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

DURAZOL LS CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have parkinson’s disease
Have history of epilepsy
Have porphyria (a rare blood disorder)
Have breast cancer or non-cancerous tumor in breast
Have alcohol intoxication (drinking too much alcohol in short period)
Have certain tumors like phaeochromocytoma (tumor in adrenal glands) or pituitary prolactinoma (tumors of pituitary gland)
Have hypokalemia (low blood potassium levels)
Have bleeding or perforation in the stomach or intestines
Have manic states (abnormally elevated mood)

Before taking DURAZOL LS CAPSULE, inform your physician if you:

Are due to have a specific blood test (Chromogranin A)
Reduced vitamin B12 levels in body
Osteoporosis

Use in pediatrics:

DURAZOL LS CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety and effectiveness. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

Introduction About RAZBERG ACE CAPSULE

RAZBERG ACE CAPSULE is a combination of Aceclofenac and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Proton pump inhibitors respectively. It is used to manage inflammation and relive pain in conditions like rheumatoid arthritis (autoimmune disease that causes inflammation in the joints), osteoarthritis (loss of the cartilage and bone tissue causing joint pain), back pain or postsurgical pain.

Do not use RAZBERG ACE CAPSULE if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking RAZBERG ACE CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer or tumour, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

Avoid smoking while taking RAZBERG ACE CAPSULE. RAZBERG ACE CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women, breast-feeding women, children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking RAZBERG ACE CAPSULE are headache, nausea, vomiting, pain or discomfort right below your ribs, gastrointestinal irritation or bleeding, diarrhoea, constipation and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

introduction:
Introduction About GASTORAB 20 TABLET

GASTORAB 20 TABLET contains Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Proton pump inhibitors. It is used to manage Gastro-esophageal Reflux Disease (GERD), peptic ulcer and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome (tumours in the pancreas causing the stomach to secrete more acid).

GERD is a chronic digestive disease in which the stomach acid frequently flows into the oesophagus leading to the irritation of lining of the food pipe. Symptoms include heartburn, chest pain, nausea, sensation of lump in throat and stomach discomfort.

Peptic ulcers are painful sores that develop on the linings of the stomach, oesophagus and/or intestines. Symptoms include stomach pain, flatulence, indigestion, vomiting and fatigue.

Take GASTORAB 20 TABLET preferably before meals or as directed by the physician. Before taking GASTORAB 20 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have vitamin B12 deficiency, osteoporosis or any tumors in your stomach.

Do not take GASTORAB 20 TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking GASTORAB 20 TABLET are oral sores, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, headache and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect troubles you.

You must also inform your doctor immediately if you experience severe uncontrollable diarrhea with stomach pain or tenderness after taking GASTORAB 20 TABLET.

mechanismOfAction:
How GASTORAB 20 TABLET Works

GASTORAB 20 TABLET is a proton pump inhibitor. It reduces the amount of acid produced in the stomach by blocking the actions of an enzyme called H+ K+ ATPase (also known as proton pump) which is present in the lining of the stomach walls. As a result, it reduces the chances for acid reflux into the oesophagus, heals peptic ulcers and esophageal lesions and manages its recurrence.

Take GASTORAB 20 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is preferably taken in the mornings or at any time of the day before meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About ULCERAB IT CAPSULE

ULCERAB IT CAPSULE is a combination of Itopride and Rabeprazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Gastroprokinetic agent and Proton-pump inhibitors respectively. It is used to manage Gastroesophageal reflux disease (acid reflux) and Peptic ulcer disease.

Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a digestive disorder that occurs when acidic stomach juices or food and fluids back up from the stomach into the oesophagus.

Peptic ulcers are open sores that develop on the inside lining of stomach and the upper portion of small intestine. Rarely, peptic ulcer may develop just above your stomach in your oesophagus. The most common symptom of a peptic ulcer is stomach pain.

Before taking this medicine inform your doctor if you have heart disease, liver disease or kidney disease. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before taking this medicine.

There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children and adultescents. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

The most common side effects are stomach pain, headache, constipation, diarrhoea, dizziness, and rash. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persist for a longer duration.
